title: Restaurant Lead
description:
WHO WE ARE:


Since 1907, Neiman Marcus has been a leader in luxury retail, providing a uniquely curated product assortment, unparalleled services and exclusive activations for customers in Pursuit of the Extraordinary. Known for creating Neiman Marcus magic through exceptional experiences, Neiman Marcus has a rich history as a brand builder, bringing together the world's top luxury designers and customers to foster a dedicated following for generations. We serve customers across our stores, digital channels and through remote selling. Neiman Marcus is part of Exemplar Luxury Group, the luxury collective uniting coveted brands with unrivaled customer experiences.

Job Description:


YOU WILL BE: The Restaurant Lead role is responsible for creating and maintaining the restaurant work schedule and supporting the Restaurant Manager or Manager / Chef in all aspects of daily Restaurant operations. This role sets the standard for their staff in order to serve Neiman Marcus customers in a warm, accommodating, and professional manner by greeting and seating customers. WHAT YOU WILL DO: • Sets and maintains the standard for staff as to personal hygiene, cleanliness of the restaurant, interaction between Associates, and store family, maintaining the high quality in service, food, beverage, and other items pertinent to the overall dining experience • Creates efficient and flexible restaurant schedules in partnership with key kitchen staff to identify specific needs in their respective area • Coordinates with key kitchen staff to obtain necessary food items to cover menus and special events, maintaining awareness of inventory quantity and quality control standards to avoid waste • Coordinates with key dining room staff in the preparation and follow-through of daily guest service • Notes any lapse in service standards that may be experienced by guest and relays awareness and appropriate communication to staff • Completes daily, weekly, and monthly reports to forecast business and sales projections • Plans schedules, keeps track of inventory, and budgets • Delegates responsibilities to Associates and follows up on completion • Supports coordination and execution of special events • Reviews catering prospectus details to ensure accuracy of guest count, etc. • Responsible for all rentals, labor, beer, wine, and other variables that may be included but not listed • Builds relationship with customers, behaving as representative of the restaurant WHAT YOU WILL BRING: • High School diploma or GED preferred • Excellent oral and written communication skills • Strong attention to detail • Ability to work autonomously • Motivated and results-driven • Knowledge of proper placement of china, glass, and flatware for table settings • Thorough knowledge of order of service and proper placement of table settings (e.g., china, glass, flatware), food, and beverage as indicated by the kitchen ticket and the guidebookThorough knowledge of food, including preparation and culinary terminology • Ability to interact graciously with the public and handle multiple duties at the same time • Exceptional customer service and problem-solving skills • "Win together" mentality • Basic proficiency with MS Office Product Suite preferred • Role requires standing, bending, climbing stairs, and lifting and carrying 35 pounds • Associates must be willing to work a flexible schedule based on business needs, which will include evenings, weekends, and holidays

YOUR LIFE AND CAREER AT EXEMPLAR LUXURY GROUP:


  • Opportunity to work in a dynamic fast paced environment at a company experiencing growth and transformation
  • Exposure to rewarding career advancement opportunities across the largest multi-brand luxury retailer from retail to distribution, to digital or corporate
  • Comprehensive benefits package for all eligible full-time employees (including medical, vision and dental)
  • An amazing employee discount

Benefits: We offer the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, disability insurance, and a variety of additional voluntary benefits (such as critical illness, hospital and accident insurance).


Thank you for your interest with Exemplar Luxury Group. We look forward to reviewing your application.


Exemplar Luxury Group is an equal employment opportunity employer and is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with Exemplar Luxury Group and would like to request special assistance or an accommodation, please contact candidatesupport@exemplarluxury.com.


Salary Range $21.94 - $27.42*

Compensation for this role varies by geographic location. The listed range reflects multiple markets, including higher-cost areas. Actual starting pay will be determined based on work location, experience, and other job-related factors.

title: [Job-32674] Senior Software Developer (.NET / Azure), Brazil
description:
At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.

With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.

What we’re looking for

  • Hands-on experience implementing authentication: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, JWT, and SSO / SAML.
  • Experience designing RESTful microservices, including security, logging and error handling.
  • Upper-intermediate or advanced English for daily communication with US stakeholders.

Nice to have

  • Microsoft Entra ID or Entra External ID (formerly Azure AD B2C).
  • Dataverse Web API or Dynamics 365 integration.
  • Azure certifications such as AZ-204.

title: Post Fab Operator (Day Shift 2)
description:
onsemi is seeking a highly motivated Wafer Fab Operator to join the Manufacturing Operations Team. The role of the Manufacturing Specialist is primarily to load wafers into production equipment, verify product specs against equipment settings, monitor equipment operation, monitor process pace/productivity, and recognize when something is out of adjustment.

Day 2 Shift: Thursday, Friday, Saturday, and every other Wednesday, 6:30 AM-7:00 PM

Sign-on bonus: $1,500

Sign-On Bonus: Subject to your commencing employment with us, you will also be eligible to receive a sign-on award in the gross amount of $1,500.00, which will be paid in 4 quarterly payments of $375 each (subject to applicable taxes and payroll deductions). The first payment is payable within the first 30 days of you joining onsemi and quarterly thereafter for 3 additional payments. You must be an active employee with onsemi to receive these sign-on awards. In addition, if your employment is terminated with onsemi for any reason, the sign-on award(s) received as of the date of your termination do not need to be repaid to onsemi

Responsibilities

  • Responsible for setting up and operating tools to process wafers through the applicable stage in the manufacturing process.
  • Responsible for using analytic and deductive skills to determine the best strategies for processing those wafers through their tool, including when to perform tool changeovers; ability to communicate with internal customers and team members to make the best decisions for maximum factory productivity.
  • Responsible for making minor corrections to the process and equipment and for recognizing when a technician or engineer is needed, in addition to making suggestions for improvement to productivity.
  • Computer/Software-related tasks such as process diagnosis and interpretation using Statistical Process Control (SPC) methodology.
  • Perform production processes in accordance with documented specifications and production schedules, requiring interfacing with computer systems to complete job duties.
  • Works with teammates and other departments to prioritize daily tasks that impact team goals.
  • Responsible for following and staying up to date on safety and conduct requirements.
  • Able to meet physical requirements listed below in the specific skills addendum, including but not limited to:
    • Carrying pods of wafers that weigh 15-25 pounds throughout the full shift of work

Requirements:

  • High school diploma or GED

Experience required:

  • Prior semiconductor experience is preferred, but not required
  • A stable work history is a plus

Specific Skills Required:

  • Must be able to work a 12-hour compressed shift in a clean room environment.
  • Hard-working, flexible team player with superior attention to detail and computer knowledge.
  • The ability to multitask and manage a large volume of activity and demands.
  • Wearing cleanroom garments is necessary to protect hair, dry skin, etc., from contaminating the product (wafers). This includes wearing a bunny suit, gloves, safety glasses, approved cleanroom shoes, and face coverings.
  • The ability to carry a pod of wafers that weigh 15 pounds throughout the full shift of work.
  • The ability to frequently climb up 4-5 stair steps while carrying a wafer pod throughout the full work shift.

Shift Requirements:

  • The position works a compressed Night. Each shift is 12 hours per day, alternating 3 working days one week and 4 working days the next week.
  • Arriving on shift at the scheduled time and punctuality from breaks and lunches is mandatory to ensure appropriate coverage at all times.

Employees in this role may be required to participate in the site Emergency Response Brigade and support emergency preparedness activities. Participation includes maintaining required training, certifications, and response readiness in accordance with site policies and business needs.

Hourly: onsemi is excited to share the base salary range for this position is $17.13 to $25.87 exclusive of fringe benefits or potential bonuses.The final pay rate for the successful candidate will depend on geographic location, skills, education, experience, and/or consideration of internal equity of our current team members. We also offer a competitive benefits package.

title: Client Service Manager, Las Vegas
description:
The Client Services role represents the entry-level client leadership position at BC. Individuals progress into CG1 after demonstrating both interest and foundational capability in the Client Service Manager (CSM) function, supported by successful completion of the required CSM readiness assessment.

The purpose of the role is to build and apply core client leadership practices, advancing the firm’s consistency and effectiveness in managing BC’s business for clients. Should also be actively working on projects with the client and maintain a utilization target of 60-75% with remaining availability largely devoted to business and client development.

While serving, the individual demonstrates the ability to maintain, leverage, and expand client relationships. Growth contribution is achieved through strong project delivery, successful pursuit participation, and active engagement with the Client Service Team (CST).

Effectiveness is grounded in credibility, both technical and relational, reinforced by visible and measurable contributions to client outcomes and opportunity development.

Expected to serve as an active and engaged member of a CST for a Type I or Type II client and, in some instances, may serve as the CSM for a Type II client. The CSM should expect to spend 20 percent of their time with the client (some of this time may occur as part of billable work).

Responsibilities

  • Support administration and performance of the client portfolio (projects and pursuits) to achieve BC and client business outcomes.
  • Serve as an active CST member (Deputy CSM) for a Type I or Type II client; may serve as CSM for a Type II client in select cases.
  • Contribute to development of client growth strategies and business cases aligned with 1-, 3-, and 5-year milestones.
  • Build a track record of securing and delivering profitable assignments within Area/Market priorities.
  • Maintain utilization targets aligned with portfolio responsibilities.
  • Apply growth and business case thinking to support delivery decisions and reinforce BC’s value through tangible client-recognized outcomes.
  • Maintain accurate and current client data within BC information systems (e.g., WS+).
  • Support effective engagement of SMEs and Delivery leaders to broaden service impact.
  • Assist in expanding client relationships across functional areas and organizational levels; gather and synthesize market intelligence to inform strategy.
  • Maintain regular client engagement (approximately 20% of time, billable or non-billable).
  • Identify and communicate emerging risks affecting client performance or BC exposure.
  • Flexibility to adapt and execute various additional assignments based on evolving needs.

Skills and Competencies

  • Foundational understanding of client portfolio development and business performance drivers.
  • Professional acumen in supporting project oversight while building client-facing credibility.
  • Ability to identify potential opportunities and contribute to go/no-go discussions and pursuit strategy development.
  • Proficiency in developing and maintaining client relationships across functional levels.
  • Working knowledge of client business drivers and emerging needs.
  • Ability to contribute to market research and support expansion into adjacent services.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary teams.
  • Developing experience in proposal support and pursuit participation.
  • Working familiarity with governance principles, risk management, and decision-support practices.
  • Proficiency in facilitation, communication, and presentation skills.
  • Working proficiency in digital tools, data systems, and emerging AI applications.
  • Demonstrated leadership potential with the ability to motivate and support team performance.

Experience

  • Typically, a minimum of 5 years of experience in environmental engineering and consulting industry with progressive responsibilities including marketing and business development.

Education

  • A bachelor’s degree in engineering, science, business, sales, or equivalent experience is required.

Location A: $95,000 - $129,000

Headquartered in Walnut Creek, California, Brown and Caldwell is a full-service environmental engineering and construction services firm with 50 offices and over 2,100 professionals across North America and the Pacific. We strive to be the company of choice—to our clients, who benefit from our passion for delivering exceptional quality, and to our employees, present and future, who share our commitment to client service, collaboration, and innovation. title: Carroll White REMC Member Service Representative
description:
POSITION PURPOSE

To assure that all people visiting or calling the cooperative have a pleasant, courteous, informed reception and are dealt with in a professional and timely manner. To serve as primary contact in the provision of services, disconnects/connects, problem resolution, payments, payment arrangements, general inquiries, and account maintenance.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

To be successful in this role, an individual must be able to perform in a satisfactory manner the functions listed below. The company will make reasonable accommodations to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.

  1. Provide customer service as needed and appropriate. Assure that all people contacting Carroll White REMC have a pleasant, courteous, informed reception and are dealt with in a professional and timely manner
  2. Process payments received for energy bills, diversified services, and miscellaneous receipts with any form of payment that is accepted by Carroll White REMC
  3. Responsible for accurate preparation of daily cash receipts and records. Place the cash drawer in the designated area at the beginning and end of each business day
  4. Assist eligible members to establish a payment arrangement for a delinquent account according to Carroll White REMC policies and document these arrangements
  5. Process delinquent accounts subject to non-payment disconnection; complete processes on terminated accounts and prepare reports for collection agency
  6. Process requests for connections and disconnections; Issue membership applications and determine credit worthiness
  7. Create service orders for tree work, security lights, and other miscellaneous items
  8. Support members’ capital credit inquiries and completing heir forms
  9. Document member contacts with details of interaction and scan items into Document Vault
  10. Assist members with questions concerning their energy usage and be familiar with the different rate options
  11. Troubleshoot specific customer problems and complaints to ensure proper resolution
  12. Promote the sale of new or diversified services or products offered by the cooperative
  13. May be asked to answer calls during power outages after regular working hours
  14. Attain and maintain CPR & First Aid certification
  15. Perform other duties and activities as assigned

EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE

To perform this job successfully, an individual should have an equivalent of the following education and/or experience:

  • High School Diploma or its equivalent
  • Valid Indiana Driver’s License is required

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities required to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The company will make reasonable accommodations to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.

Communication and Relationship Skills

  • Maintain a professional image, demonstrate the cooperative principles, and adapt to change as required
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to describe and explain complicated or sensitive information, the ability to motivate others, the ability to listen effectively to find the issue behind the complaint, the ability to maintain confidentiality, and strong listening skills
  • Strong interpersonal communication skills to work closely with members, other employees, and businesses on a regular basis
  • Maintain confidentiality and discretion regarding member information and other sensitive information

Analytical and Judgment Skills

  • Good decision-making and problem-solving abilities, including the ability to make judgments based on interpretation of information and when others’ opinions may be in conflict
  • Ability to make informed decisions efficiently and effectively
  • Ability to work with limited oversight

Planning and Organizational Skills

  • Ability to prioritize, organize, and manage tasks and time effectively
  • Ability to consistently meet deadlines
  • Ability to work efficiently in conjunction with other organizations and/or departments

Financial Skills

  • Good mathematical abilities, including the ability to analyze, interpret, process and report on data
  • Above average detail orientation and ability to ensure accuracy of information for self and others

Technical/ Computer/ Office Equipment

  • Proficiency using a computer, including Microsoft 365, spreadsheets, and various databases
  • Ability to operate office equipment, including printers, copiers, phones, and mobile devices

DESIRED COMMITMENTS

7 Cooperative Principals

  1. Voluntary and Open Membership
  2. Democratic Member Control
  3. Member’s Economic Participation
  4. Autonomy and Independence
  5. Education, Training, and Information
  6. Cooperation Among Cooperatives
  7. Concern for the Community

WORK ENVIRONMENT/PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The environmental and physical demands described here are representative of those an individual must meet to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. The company will make reasonable accommodations to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.

  • Ability to work in a deadline-oriented environment
  • Ability to sit for extended periods and operate computer workstation
  • Ability to stand for periods of time and to move intermittently throughout the workday within or between departments or facilities
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision; may be required to act based on own interpretation of policies
  • Strong sensory skills such as hearing, dexterity, feeling and good eyesight, including the use of peripheral vision and can identify colors
  • Ability to speak clearly and have legible handwriting
  • Ability to interact frequently with others, both in person and through phone, e-mail, and written correspondence
  • Ability to lift/carry up to 30 pounds or more on a periodic basis
  • Maintain a safe and clean working environment
  • Limited travel, including overnights
  • Occasional work outside of normal work hours will be required

title: Director of Finance
location: West Palm Beach, FL, United States
description:
Additional Information: This hotel is owned and operated by an independent franchisee, Sage Hospitality. The franchisee is a separate company and a separate employer from Marriott International, Inc. The franchisee solely controls all aspects of the hotel’s employment policies and practices, including hiring, firing, discipline, staffing, compensation, benefits, and all other terms and conditions of employment. If you accept a position at this hotel, you will be employed by a franchisee and not by Marriott International, Inc.

The Ben Hotel and Sage Hospitality Group are seeking a strategic, hands-on Director of Finance to join the executive leadership team in West Palm Beach, Florida.
The Ben is a luxury waterfront hotel where every detail tells a story. Inspired by Birdie Dewey and her legendary Ben Trovato Estate, the hotel blends modern sophistication with creativity, individuality, and authentic hospitality. As part of Marriott’s Autograph Collection, The Ben delivers an experience that is “Exactly Like Nothing Else.”
Overlooking the Intracoastal Waterway in the heart of downtown West Palm Beach, The Ben is home to Proper Grit, a whisky and supper club-inspired restaurant, and Spruzzo, the city’s only water-facing rooftop lounge. With a rooftop heated saltwater pool, distinctive event spaces, and elevated food and beverage experiences, The Ben is a destination for guests who value luxury, style, and thoughtful service.
The Director of Finance serves as a key member of the hotel’s executive leadership team and is responsible for leading all financial operations of the property. This role partners closely with the General Manager and department leaders to drive financial performance, protect company assets, ensure compliance, and support sound business decisions across the hotel.
The ideal candidate is a strong hospitality finance leader with exceptional analytical skills, operational knowledge, and the ability to lead with confidence, integrity, and collaboration. They will oversee budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, internal controls, payroll, accounts payable, accounts receivable, cash management, and financial analysis while helping shape the continued success of this distinctive luxury hotel.
Learn more about The Ben at .
Job Overview:
The Director of Finance serves as the financial leader of The Ben Hotel, overseeing all areas of the hotel’s finance operation, including payroll, budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, and internal controls. This role provides strategic financial guidance to hotel leadership and Sage Hospitality, ensuring timely, accurate reporting and sound business decisions. The Director of Finance safeguards hotel and owner assets, maintains strong internal controls, and ensures compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with hotel leaders across all departments on daily operations and special projects. Identify financial risks, present practical solutions, and guide decisions that support the hotel’s financial objectives.
  • Develop and manage the annual operating budget, business plan, and financial goals. Drive budgeted revenue, cost, and profit performance through disciplined accounting practices and strong expense controls.
  • Establish clear quarterly priorities and key objectives for department heads, including action plans and completion dates. Follow up on progress, ensure accountability, and take corrective action when objectives are not met.
  • Prepare monthly forecasts for staffing, operating expenses, and business performance. Partner with department heads to align staffing plans, expenses, and operational decisions with forecasted revenue and costs.
  • Review monthly financial statements to identify trends, correct concerns, manage spending, and plan for future business needs. Review and approve applicable “other expense” categories and regularly evaluate significant expenditures to ensure responsible use of hotel resources.
  • Maintain a visible, approachable presence throughout the hotel. Promote associate morale, engagement, retention, and development in alignment with Sage Hospitality’s open-door culture. Attend department meetings when possible.
  • Lead performance reviews and development planning for finance management team members. Address performance concerns promptly through coaching, improvement plans, and corrective action when appropriate.
  • Ensure finance team members have the experience, knowledge, and capability to meet their responsibilities. Provide ongoing training, mentorship, and support to strengthen the department.
  • Establish, review, and enforce cost-control practices and internal controls that safeguard hotel and owner assets and support compliance with company standards and applicable regulations.
  • Partner with the Sales and Revenue teams to review sales activity, room night productivity, group rates, market mix, and key account opportunities. Support strategic account engagement by reviewing contracts, participating in sales discussions, and meeting with key clients as needed.

Qualifications

Education/Formal Training

A four-year college degree (accounting preferred) or equivalent education/experience.

Experience

Experience required by position is five to ten years of employment in a related position with this company or other organization(s).

Knowledge/Skills

  • Requires knowledge of all hotel accounting functions performed by the subordinate reporting directly or indirectly.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

As a Process Integration Conversion Coordinator (PICC) in Fab 4, you will play a key role in enabling successful manufacturing changes by partnering closely with Process Integration Engineering and a broad network of cross-functional teams. You will collaborate with Change Management, Traveler Control, Manufacturing, Process Integration Engineering, PI Technicians, and business partners across Operations, Information Systems, Planning, and Inventory to maintain and improve critical process control systems and manufacturing execution workflows!


In this role, you will coordinate and implement system setup changes to support automated lot processing, new product introductions, traveler revisions, process conversions, and manufacturing changes. Acting as a central point of coordination, you will ensure changes are implemented accurately, on time, and in compliance with business rules and BKMs. You will also use approved AI and digital tools to improve data analysis, reporting, documentation, training, and process execution, while validating AI-generated content for accuracy and compliance and driving continuous improvement through automation and technology!


Responsibilities


  • Coordinate and implement process conversions, traveler revisions, and New Part Requests (NPRs) to support manufacturing and new product introduction requirements.
  • Create, validate, and implement system setup changes across manufacturing platforms such as GeRM, Sigma, SPACE, Travelers, Queue Time, LMS, and GCPWeb.
  • Drive NPR startup activities and coordinate changes across multiple systems to support new product introductions while minimizing manufacturing risk and disruption.
  • Apply, maintain, and promote worldwide standards, business rules, and best known methods (BKMs) related to conversion management and process control.
  • Troubleshoot manufacturing system issues, verify process flows and configurations, and partner with stakeholders to ensure reliable automated lot processing.
  • Develop and maintain documentation, training materials, business rules, and lessons learned to improve organizational knowledge and operational consistency.
  • Provide training and guidance to engineers, technicians, and other users on GCPWeb, conversion processes, and related manufacturing systems.
  • Generate performance metrics, dashboards, and reports while identifying and implementing opportunities to streamline workflows, improve process efficiency, enhance data quality, and support continuous improvement initiatives.

Minimum Qualifications


  • High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent experience.

  • 4+ years of semiconductor manufacturing experience, including semiconductor processes and systems, lot logistics, conversion management, troubleshooting, and process execution.
  • 4+ years of experience using Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint for data analysis and reporting.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, communication, and teamwork skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and effectively partner across technical and operational teams.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Required associate degree - AAS, AS, STEM-related degree, trade school certification, military technical training, or equivalent industry experience.
  • Experience with PI Tech activities, process conversions, traveler revisions, NPRs, or change management activities.

title: Restorative Aide
description:
Title: Restorative Aide

Job Type: Full time

Your experience matters!

At Cornerstone Specialty Hospitals Round Rock, we are driven by a profound commitment to prioritize your well-being so you can provide exceptional care to others. Here, you’re not just valued as an employee, but as a person.

Cornerstone Specialty Hospitals Round Rock is a long-term acute care (LTAC) hospital located at 4681 College Park Drive, Round Rock, TX 78665. It specializes in treating patients who are recovering from intensive care and have medically complex conditions.

As a Restorative Aide joining our team, you’re embracing a vital mission dedicated to making communities healthier. Join us on this meaningful journey where your skills, compassion, and dedication will make a remarkable difference in the lives of those we serve.

How you’ll contribute:

Provides restorative nursing interventions under the supervision of a licensed nurse to support patients discharged from formal rehabilitation therapy, those not eligible for formal therapy, or those requiring supplemental interventions during custodial care. The goal is to promote independent, safe functioning and enhance physical, mental, and psychosocial well-being. Restorative nursing services (excluding Continuous Passive Motion) do not require a physician’s order.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Perform restorative nursing interventions to support patients in reaching maximum functional potential.
  • Report patient responses and condition changes to the supervising nurse or therapist.
  • Participate in quality management and safety committee activities.
  • Assist in collecting quality review data and survey preparation.
  • Support cost-effective care delivery and interdisciplinary group activities.
  • Engage in continuing education and professional development.
  • Demonstrate professional behavior in interactions with patients, families, and colleagues.
  • Adhere to the standards of professional organizations and internal policies.
  • Contribute to client relations and marketing efforts.
  • Maintain clinical competency and participate in team meetings.
  • Support administrative and clinical efficiency initiatives.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

FLSA Status: Non-exempt
Work Environment: Hospital-based; may involve exposure to biohazards and require PPE

Qualifications and requirements:

Education: High school diploma or GED required.
Experience: Six months experience as a Rehab Tech or Restorative Nursing Aide in a hospital or long-term care setting preferred.
Certifications: Basic Life Support (BLS) certification required.
Skills and Abilities: Competence with basic computer and technology systems.

About us
Lifepoint Rehabilitation is part of Lifepoint Health, a diversified healthcare delivery network committed to making communities healthier® with acute care, rehabilitation, and behavioral health facilities from coast to coast. From your first day to your next career milestone—your experience matters.

title: Post Fab Technician Day Shift 2
description:
onsemi is seeking a Post‑Fab Technician in Hopewell Junction, NY. This is a multi‑skilled, hands‑on role responsible for supporting semiconductor manufacturing through equipment maintenance, process execution, and day‑to‑day operations. This position requires a strong willingness to learn semiconductor processes, troubleshoot and maintain manufacturing equipment, and support smooth production flow while adhering to all safety, quality, and cleanroom standards.

This role is ideal for a technician who enjoys hands‑on technical work, problem‑solving, and working in a high‑precision manufacturing environment. Application Technicians work 12‑hour compressed shifts in a cleanroom environment.

Day 2 Schedule: Thursday, Friday, Saturday every other Wednesday 6:30 AM – 7:00 PM

Sign on Bonus: $5,000

Employees in this role may be required to participate in the site Emergency Response Brigade and support emergency preparedness activities. Participation includes maintaining required training, certifications, and response readiness in accordance with site policies and business needs.

Operations Support

  • Operate production tools safely and efficiently within a cleanroom environment
  • Load/unload wafers, materials, and tools in accordance with operating procedures
  • Monitor equipment performance, alarms, and system statuses
  • Support production goals by maintaining equipment uptime and tool availability
  • Follow all safety, ESD, and contamination control guidelines

Process Support

  • Learn and monitor semiconductor manufacturing processes according to documented procedures
  • Assist with process setup, recipe changes, and process optimization under engineering guidance
  • Perform inspections, measurements, and basic data collection to ensure process stability
  • Identify process deviations and escalate issues to engineering or leadership as required

Equipment Maintenance

  • Perform preventative maintenance (PM) on semiconductor manufacturing equipment
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot equipment issues to minimize downtime
  • Assist with equipment repairs, part replacements, and system calibrations
  • Maintain maintenance logs and documentation in accordance with company standards
  • Support equipment startups, shutdowns, and qualification activities

Continuous Improvement & Team Collaboration

  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives for process, equipment, and operations
  • Work closely with engineers, technicians, and operators across shifts
  • Assist with training new team members and documenting procedures
  • Maintain a high standard of housekeeping and organization in work areas
  • Perform all job duties in a safe and responsible manner, supporting all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security (EHS&S) programs

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED with 1-2 years of technical manufacturing experience
  • Ability to stand and walk for up to 10-hours per day in a cleanroom environment while wearing coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, and gloves.
  • Basic computer literacy, including the use of email, web-based systems, and common office productivity tools (e.g., Microsoft Office applications) to document work, create reports, and communicate with team members.
  • Must be self-motivated, showing initiative and drive to exceed performance expectations.
  • Analytical problem-solving and troubleshooting skills with close attention to detail.
  • Ability to work well in a diverse team environment.
  • Ability to work with minimal supervision and adjust to rapidly changing priorities.
  • Able to speak and write fluently in English.
  • Must be able to lift up to 35 lbs.

Preferred

  • Vocational High School, Technical training, or technical trade certificate.
  • Proficient in working with hand tools, meters, and calibration tools
  • Knowledge of and ability to follow 5S, LEAN is a plus.

Hourly: onsemi is excited to share the base salary range for this position is $18.46 to $32.26 exclusive of fringe benefits or potential bonuses.The final pay rate for the successful candidate will depend on geographic location, skills, education, experience, and/or consideration of internal equity of our current team members. title: Telemetry Monitor Technician Full Time Days
description:
Job Summary

The Monitor Technician is responsible for continuous surveillance of telemetry monitors to assess and document patient cardiac rhythms. Identifies arrhythmias, communicates findings to the healthcare team, and ensures monitoring equipment is functional and accurately configured. Supports patient safety and effective care delivery.

Essential Functions

  • Continuously observes and interprets patient telemetry monitors, accurately recording rhythm strips at established intervals.
  • Identifies and promptly notifies the nurse or other licensed personnel of any rhythm changes, including potentially life-threatening arrhythmias.
  • Maintains effective communication with peers, staff, physicians, and leaders to ensure seamless care coordination.
  • Troubleshoots and resolves issues with monitoring equipment, escalating unresolved problems to Bio-med or IT as directed.
  • Organizes and tracks monitoring equipment during the shift, ensuring proper configuration for patient admissions, transfers, and discharges.
  • Ensures accurate lead placement and electrode application to maintain optimal telemetry monitoring.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Maintains regular and reliable attendance.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.

Qualifications

  • Completion of a telemetry or EKG interpretation course during orientation period required
  • 0-2 years of clerical and/or clinical experience in a medical setting required

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Proficiency in reading and interpreting EKG rhythms and identifying arrhythmias.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to remain focused in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to operate and troubleshoot telemetry monitoring equipment.
  • Knowledge of patient safety protocols and escalation processes.
  • Organizational skills to manage equipment tracking and documentation efficiently.

Licenses and Certifications

  • BCLS - Basic Life Support required

title: Director of Internal Communications
description:

Above all, you are passionate about employee communications. We’re seeking an innovative, hands-on communications leader to direct the internal communications function for our large global workforce. Reporting directly to the Managing Director of Corporate Communications and Brand, you’ll be the primary architect of our employee communications strategy and a key member of the corporate communications leadership team.


You’ll lead a small, specialized team, including our in-house studio production team, which supports internal, executive, and external communications.   • Lead communications strategy and execution for key internal events, including quarterly all-hands meetings

  • Champion storytelling that highlights employee achievements, club activities, and unique aspects of our workforce
  • Drive innovation in internal communications, leveraging new technologies and best practices

  • 15+ years of corporate communications experience, with substantial focus on internal communications
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing communications strategies for large, global organizations
  • Experience leading small, high-performing communications teams while remaining hands-on in strategy and content creation
  • Experience overseeing video and multimedia production for internal, executive, and external audiences, ideally including management of an in-house studio or production team

No

title: Water Resources Graduate
description:
Great communities are built on connection. From vibrant economic centres, resilient communities, and public spaces where we gather to the roads, bridges, transit systems, airports, and ports that connect us, our work touches everyday life. We bring together diverse perspectives and expertise to deliver meaningful outcomes.

Join us to help plan, design, and engineer community and mobility solutions that improve everyday life. Whatever the distance, wherever the destination, our designs lead you there.

Your Opportunity

An opportunity exists within Stantec’s Community Development Team for a Water Resources Graduate. This entry level position will be based out of Stantec's Ontario offices (Markham, Mississauga, Toronto, etc.), but may require travel to other regional Stantec offices.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Assisting senior staff with writing reports and design briefs to document analyses.
  • Prepare stormwater management plans involving hydraulic and hydrologic modeling analyses, preparation of design concepts, and input into design drawings in support of land development and/or linear infrastructure projects;
  • Complete engineering design of stormwater management ponds, underground and surface drainage infrastructure, low impact development features, green infrastructure, storm sewer design sheets, and erosion and sediment control plans;
  • Complete hydraulic modeling in support of floodplain mapping;
  • Prepare technical reports and design briefs to document analyses including taking responsibility for the quality of written, technical and graphic work. Review designs and reporting for compliance with municipal, provincial and federal regulations;
  • Help guide projects through to completion, from due diligence/feasibility work, preliminary/ conceptual design, through to detailed design, scheduling, tendering, construction, and certification;
  • With the support of senior staff, liaise with clients, agencies and others to determine project requirements and obtain approvals;
  • Perform local and remote field work as required, including the collection of geomorphological field data, environmental sampling, etc.; and
  • Performs other duties as assigned by the senior engineering staff.

Your Capabilities and Credentials

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate ideas to others both verbally and in written documentation such as emails, memos and technical reports;
  • Working knowledge of Ontario’s stormwater guidelines and regulations and familiarity with the land development/redevelopment process with an understanding of water resources, environmental and/or civil engineering concepts;
  • Willing to work and collaborate in project team setting and to engage in creative and critical thought;
  • Strong time management skills with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks;
  • Ability to interpret sketches. drawings, standards, and other similar material including an understanding of the interplay between design, permitting and construction;
  • Requires understanding of Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, etc.);

  • Hands on experience with stormwater management modelling, ideally Visual OTTHYMO, HEC-RAS, and PCSWMM, and with design software such as ArcGIS, AutoCAD (Civil3D) is beneficial. Knowledge of SWMHYMO, InfoWorks, GAWSER, or other models considered an asset. Requires proficiency with the Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, etc.); and a background in the preparation of stormwater management plans and reports, master and/or phased master drainage plans, and functional servicing plans are considered assets.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Civil Engineering (or similar) and eligibility to be registered as a Professional Engineer (P. Eng.) with Professional Engineers Ontario (PEO) within 0-4 years.
  • Minimum of 8 months of stormwater management experience (e.g. coop) with a preference for 2+ years. Work experience in adjacent fields such as civil, geological or hydrogeological engineering, construction management, etc. will be considered.

Typical office environment working with computers and remaining sedentary for long periods of time. Field work may include exposure to the elements including inclement weather.

This description is not a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that may be required of the employee and other duties, responsibilities and activities may be assigned or may be changed at any time with or without notice.

About Stantec

Stantec is a global leader in sustainable engineering, architecture, and environmental consulting. The diverse perspectives of our partners and interested parties drive us to think beyond what’s previously been done on critical issues like climate change, digital transformation, and future-proofing our cities and infrastructure. We innovate at the intersection of community, creativity, and client relationships to advance communities everywhere, so that together we can redefine what’s possible.

title: Orthotics Technician
description:
Job Summary:

The Orthotics Technician is a trained member of the orthopaedic team who works with all health care professionals in delivering patient care and assuming appropriate responsibilities concerning all surgical and non-surgical procedures.

Key Accountabilities:

Excellence in customer service, proficient in insurance verification / authorization and maintenance of patient records. Organizational skills required to maintain schedules, return phone calls and maintain stock.

  1. Greets patient, informs, prepares and positions patient for procedure. Provides patient and family education.
  2. Conducts clinical interview of patients and assesses needs according to Physician's prescription. Read specifications to determine the type of device to be fabricated and the materials and tools that will be required.
  3. Applies or removes casts/splints.
  4. Make orthotic devices by bending, forming and shaping materials to prescribed specifications. Fit, test and evaluate devices on patients and make adjustments for proper fit, function and comfort.
  5. Provides patient with insurance information and financial responsibility information. Completes work orders, billing, and notes for patients. Verifies benefits, completes pre-certification and documents in patient record.
  6. Triages patient by telephone and communicates patient's needs to certified practitioner or Physician.
  7. Maintains cast room and orders stock inventory.
  8. Exemplifies the desired culture and philosophies of the organization.

Minimum Requirements:

  • High School diploma or GED minimum education requirement
  • Computer skills including, but not limited to, MS Office suite

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Completed courses in Anatomy, Kinesiology, Sports Medicine, Physical/Occupational Therapy and Athletic Training preferred.
  • Certified Orthotics Fitter or Athletic Trainer preferred.
  • One (1) to two (2) years experience in a clinical position preferred. Certified Athletic Trainers or Occupational Therapy experience preferred.

title: Projects Engineer
description:
The Staff Manufacturing Engineer is a full-time, on-site role based in Austin, Texas. This position provides hands-on technical leadership to Manufacturing Operations during the planning, introduction, integration, and production of complex test and measurement systems. Serving as the primary link between product design teams and manufacturing, the engineer ensures that configurable, multidisciplinary systems can be assembled, configured, tested, verified, and delivered safely, reliably, and on schedule in a highly dynamic environment.

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:

  • Serve as the product engineering owner for assigned test-system platforms from new product introduction through sustaining production.
  • Provide hands-on technical support during system assembly, integration, software and firmware configuration, calibration, test, verification, and production release.
  • Partner with design teams to define requirements, develop validation plans, and improve manufacturability, testability, quality, reliability, and serviceability.
  • Assess manufacturing readiness by reviewing drawings, bills of material, work instructions, software configurations, test procedures, tooling, material availability, and configuration-control requirements.
  • Lead the resolution of production constraints involving design ambiguities, component shortages, substitutions, test failures, workmanship issues, and hardware, software, firmware, mechanical, or system-level interfaces.
  • Own technical issues from initial identification through containment, structured root-cause analysis, corrective action, recurrence prevention, and effectiveness verification.
  • Balance planned engineering work with urgent manufacturing escalations, reprioritizing based on production schedules, material constraints, technical risk, and customer commitments.
  • Support prototype and pilot builds, design-for-manufacturability and design-for-test reviews, process validation, production documentation, training, release readiness, and transition to sustaining production.
  • Use production data to identify and lead improvements in first-pass yield, system test success, build cycle time, defects, rework, schedule attainment, material readiness, cost, and productivity.
  • Drive continuous improvement through Lean methods, mistake-proofing, workflow automation, analytics, and engineering productivity tools.
  • Communicate technical risks, tradeoffs, ownership, status, and recovery plans clearly to manufacturing personnel, global engineering teams, cross-functional partners, and leadership.
  • Maintain clear technical documentation, product knowledge, configuration rules, known failure modes, lessons learned, and standard work.

For This Role, You Will Need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical, mechanical, computer, systems, manufacturing engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States, Sponsorship will not ne provided now and in the future.
  • Two or more years of relevant experience in product, systems, manufacturing, test, or new product introduction engineering.
  • Experience troubleshooting multidisciplinary electromechanical systems that may include electronic instrumentation, industrial computers, embedded controllers, software, firmware, cable assemblies, custom interfaces, mechanical enclosures, racks, fixtures, and thermal components.
  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings, schematics, bills of material, technical specifications, test requirements, and manufacturing documentation.
  • Demonstrated experience leading structured root-cause analysis, corrective action, and recurrence-prevention activities.
  • Strong project coordination, analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and cross-functional communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, make sound technical decisions with incomplete information, and work independently in a fast-changing production environment.
  • Fluent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to work on-site five days per week in manufacturing and office environments.

Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:

  • Experience with automated test and measurement systems and configurable, low-volume/high-mix manufacturing.
  • Familiarity with NI or Emerson hardware and software platforms.
  • Knowledge of design validation, quality and reliability engineering, configuration control, and engineering change processes.
  • Experience with AS9100, ISO 9001, or similar quality-management systems.
  • Experience applying Lean, Kaizen, mistake-proofing, or Design for Manufacturability principles.
  • Experience using Power BI, Power Automate, LabVIEW, Python, SQL, or similar analytics and automation tools to improve manufacturing performance.
  • Experience supporting global manufacturing and engineering teams.

At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. title: ED Registrar- PRN
description:
Job Summary

The ER Registrar is responsible for managing patient intake and registration processes in the Emergency Department. This role gathers and verifies personal, insurance, and medical information, ensures accuracy and confidentiality of patient records, and delivers high-quality customer service to patients and their families. The ER Registrar plays a key role in facilitating efficient department operations by supporting accurate documentation, insurance verification, and communication across clinical and administrative teams.

Essential Functions
  • Greets patients and families in a professional and compassionate manner, ensuring a positive first impression.
  • Registers patients for emergency services, obtaining all required personal, insurance, and medical information.
  • Verifies patient identification and insurance details, making necessary updates to patient records as needed.
  • Obtains patient's or appropriate family members' signature on all necessary consent authorization forms, explaining each consent prior to it being signed.
  • Verifies insurance coverage and eligibility, ensuring that all necessary information is captured for billing purposes.
  • Collects patient co-pays or deductibles when applicable and inform patients of financial obligations.
  • Assists patients with understanding insurance requirements and assist with resolving insurance-related questions.
  • Carefully documents on all forms if the patient is unable to sign the consent authorization forms or why a family member signs the forms and has nursing sign off if the patient is unable to sign.
  • Verifies insurance and identifies the proper insurance plan codes to ensure accurate and prompt payment.
  • Compiles the necessary paperwork to ensure quick retrieval and processing of the patients visit.
  • Places an armband on each patient before the patient leaves the department to ensure proper identification of the patient throughout their stay.
  • Notifies department or physicians or the patient's arrival. Follows up with the physician or ancillary department if the patient is left waiting for an extended period of time.
  • Maintains communication with key personnel during emergency codes and alerts the facility when emergency plans are in place.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Maintains regular and reliable attendance.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.
Qualifications
  • Post-secondary education or training in medical office administration or healthcare administration preferred
  • 0-2 years of experience in a healthcare setting including patient registration, medical office scheduling, or front desk/admissions required
  • 0-2 years of experience in customer service preferred
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
  • Strong communication and customer service skills.
  • Knowledge of insurance verification and basic medical terminology.
  • Ability to maintain accuracy and attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.
  • Familiarity with electronic health record (EHR) systems and registration software.
  • Ability to manage sensitive and confidential information appropriately.
  • Effective interpersonal skills to work with patients, families, and healthcare teams.
  • Ability to remain calm and professional in high-stress or emergency situations.

title: Technology Business Management Planning Intern
description:
A path for every ambition.

At HUB, we believe the best work happens when people are given real space to grow and then given the autonomy to exercise it. We power progress and protect ambition: for the clients who count on us, and equally for the people who make that possible every day.

Whether you’re starting out or leveling up, you’ll find the resources to evolve, the support to take on more and a team ready to back you at every stage.

Your ambition has a home here.


Hi – we’re HUB, we’re more than an insurance broker – we’re a network of doers with diverse stories and a shared goal: to support our clients and communities. Great work happens when people come together, which is why we build teams where every voice is valued, ideas are encouraged, and growth is supported.


Are you ready to launch your career in insurance brokerage? Join HUB International’s U.S. award-winning Internship Program!

As an intern at HUB, you’ll be part of our collaborative culture where your contributions matter and your growth is supported. This internship is specifically designed to give you exposure to the many career opportunities within the fast-growing insurance brokerage industry.


Business Practice Assignment

We are looking for a Technology Business Management (TBM) Planning Intern to join our Enterprise Strategy and Technology Planning team. This internship gives you hands-on exposure to how a large insurance broker plans and manages its technology spend. You will support the finance team that partners with Infrastructure and Data & Analytics leaders on a portfolio of roughly $90M in annual spend, helping turn financial data into clear, forward-looking insight for decision-makers.


You will work alongside experienced FP&A and IT finance professionals, learn how budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis work in practice, and build skills in financial analysis, IT cost structures, and technology business management. We are looking for someone curious, detail-oriented, and eager to learn how finance and technology work together.

Full-time, paid, June 1 to August 6 (10-week) internship working out of our 200 N LaSalle Office in Chicago, IL.

Program Highlights

  • Pathway to a Career at HUB: Our internship program is designed to identify and develop future talent. High-performing interns may have the opportunity to pursue full-time roles across HUB’s U.S. locations following graduation.
  • Connect with Industry Leaders: Build your network and learn from experienced professionals across HUB. Through our Speaker Series and other networking opportunities, you’ll gain exposure to leaders, fellow interns, and professionals from across the United States while developing a deeper understanding of the insurance industry.
  • Meaningful, Hands-On Experience: Make an impact from day one by contributing to real business priorities and projects. Bring your ideas, collaborate with your team, and gain practical experience that connects your learning to the business.
  • Professional Development: Build skills that will support you throughout your career through workshops, learning sessions, and networking opportunities focused on communication, problem-solving, leadership, and professional growth.
  • Mentorship & Support: Learn alongside experienced professionals who will provide guidance, share their expertise, and help you navigate both your internship experience and the insurance industry.
  • Experiences Beyond the Office: Your internship is about more than your day-to-day role. Participate in volunteer initiatives, social activities, networking opportunities, and local experiences designed to help you build connections, explore the industry, and have fun along the way.
  • Make an Impact in Your Community: Collaborate with fellow interns on a local service initiative that gives back to the communities where we live and work. Select projects may also receive a donation to support their chosen nonprofit or charitable organization.
  • Scholarship Opportunities: Eligible interns may have the opportunity to apply for a scholarship through the Council of Insurance Agents & Brokers (CIAB), providing an additional opportunity to demonstrate their potential and commitment to a future in the insurance industry.

In This Role, You'll Get To:

  • Support budget and forecast preparation: Assist with annual budget inputs and monthly or quarterly rolling forecasts for Infrastructure and Data & Analytics.
  • Build analyses and models: Help develop multi-year outlooks and simple scenario models that support long-range technology planning.
  • Track spend: Pull and reconcile spend data across infrastructure, cloud, and data platforms, and help check coding, accruals, and contract alignment.
  • Contribute to variance analysis: Help prepare monthly variance reports and draft clear commentary on what the numbers mean.
  • Support dashboards and metrics: Assist in building and maintaining technology executive dashboards and financial performance metrics.
  • Work across teams: Learn how Cloud FinOps, the TBM platform team, technology leadership, procurement, AP, and corporate FP&A keep IT finances aligned.
  • Support workforce and investment analysis: Help with workforce planning, labor capitalization tracking, and business case or post-close analysis for technology investments.
  • Improve processes: Contribute ideas for standardizing planning templates and making recurring financial processes more efficient.

What You Will Learn:

Throughout the internship, you will build a working understanding of the following areas:

  • Financial Planning & Analysis: How budgets, forecasts, and variance analysis are built and used to guide decisions.
  • TBM & Financial Platforms: How TBM frameworks and tools such as Apptio, along with ERP systems and reporting tools, support cost transparency.
  • Business Partnership: How to explain financial and technical information clearly to people with different backgrounds.
  • Process & Governance: How automation, standardization, and continuous improvement strengthen financial discipline.
  • Independent Thinking: How to take ownership of well-defined tasks, ask the right questions, and escalate issues early.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Currently enrolled in a bachelor's or master's program in finance, accounting, business, economics, information systems, or a related field, with an expected graduation date within the next 12 to 24 months
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort working with numbers and large datasets
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including formulas, lookups, pivot tables, and basic charting
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks, meet deadlines, and take direction while also thinking independently

Preferred:

  • Coursework or experience in corporate finance, managerial accounting, or financial analysis
  • Exposure to IT, cloud, or technology cost concepts through coursework, projects, or prior work
  • Familiarity with ERP systems (such as SAP or Oracle) or data visualization tools
  • Interest in Apptio or Technology Business Management (TBM)
  • Experience with Excel modeling or Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools

Ready to kickstart your career? Join HUB’s Internship Program and gain hands-on experience, mentorship, and professional development in one of the fastest-growing industries. Apply today and take the first step toward building your future with HUB!


Culture and Belonging: Our Commitment

At HUB International, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where everyone feels a sense of belonging. We value the unique experiences and perspectives that each team member brings, creating an environment where all voices are welcomed and respected. title: Research Intern, Continual Adaptation for Robotics
description:
At Toyota Research Institute (TRI), we’re on a mission to improve the quality of human life. We’re developing new tools and capabilities to amplify the human experience. To lead this transformative shift in mobility, we’ve built a world-class team advancing the state of the art in AI, robotics, driving, and material sciences.

This is a paid 12-week internship opportunity and is a hybrid, in-office role.

Here’s a glimpse into the Internship experience from some of our TRI interns!


The Opportunity

We are seeking a research intern to advance continual adaptation for robot policies. Our goal is to enable robots to improve from experience, personalize their behavior, preserve learned capabilities, and build on prior learning to acquire new behaviors more efficiently.

You will work closely with our robotics and machine learning researchers on a project shaped around your interests, expertise, and the team’s priorities. The work will combine algorithm development with experiments in simulation and on real robots, emphasizing reliable adaptation with limited robot experience and human effort.

The Research

We are interested in how robots can improve through ongoing experience while preserving and building on what they have learned. Your project could explore one of the following directions:

  • Continual learning: Preserve existing capabilities through successive adaptations and use prior experience to learn new behaviors more efficiently. Investigate how useful adaptations can be retained, combined, and reused, including settings where the original training data are unavailable.

  • Efficient learning and adaptation: Enable robots to improve with limited experience by identifying where adaptation is needed and making effective use of prior knowledge, new interactions, and guidance.

  • Personalization from human guidance: Use demonstrations, corrections, or preference feedback to change how a robot performs a task while maintaining task success. Investigate when guidance is sufficient and when further learning is needed.

Possible approaches include reinforcement learning, imitation learning, agentic tool use, modular policies, and distillation, depending on the research question.

Responsibilities

  • Work with your mentor to formulate a focused research question, develop an approach, and implement it within the team's research systems.

  • Design and run controlled experiments with strong baselines in simulation and on real robots, using measures appropriate to the project, such as task success, retention and transfer of learned capabilities, adherence to user preferences, and the robot experience and human effort required.

  • Analyze failure modes and maintain reproducible code and experimental records.

  • Collaborate with researchers and engineers, present findings, and contribute to technical reports and potential publications in robotics and machine learning venues.

Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing a Ph.D. in robotics, machine learning, computer science, or a related field.

  • Research experience in reinforcement learning, imitation learning, continual learning, or closely related machine learning methods.

  • Strong programming skills in Python and experience with a deep learning framework such as PyTorch or JAX.

  • Ability to design experiments, reason critically about results, work independently with mentorship, and communicate clearly.

Bonus Qualifications

  • Experience with generative robot policies, diffusion or flow models, vision-language-action, or world-action models.

  • Experience with online reinforcement learning, interactive learning, personalization, preference learning, or continual learning.

  • Experience with post-training, parameter-efficient adaptation, modular models, or agentic approaches using pretrained models.

  • Experience with robotics simulation, real-world robot learning, or robot data collection and evaluation systems.

  • Relevant research contributions demonstrated through publications, open-source projects, or substantial research projects.

title: Tilaus- ja toimituskoordinaattori – Vohek Oy
description:
Tilaus- ja toimituskoordinaattori – Vohek Oy, Lieto

Pidätkö langat käsissäsi, nautitko asioiden järjestämisestä ja haluatko nähdä oman työsi tulokset päivittäin?

Etsimme Vohek Oy Lietoon oma-aloitteista ja järjestelmällistä tilaus- ja toimituskoordinaattoria vastaamaan tilausten sujuvasta käsittelystä, toimitusten seurannasta ja myynnin tukemisesta.

Tässä tehtävässä pääset työskentelemään teknisen kaupan parissa, tekemään yhteistyötä asiakkaiden, myynnin ja kansainvälisten yhteistyökumppaneiden kanssa sekä varmistamaan, että tilaukset etenevät sovitusti alusta loppuun.

Jos olet tarkka, pidät vastuunkannosta ja viihdyt monipuolisessa työssä, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö!

Tehtäväsi – varmistat, että asiat tapahtuvat

Tilaus- ja toimituskoordinaattorina olet tärkeä osa Vohekin päivittäistä toimintaa. Huolehdit siitä, että tilaukset, toimitukset ja niihin liittyvä tieto kulkevat sujuvasti asiakkaiden, myynnin ja toimittajien välillä.

Keskeisiä tehtäviäsi ovat:

  • Asiakastilausten vastaanottaminen, käsittely ja kirjaaminen toiminnanohjausjärjestelmään

  • Tilausvahvistusten, toimitusaikojen ja saatavuustietojen seuranta sekä yhteydenpito asiakkaisiin ja toimittajiin

  • Tarjousten valmistelun tukeminen ja myynnin tilausten käsittely

  • Tuote- ja sähkönumeroiden sekä tuotetietojen ylläpito

  • Laskutuksen oikeellisuuden varmistaminen ja tilausten dokumentointi

  • Päivittäinen yhteistyö kotimaisten ja kansainvälisten yhteistyökumppaneiden kanssa

  • Tarvittaessa myynti- ja markkinointimateriaalien valmistelussa avustaminen

Työsi painottuu tilausten ja toimitusten hallintaan. Varsinainen kuljetusten järjestäminen ei ole tehtävän keskeinen osa, mutta osallistut tarvittaessa toimituksiin liittyvien käytännön asioiden selvittämiseen.

Tehtävässä on mahdollisuus kehittää toimintatapoja ja ottaa vähitellen lisää vastuuta osaamisesi ja kiinnostuksesi mukaan.

Millainen osaaja menestyy tehtävässä?

Etsimme henkilöä, jolle järjestelmällisyys, huolellisuus ja asioiden loppuun saattaminen ovat luonteva tapa työskennellä. Pystyt hallitsemaan useita samanaikaisia tehtäviä ja pidät huolen siitä, ettei mikään tärkeä jää kesken.

Toivomme sinulta:

  • Kokemusta tilausten käsittelystä, myynnin tuesta, toimitusten koordinoinnista tai vastaavista tehtävistä, mielellään teknisen kaupan, tukkukaupan tai teollisuuden parista

  • Erinomaista järjestelmällisyyttä, tarkkuutta ja kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn

  • Hyviä tietoteknisiä valmiuksia ja kokemusta toiminnanohjausjärjestelmien käytöstä

  • Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa sekä hyvää englannin kielen suullista ja kirjallista osaamista

  • Hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja sekä palveluhenkistä asennetta

  • Kykyä ratkaista arjen tilanteita oma-aloitteisesti ja viedä asiat loppuun saakka

Erityiseksi eduksi katsomme ruotsin kielen taidon, sillä tehtävään kuuluu yhteydenpitoa ruotsalaisten yhteistyökumppaneiden kanssa mutta englanniksi onnistuu myös.

Lisäksi arvostamme kokemusta Monitor G5 -toiminnanohjausjärjestelmästä, sähköteknisten tuotteiden tai sähkönumeroiden tuntemusta sekä kiinnostusta myynnin ja markkinoinnin tukitehtäviin.

Kaikkea ei tarvitse osata valmiiksi. Tärkeintä on, että sinulla on kokemusta vastaavanlaisesta työstä, vahva ote asioiden organisointiin ja halu oppia uutta.

Mitä Vohek tarjoaa sinulle?

Tarjoamme sinulle itsenäisen ja monipuolisen tehtävän, jossa pääset aidosti vaikuttamaan päivittäisen toiminnan sujuvuuteen.

Saat:

  • Vastuullisen ja vaihtelevan työn teknisen kaupan parissa

  • Mahdollisuuden tehdä yhteistyötä kansainvälisessä toimintaympäristössä

  • Pienen organisaation mutkattoman työilmapiirin ja läheisen yhteistyön kollegoiden kanssa

  • Mahdollisuuden kehittää omia toimintatapojasi ja kasvattaa vastuutasi

  • Päivittäistä yhteistyötä kansainvälisten kumppaneiden kanssa osana pohjoismaista United Power -ryhmää

  • Joustavan työajan noin klo 8–17 välillä

  • Oman toimistohuonen Liedon toimistolla ja hyvät pysäköintimahdollisuudet

  • Työsuhde on vakituinen, ja kuukausipalkka on noin 3 000–3 500 euroa kokemuksestasi ja osaamisestasi riippuen.

Työskentely tapahtuu aluksi pääsääntöisesti toimistolla, jotta pääset hyvin sisään tehtävään, tuotteisiin ja toimintatapoihin. Mahdollisuutta osittaiseen etätyöhön voidaan tarkastella myöhemmin.

Vohek Oy – teknisiä ratkaisuja ammattilaisille

Vohek Oy toimii sähköteknisten tuotteiden ja ratkaisujen parissa palvellen alan ammattilaisia ja yritysasiakkaita. Toimintaamme kuuluvat muun muassa sähkökeskuksiin liittyvät ratkaisut sekä teknisen kaupan tuotteet.

Olemme osa kansainvälistä United Power -yritysryhmää, jonka toiminta keskittyy sähkö-, valaistus- ja olosuhdehallinnan ratkaisuihin. Kansainvälinen toimintaympäristö tarjoaa mahdollisuuksia yhteistyöhön, osaamisen kehittämiseen ja liiketoiminnan kasvattamiseen. Sinulle se tarkoittaa vakaata taustaa, kansainvälistä työympäristöä sekä mahdollisuuksia kehittyä ja ottaa ajan myötä lisää vastuuta.

Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana, joten kannattaa olla yhteydessä mahdollisimman pian.
