title: Quality Integration & Improvement Engineer
description:
About the role:

At Dcubed, we are redefining the future of space exploration with innovative solar arrays and space mechanisms. As a Quality Integration & Improvement Engineer (f/m/d), you will be the guardian of reliability and quality, making sure our products perform flawlessly in the harshest environments.

From the lab all the way to orbit. In this role, you’ll shape quality standards, define and oversee quality processes, manage non-conformances, and drive process improvements across the full product lifecycle. You’ll collaborate closely with engineering, production, suppliers, Customer Success, and Sales to ensure that Dcubed products not only meet but exceed expectations.


Your impact: By safeguarding product quality, you will directly shape the trust our customers place in Dcubed and ensure the success of future space missions. Every improvement you drive will contribute to safer, more reliable, and more ambitious missions beyond Earth.

Responsibilities:

  • Integrated Management System (IMS): Support the maturation of the existing Quality Management System (QMS) into a comprehensive Integrated Management System (IMS), harmonizing processes, procedures, standards, and methodologies across the Actuators and Solar Array divisions in accordance with applicable ISO 9001 requirements.

  • ERP and MES Standardization: Drive the standardization and integration of ERP and Manufacturing Execution System (MES) processes across both product divisions, working closely with Engineering, Production, Supply Chain, and Quality Inspection to ensure consistent workflows, traceability, documentation, and quality data management.

  • Root Cause Analysis and Corrective Action (RCCA): Lead and facilitate cross-functional root cause investigations and corrective action activities using recognized methodologies such as 8D, 5 Whys, Ishikawa, and other structured problem-solving techniques. Ensure effective implementation, verification, and prevention of recurring quality issues.

  • Nonconformance Management: Support the creation, management, and resolution of Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), collaborating with Engineering, Production, Customer Solutions Engineering, and customers as appropriate. Monitor NCR trends, identify systemic issues, and drive continuous improvement through data-driven analysis and corrective actions.

  • Quality Training and Competency Development: Develop and deliver along with the Head of Quality, quality-related training and onboarding programs for new and existing employees, covering topics such as First Article Inspection (FAI), RCCA, Quality Management principles, nonconformance management, and applicable industry standards. Support the development of organizational quality competencies.

  • Inspection Standards and Methodologies: Collaborate with the Quality Inspection team to develop, improve, and standardize incoming, in-process, and final inspection procedures, methodologies, templates, and documentation. Work with Engineering to establish consistent inspection criteria and promote risk-based inspection approaches.

  • Quality Culture and Policy Deployment: Act as a key operational partner to the Head of Quality in implementing the organization's Quality Policy, strategic quality objectives, and continuous improvement initiatives. Champion a proactive quality culture emphasizing accountability, prevention, transparency, and shared responsibility for quality throughout the organization.

  • Cross-Functional and Customer Interface: Support the Head of Quality as a key Quality interface with Customer Solutions Engineering, supporting the effective communication and resolution of customer quality concerns, the translation of customer requirements into internal processes, and the coordination of quality-related activities across Engineering, Production, Supply Chain, and customer-facing functions.

  • Process Improvement and Risk Management: Identify and implement opportunities to improve operational efficiency, product conformity, and process reliability. Facilitate process risk assessments, support mitigation planning, and promote preventive quality practices throughout the product lifecycle.

  • Documentation, Reporting, and Performance Monitoring: Support the Head of Quality in establishing and maintaining standardized quality documentation, procedures, and reporting practices. Monitor quality performance indicators, analyze trends, communicate lessons learned, and provide actionable insights to support management decisions and continuous improvement.

Candidate requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

  • Minimum 3–5 years of experience in Quality Engineering, Quality Management Systems, Manufacturing Quality, Customer Complaint Management, or Continuous Improvement, preferably within aerospace, space, or another technically demanding manufacturing industry.

  • Practical knowledge of ISO 9001 Quality Management System requirements, including process management, documentation, internal auditing, and continuous improvement. Familiarity with EN 9100 and ECSS standards is an advantage.

  • Demonstrated experience developing, implementing, or improving quality management processes, procedures, and operational standards.

  • Experience with ERP and/or Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), including production workflows, traceability, quality records, and process standardization. Experience with Odoo is an advantage.

  • Practical experience conducting root cause investigations and implementing corrective actions using recognized methodologies such as 8D, 5 Whys, Ishikawa, or equivalent structured problem-solving techniques.

  • Knowledge of nonconformance management, corrective action effectiveness verification, and quality performance monitoring.

  • Familiarity with manufacturing inspection processes, First Article Inspection (FAI), technical drawings, and inspection documentation. Knowledge of AS/EN 9102 is an advantage.

  • Experience working with cross-functional teams to implement process improvements, standardize operational practices, and support organizational change.

  • Experience developing and delivering technical training, facilitating workshops, or supporting employee competency development is desirable.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, with the ability to analyze quality data and prepare clear technical documentation.

Personal attributes:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured, solution-oriented approach.

  • Proactive, hands-on mindset with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

  • Excellent interpersonal and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence others and drive organizational change.

  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize initiatives and work independently.

  • Detail-oriented, pragmatic, and committed to continuous improvement and fostering a positive quality culture.

  • Comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced startup environment, adapting to evolving requirements and organizational growth.

  • Collaborative, approachable, and capable of delivering constructive feedback while fostering a positive and proactive quality culture.

  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal; German language skills a plus.

  • Eligibility to work in Germany, and ability to travel up to 30% to support the site in USA, and customer and supplier visits as required.

  • Driver's license is a plus.

This position involves access to technology that is subject to U.S. and/or Germany export controls. Any job offer made will be contingent upon the applicant's capacity to serve in compliance with U.S. and/or Germany export controls.

Please note: Dcubed does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies and will not pay fees for any candidates we have not requested.

title: Counseling Administrator - Secondary
description:
Counseling Administrator - Secondary

Position Summary:

The District Counseling Administrator (Secondary) provides strategic oversight and mentorship to middle and high school counselors. This role ensures consistent implementation of college and career readiness programming, graduation pathway compliance, and the delivery of Tiered behavioral health interventions for adolescent students.

Essential Duties:

  1. Great Teaching & Learning (Instructional Infrastructure):
    • Provide specialized professional development to secondary counselors on ICAP (Individual Career Academic Plan) implementation, graduation requirements, and post-secondary planning.
    • Mentor site-level counselors in conflict resolution, academic scheduling strategies, and the integration of social-emotional learning into secondary classroom curricula.
    • Analyze district-wide outcome data to identify and address achievement, attendance, and opportunity gaps, ensuring equitable access to college and career readiness programming.
    • Assist in developing systems to track and monitor post-secondary success metrics, including FAFSA completion, concurrent enrollment, and graduation pathways.
    • Assist in developing and leading professional development to support counseling strategies and initiatives.
    • Support school counselors in utilizing data to drive student support strategies.
  2. Great People (Talent Management):
    • Coordinate counselor/teacher; counselor/parent; and any other scheduled conference or team meetings.
    • Ensures the support of District Counselors for District Counseling initiatives and compliance with tracking data.
    • Provide support for development of District and Site level comprehensive counseling frameworks and plans.
    • Assist in mentoring and supporting school counselors through monthly meetings designed to ensure the successful implementation of a school counseling program that aligns with American School Counselor Association (ASCA) standards. Facilitate monthly collaboration meetings with site counselors to promote consistency and continuous improvement.
    • Assist in monitoring state and national issues and trends related to mental health, academic, career, and social domains, and assist in providing professional development to educate staff.
    • Assist in providing individual training and onboarding support for newly assigned or hired counselors to ensure consistent processes across the district.
    • Coordinate with the Director of Mental Health to foster professional growth through training in trauma-informed practices, suicide prevention, and support for at-risk students.
    • Assist in providing updates to school sites regarding legislation related to graduation requirements or changes to Oklahoma Higher Learning Access Program (OK Promise).
  3. Great Culture (Systems Leaders):
    • Facilitate monthly collaborative meetings for secondary counselors to promote consistency in college counseling, trauma-informed crisis response, and suicide prevention planning.
    • Oversee the utilization of the student information system for scheduling and enrollment integrity. Ensure compliance with OK Promise, FAFSA, and career technology partnerships at the site level.
    • Ensure and monitor all School Counselors have the required structures in place to meet students Tier 1-3 MTSS needs, including completing master schedules and student schedules in time for appropriate service delivery.
    • Helps to plan, monitor and support Counselors to ensure parent/family outreach is targeted and successful.
    • Ensure follow-up with families who have not been contacted or reached, and implement strategies to strengthen family communication and engagement based on the data.
    • Strengthen collaboration with families, community organizations, and mental health providers.
    • Ensure consistent implementation of crisis intervention, suicide prevention, and postvention protocols.
    • Promote inclusive and transparent systems to support the holistic development of all students.
    • Represent OKCPS in local, state, and national forums to remain current in the fields of mental health, counseling, and career readiness.
    • Maintain high levels of communication with site leaders to ensure alignment with district goals and emerging needs.
  4. Great Systems (Support & Accountability):
    • Respond to inquiries and provide assistance to staff, students and the public; schedule counseling appointments; answer telephone calls and provide information and assistance to callers, visitors, staff and students.
    • Prepare all routine correspondence as requested by the guidance department and/or administration.
    • Support Counselors in communicating effectively with students and families regarding individualized academic plans, including strategies for getting students back on track and opportunities for gifted enrichment.
    • Oversee and support Counselors in maintaining and updating all office files (ex. credit checks) and a master calendar for guidance counselors.
    • Assist in developing systems for processing student grade report data and maintaining accurate student/staff schedules.
    • Assist counselors with the process of monitoring student grades and submitting grade change requests; notify teachers, counselors and parents of academic issues.
    • Assist in maintaining and updating all office files and a master calendar for guidance counselors and other coordinators.
    • Assist building administrators and guidance staff in processing forms, surveys, and other data as appropriate.
    • Perform other duties as assigned.

Job Specifications:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities required.

Minimum Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills and/or Abilities):

  • Master’s Degree in School Counseling, Educational Leadership, or a related field required.
  • Current Oklahoma School Counselor certification.
  • 3+ years of experience in elementary school counseling, educational administration, or related leadership roles.
  • Strong knowledge of elementary legislation and policies, elementary child development, SEL frameworks, MTSS/PBIS structures, and child protection policies.
  • Knowledge and experience working with computer hardware and software applications (Microsoft Office Suite) required.
  • Flexibility, initiative, and excellent organizational skills.

Physical/Mental Requirements:

  • Able to sit and/or stand for extended periods of time.
  • Exhibit manual dexterity to enter data into a computer.
  • Ability to see and read a computer screen and printed material with or without vision aids.
  • Hear and understand speech at normal classroom levels, outdoors and on the telephone.
  • Speak in audible tones so that others may understand clearly in normal classrooms, outdoors and on the telephone.
  • Physical agility, able to bend, stoop, sit on the floor, climb stairs, walk and reach.
  • Ability to lift, push, pull up to 25 pounds.

Work Environment:

  • Frequent use of personal vehicle for travel within and outside the district to meetings with community partners, advisory board meetings, trainings, outreach and engagement events, and other community-based meetings that are needed to ensure the success of the grant.
  • Office duties will be performed in a well-lighted, climate-controlled environment.
  • Will require time in office, as well as external meeting locations with community partners or schools throughout the OKC metro area.
  • Must maintain a consistent daily in-office presence during designated work hours and remain available to respond to school-site needs requiring in-person support.
  • Able to bend and stoop, lift 25lbs, stand and/or sit for extended periods of time.

Reports To: Director of Counseling

Compensation: 904 (Salary determined by experience.)

FTE: 1.0 (8 hours per day)

title: Case Manager
description:
Case Manager Career Opportunity

Recognized for your abilities as a Case Manager
Are you ready for a Case Management role that brings your career closer to home and heart? Join Encompass Health, where being a Case Manager goes beyond just a job; it positions you as a vital link between exceptional care and the transformative impact on each patient's journey. As the leading provider of rehabilitation care in the nation, this opportunity allows you to leverage your clinical expertise while contributing to the well-being of individuals in your community. Manage resources, coordinate patient care from admission to post-discharge, and oversee interdisciplinary plan-of-care decisions. This is more than a career move; it's a chance to shape a future where care and compassion converge for truly meaningful outcomes.


A Glimpse into Our World
At Encompass Health, you'll experience the difference the moment you become a part of our team. Working with us means aligning with a rapidly growing national inpatient rehabilitation leader. We take pride in the growth opportunities we offer and how our team unites for the greater good of our patients. Our achievements include being named one of the "World’s Most Admired Companies" and receiving the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® Award, among other accolades, which is nothing short of amazing.


Starting Perks and Benefits
At Encompass Health, we are committed to creating a supportive, inclusive, and caring environment where you can thrive. From day one, you will have access to:

  • Affordable medical, dental, and vision plans for both full-time and part-time employees and their families.
  • Generous paid time off that accrues over time.
  • Opportunities for tuition reimbursement and continuous education.
  • Company-matching 401(k) and employee stock purchase plans.
  • Flexible spending and health savings accounts.
  • A vibrant community of individuals passionate about the work they do!

Become the Case Manager you always wanted to be

  • Work with interdisciplinary team, guiding treatment plans based on patient needs and preferences.
  • Coordinate with interdisciplinary team to establish tentative discharge plan and contingency plans.
  • Participate in planning for and the execution of patient discharge experience.
  • Monitor patient experience: quality/timeliness/service appropriateness/payors/expectations.
  • Facilitate team conferences weekly and coordinate all treatment plan modifications.
  • Complete case management addendums and all required documentation.
  • Maintain knowledge of regulations/standards, company policies/procedures, and department operations.
  • Review/analyze case management reports, including Key Care Indicators, and plan appropriate actions.
  • Understand commercial contract levels, exclusions, payor requirements, and recertification needs.
  • Attend Acute Care Transfer (ACT) meetings to identify trends and collaboratively reduce ACTs.
  • Meet with patient/family per Patient Arrival and Initial Visit Standard within 24 hrs of admission.
  • Perform assessment of goals and complete case management addendum within 48 hours of admission.
  • Educate patient/family on rehabilitation and Case Manager role; establish communication plan.
  • Schedule and facilitate family conferences as needed.
  • Assist patient with timely procuring/planning of resources to avoid discharge delays or issues.
  • Monitor compliance with regulations for orthotics and prosthetics ordering and payment.
  • Make appropriate/timely referrals, including documentation to post discharge providers/physicians.
  • Ensure accuracy of discharge and payor-related information in the patient record.
  • Participate in utilization review process: data collection, trend review, and resolution actions.
  • Participate in case management on-call schedule as needed.

Qualifications

  • License or Certification:
    • Must be qualified to independently complete an assessment within the scope of practice of his/her discipline (for example, RN, SW, OT, PT, ST, and Rehabilitation Counseling).
    • If licensure is required for one’s discipline within the state, individual must hold an active license.
    • Must meet eligibility requirements for CCM® or ACM™ certification upon entry into this position OR within two years of entry into the position.
    • CCM® or ACM™ certification required OR must be obtained within two years of being placed in the Case Manager II position.
  • Minimum Qualifications:
    • For Nursing, must possess minimum of an Associate Degree in Nursing, RN licensure with BSN preferred. A diploma is acceptable only in those states whose minimum requirement for licensure or certification is a diploma rather than an Associate Degree.
    • For all other eligible licensed or certified health care professionals, must possess a minimum of a bachelor’s degree and graduate degree is preferred.
    • 2 years of rehabilitation experience preferred.

title: Sr. Data Scientist
description:
Who We Are


Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.


What We Offer


Salary:

$148,000.00 - $203,500.00

Location:

Austin,TX

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.

About the Role
We are seeking a forward‑thinking Data Scientist focused on operational optimization and intelligent automation. The ideal candidate will leverage machine learning, statistical modeling, and emerging agentic AI capabilities to transform complex data into actionable insights and autonomous workflows that drive measurable impact across business operations.

Responsibilities

  • Optimize operational workflows by designing and deploying ML models that improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, and support data‑driven decision-making across business units.
  • Develop autonomous, agentic AI systems that can proactively monitor processes, make recommendations, trigger actions, and continuously improve through feedback loops.
  • Interpret and analyze complex datasets using advanced statistical and machine learning techniques; communicate insights clearly to technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
  • Build scalable data collection and analytics pipelines that enhance data quality, statistical efficiency, and real-time decisioning.
  • Develop and validate custom ML models (supervised, unsupervised, time-series, causal inference, etc.) tailored to operational use cases.
  • Implement predictive and prescriptive models to address a wide range of business challenges in manufacturing, supply chain, customer operations, finance, and more.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to define new process automation and optimization opportunities driven by machine learning and intelligent agents.
  • Maintain and enhance internal data systems, ensuring ongoing data integrity, reliability, and governance.
  • Participate in code reviews, model reviews, and best‑practice development, contributing to a high-performance Data Science culture.


Requirements

  • Strong expertise in data modeling, database design, feature engineering, and data mining with large-scale structured and unstructured datasets.
  • Proficiency with SQL, statistical programming languages (Python, R) and experience building end-to-end ML workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with machine learning algorithms and frameworks, including clustering, decision trees, ensemble methods, deep learning, and reinforcement learning.
  • Familiarity with agentic AI frameworks, autonomous decision agents, and LLM-based workflow orchestration (e.g., tools, function-calling, planning agents).
  • Experience with Tableau or similar BI tools, enabling clear, actionable data storytelling.
  • Expertise in statistical techniques including regression, distribution properties, hypothesis testing, and experimental design.

Why Join Brookfield Renewable North America?

We offer unparalleled opportunity to lead and manage one of the largest renewable energy businesses with decades of history, while contributing to the global need for sustainable energy.

About the Role

The Director, Fund Finance will report to the Chief Financial Officer of Brookfield Renewable North America, and lead the Finance and Operations function for a Private Fund investing in utility-scale battery energy storage assets across North America. Responsibilities will include overseeing the ongoing finance, reporting and operational activities associated with Brookfield's role as investment manager. This is inclusive of financial reporting, valuation oversight, treasury, governance, regulatory compliance and service provider management. The role will also evaluate fund operations and recommend changes to ensure Brookfield's operating standards and scalable processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the finance and operations function for the Fund, overseeing all recurring manager-level finance and operational responsibilities
  • Lead the transition of finance and operational responsibilities from the seller to Brookfield, including knowledge transfer, process documentation and implementation of Brookfield operating standards.
  • Oversee quarterly and annual financial reporting, including coordination with external fund administrators, auditors and other service providers.
  • Lead the quarterly valuation process, including oversight of valuation models, third-party valuation specialists, historical valuation support and preparation of valuation materials for senior management.
  • Oversee treasury operations, including liquidity management, capital calls/ distribution events, cash forecasting and other fund-level capital activities.
  • Oversee preparation of supporting financial analyses, operating metrics and reporting deliverables supporting investor communications and ongoing fund reporting.
  • Ensure compliance with fund governing documents, side letter obligations, regulatory reporting requirements (including SFDR and Annex IV, as applicable) and internal governance standards.
  • Lead the annual audit process and coordinate tax reporting deliverables with external service providers.
  • Maintain oversight of the Fund's operating calendar, recurring deliverables and governance processes, including Board and manager approvals.
  • Manage relationships with external fund administrators, auditors, valuation specialists, tax advisors, legal counsel and other professional service providers.
  • Review and prepare analyses, presentations and recommendations for senior management supporting fund performance, business planning, budgeting, forecasting and strategic initiatives.
  • Drive continuous improvement across the Fund’s operating platform by enhancing reporting, strengthening internal controls and implementing scalable operating procedures.
  • Mentor and develop team members while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
  • Support ad hoc analyses, presentations and special projects relating to fund financial and operational performance.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • CPA or CA designation with 7–10 years of progressive experience in accounting, finance or fund operations, including 2–3 years of people leadership experience.
  • Experience within private funds, infrastructure, renewable energy or asset management environments is preferred.
  • Strong understanding of fund accounting, financial reporting, valuations, treasury and fund operations.
  • Experience managing relationships with external fund administrators, auditors and other professional service providers.
  • Strong financial systems experience, including advanced Excel skills.
  • Highly analytical with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Demonstrated leadership ability with a collaborative, proactive and solutions-oriented approach.
  • Experience leading complex projects involving multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to thrive in a dynamic, entrepreneurial and fast-paced environment while managing changing priorities and deadlines.
  • Strategic thinker with a focus on continuous improvement, scalable processes and operational excellence.
  • Self-motivated with a strong sense of ownership and accountability for both business results and professional development.

Starting at $195,000 with final compensation commensurate with the successful candidate’s experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role.

title: Senior Manager – Integrated Planning Intelligence
location: Boise, Idaho, United States of America
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

Micron is engaged in a multi-year, extensive overhaul of its planning process: from long-range targets down to supply commits and order promising. We're looking for a Senior Manager who works at the crossroads of three areas: Coordinated Business Planning, Planning Platforms and Integration, and AI. This outstanding opportunity will allow you to make a significant impact on our planning processes, ensuring they are connected, speedier, and steadily more autonomous!


Responsibilities:


  • Build the E2E Planning Transformation: Define the future-state IBP process, including demand, supply, and financial reviews. Specify how targets, demand, and commitments flow from segment to business unit and product. Develop a sequenced capability roadmap and address gaps before they threaten the launch.
  • Lead the Planning Integration and Data efforts: Make certain SAP, Kinaxis, Blue Yonder, and Snowflake operate as a cohesive planning system, addressing problems like hierarchy mismatches, master data inconsistencies, and plan versions. Ensure every project uses managed data products with assigned decision and data owners.
  • Lead planning efforts to apply AI for process improvement. Own the 12–24 month roadmap for planning automation, augmentation, or acceleration with AI. Take use cases from PoC to production. Decide when to build or use vendor AI like Kinaxis Maestro, SAP Joule, or Blue Yonder. Measure success by forecast accuracy, plan stability, cycle time, inventory, and manual effort.
  • Keep Pace with AI: Maintain an AI technology radar, run fast experiments, and set governance for evaluation, explainability, and cost.
  • Partner with Executives and Lead Change: Be the primary link between Supply Chain leadership, Business Unit's leaders, IT Enterprise AI, and EPS, and present results as business outcomes. Drive adoption with users worldwide by building trust in AI-assisted decisions.
  • Build the Team: Lead a hybrid group of Industry Analysts, Data Scientists, and Solution Architects, and earn the trust of an EPS team with deep SAP, Kinaxis, and Blue Yonder expertise. Encourage a culture where every initiative owns its business metric, applying Agile delivery.

Minimum Qualifications:


  • Over 12 years of expertise in supply chain planning, planning systems, or planning transformation, including more than 5 years managing teams (technical or combined business/technical).
  • Comprehensive, hands-on IBP / S&OP / Master Planning knowledge. You have established, handled, or supported a monthly IBP cycle. You can explain demand and supply coordination, constrained against unconstrained planning, allocation, and order scheduling (ATP/CTP) effectively.
  • Led the implementation or major evolution of at least one advanced planning platform, such as Kinaxis, SAP IBP/APO, Blue Yonder, o9, or an equivalent. This included integrating it with ERP and enterprise data platforms.
  • Proven delivery of analytics, ML, or GenAI into production planning use, with measurable business outcomes.
  • Working proficiency in modern AI: LLMs, agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation, and model/agent evaluation. You should know enough to challenge architects and data scientists on build choices.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Supply Chain, Engineering, Computer Science, Operations Research, or a related area. Candidates with an advanced degree (MS/MBA) will be considered favorably.

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Semiconductor or high-tech planning experience: long lead times, multi-echelon supply, die/bin/product hierarchies, allocation under constraint.
  • Experience in multi-platform planning landscapes (two or more planning tools coexisting).
  • Familiarity with Snowflake, semantic layers, and data-product operating models.
  • Hands-on exposure to enterprise AI tooling: LLM platforms, Microsoft Copilot, agent frameworks, and tool-interoperability standards.

title: Intermediate Embedded Software Engineer
description:
At MITRE, your passion fuels work that impacts our nation and improves lives. This is where your skills strengthen national security, cybersecurity, health, transportation, and citizen services. We’re a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future.

We specialize in rapid prototyping of advanced sensor, communication and navigation systems on real-time embedded platforms. As an applied research organization, we focus on capability development and demonstration while remaining decoupled from protracted product lifecycles and system support roles. Our world class labs provide a canvas for our team to conduct hands-on research and develop tangible solutions to support our military leaders and reinforce our nation’s defense. As part of our team, you will have the opportunity to design and implement technical solutions for a wide range of challenges currently faced by our government sponsors.

Roles & Responsibilities:

This position provides an exciting opportunity to design and prototype state of the art embedded systems using commercial and custom platforms. Key opportunities include:

  • Working on cross-disciplinary teams of similarly bright and motivated engineers on projects of national importance
  • Real-time communication and sensor systems leveraging state of the art processors, FPGA & SoC technology and cutting-edge SDR platforms
  • Advanced architectures for high throughput signal processing
  • Low size, weight, power and cost (SWaP-C), highly integrated custom platforms
  • A supportive culture of learning, professional growth, and development
  • Opportunities to build on skills and work on a diverse range of projects
  • Outstanding continuing education programs

  • Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or related AND a minimum of 2 years of related experience; or an advanced degree with relevant experience who can immediately contribute at this job step; or equivalent combination of related education and work experience.
  • High level of proficiency in C and/or C++ programming languages.
  • Very familiar with good software development practices, including: approaches to design, implementation, testing, documentation, and debugging.
  • Very good understanding of embedded systems and hardware/software interaction.
  • Intermediate knowledge of low-level processor architectures, operating system concepts, and hardware interfacing.
  • Applicants selected for this position will be subject to a US government security investigation and must be able to obtain and maintain a Department of Defense SECRET clearance, which requires US citizenship
  • In addition, candidates must meet requirements to support project work onsite in our labs and classified facilities on the Bedford Campus
  • This position requires a minimum of 4 days a week on-site at our Bedford, MA facility.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • M.S. in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or similar field
  • Active Secret Clearance
  • Experience with object-oriented programming principles and working knowledge of one or more higher-level languages such as Python, MATLAB, or Perl.

  • Understanding of common software development tools (e.g., Git, Make, CMake).
  • Experience with development best practices including code reviews, regression testing, and user documentation.
  • Experience with real-time operating systems, POSIX, embedded Linux (user- and kernel-space development).
  • Experience with low-level hardware/software system debugging.
  • Good foundation of basic digital signal processing (DSP) concepts and experience implementing real-time algorithms for communication, radar, or navigation systems.
  • Familiarity with networking protocols (wired and wireless)
  • Basic knowledge of one or more hardware description languages (HDLs) such as VHDL, Verilog, or System Verilog

title: Electrical Engineering Student – Buildings (Summer 2027) - 4-12 Term
description:
Learning begins in the classroom but there’s no better place to gain real-world experience than with Stantec. Interns are an integral part of our teams, working to solve some of the world's most complex challenges.

As an intern, you’ll work alongside our experienced practitioners and with our clients and communities. This hands-on experience will equip you with practical skills, build your network, and provide opportunities that set you up for success.

Your Opportunity

The buildings that make up the landscape of our daily lives seem like permanent fixtures, fastened to a time and place. But what if that didn’t have to be true? What if our built environment — where we live, learn, play, and conduct business — carried us forward instead?

Our Buildings practice keeps people at its heart, recognizing that our shared journey forward is shaped by the meaningful and responsive places we design. From iconic designs to monumental groundbreakings, join us to bring transformational building solutions to life. Every day we apply our expertise, creativity, and passion to propel communities into the future—join us!

We are currently seeking an Electrical Engineering Student for our Yellowknife or Whitehorse office. This opportunity is open to students available for a 4 to 12 month term.

Your Key Responsibilities

The successful candidate should have basic knowledge of the Canadian Electrical Safety Code, understanding of building electrical equipment and systems including normal and life safety power systems, communication systems and lighting systems.

Specific duties will include:

  • Preparation of CAD and Revit drawings from sketches or mark-ups for buildings and non-buildings related projects
  • Load calculations, voltage drop, and short circuit calculations
  • Production of layout drawings for tender, construction, and record drawings
  • Preparations of single line diagrams and control schematics
  • Completion of photometric lighting calculations
  • Support of Project coordination, management, and working in a team-based environment
  • Assistance to engineers and project managers in:
  • Completion of motor, communications, security, and lighting schedules
  • The selection of electrical equipment, overcurrent protection devices, and wiring methods
  • Preparation of technical reports
  • Project coordination including interfacing with clients and contractors

Your Capabilities and Credentials

  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills
  • Detail oriented team player who has the ability to work independently
  • Demonstrated organization and planning skills and has an ability to work within tight deadlines
  • Power related courses and previous consulting experience and knowledge would be considered an asset
  • A working knowledge of AutoCAD, REVIT, and/or lighting software would be considered an asset

Education and Experience

  • Working toward an Electrical Engineering Technology Diploma or Bachelor’s degree of Electrical Engineering or similar.

Typical office environment working with computers and remaining sedentary for long periods of time. Field work may include exposure to the elements including inclement weather.

This description is not a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that may be required of the employee and other duties, responsibilities and activities may be assigned or may be changed at any time with or without notice.

About Stantec

Stantec is a global leader in sustainable engineering, architecture, and environmental consulting. The diverse perspectives of our partners and interested parties drive us to think beyond what’s previously been done on critical issues like climate change, digital transformation, and future-proofing our cities and infrastructure. We innovate at the intersection of community, creativity, and client relationships to advance communities everywhere, so that together we can redefine what’s possible.

title: ICU PCT PRN Days
description:
Job Summary

The Patient Care Technician (PCT) provides high-quality, patient-centered care by performing delegated tasks in alignment with the PCT's training and the department's needs. Under the direct supervision of a Registered Nurse (RN) or Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) (LVN at Texas facilities), the PCT supports patient care by assisting with activities of daily living, maintaining a safe and organized care environment, and ensuring effective communication within the healthcare team.

Essential Functions

  • Assists nursing staff in delivering care, performing delegated basic patient care services, and ensuring a clean, safe, and well-organized environment.
  • Collects and records patient data, including vital signs, height, weight, oxygen saturation, intake/output, and calorie counts, reporting findings to the RN/LPN/LVN.
  • Supports patients with meals, feeding, bathing, oral care, grooming, linen changes, skin care, elimination assistance, and urinary catheter care.
  • Assists with patient positioning, repositioning, dangling, ambulating, and using mobility aids such as walkers, crutches, canes, and wheelchairs.
  • Collects urine and stool samples and performs blood glucose monitoring via finger sticks, documenting and reporting results to the RN/LPN/LVN.
  • Communicates patient information effectively to the care team, adapts to change, and maintains professionalism in all interactions.
  • Maintains a clean, neat, and safe environment for patients and staff, adhering to infection control and safety protocols, including appropriate use of personal protective equipment (PPE).
  • Participates in performance improvement initiatives, risk management reporting, and compliance with National Patient Safety Goals and Core Measures.
  • May be required to maintain continuous visual observation of the patient and remains with them at all times unless relieved by appropriate personnel.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Maintains regular and reliable attendance.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.

Qualifications

  • 0-2 years of experience in an acute care setting or currently enrolled in a Nursing program preferred

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Basic knowledge of patient care practices and equipment.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions and work collaboratively within a team.
  • Commitment to maintaining patient confidentiality and adhering to safety protocols.

Licenses and Certifications

  • BCLS - Basic Life Support within 90 days of hire required
  • CNA - Certified Nursing Assistant preferred or
  • Certified Patient Care Technician (CPCT) preferred

title: Quality Improvement Program Manager
description:
This position serves as a champion for Continuous Quality Improvement (CQI) and promotes a culture of quality, patient safety, equity, and health literacy throughout the organization. The QI Program Manager uses data and performance metrics to identify opportunities for improvement, coordinates quality improvement projects, and supports organizational goals related to clinical quality, regulatory requirements, value-based care, and patient-centered care.

The QI Program Manager also provides leadership for health literacy initiatives, including management of the Materials Review Committee and integration of health literacy best practices into organizational processes, patient communications, workflows, and service delivery models.


ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

  • Building collaborative relationships with interdisciplinary teams and stakeholders.
  • Facilitating meetings, trainings, and quality improvement initiatives.
  • Managing multiple projects and action plans simultaneously.
  • Analyzing and interpreting quality and performance data.
  • Presenting information to leadership, staff, and external partners.
  • Developing and implementing quality improvement strategies and interventions.
  • Supporting organizational compliance, reporting, and accreditation activities.
  • Promoting health literacy, patient engagement, and equitable access to care.

MAJOR AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY

Quality Improvement Leadership

  • Collaborate with the Director of Quality, Chief Medical Officer and operational leaders to develop, implement and evaluate quality improvement initiatives that improve clinical outcomes, patient experience and operational performance.
  • Serve as an organizational champion for Continuous Quality Improvement (CQI) principles, methodologies, and tools.
  • Develop and maintain frameworks for measuring, monitoring, and improving quality across all service lines.
  • Serve as project manager on quality improvement projects from planning through implementation, evaluation, and sustainability.
  • Facilitate root cause analysis, process mapping, workflow redesign, and corrective action planning.
  • Educate and coach staff on quality improvement concepts, performance measures, and best practices.

Clinical Quality and Value -Based Care

  • Partner with providers and operational leaders to improve performance on clinical quality indicators and population health outcomes.
  • Support organizational participation in value-based care arrangements and quality incentive programs by monitoring performance, identifying improvement opportunities, and implementing targeted interventions.
  • Develop action plans to improve quality outcomes, close care gaps, and support achievement of performance-based reimbursement goals.
  • Collaborate with clinical teams to optimize workflows, documentation, coding practices, and care management strategies that support quality reporting and patient outcomes.

Data Analytics and Performance Monitoring

  • Monitor quality improvement outcomes and evaluate the effectiveness of interventions.
  • Conduct audits and workflow assessments to identify trends, barriers, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Prepare and present quality reports, dashboards, and recommendations to leadership and operational teams.
  • Use data to drive decision-making and prioritize improvement efforts across the organization.
  • Collaborate with clinical and operational teams to design and implement EHR workflows that support accurate documentation, coding, quality reporting, and patient care.
  • Identify opportunities to improve data capture and reporting capabilities.

Health Literacy Leadership

  • Manage and facilitate the Materials Review Committee, ensuring patient-facing materials use health literacy best practices.
  • Promote integration of health literacy principles into workflows, policies, procedures, patient education materials, and communication practices.
  • Collaborate with clinical, operational, and program staff to identify opportunities to improve patient understanding, engagement, access, and self-management.

title: Packaging Team Lead - 2nd Shift
description:
Position Summary

The Packaging Team Lead is responsible for coordinating and leading daily activities on the pharmaceutical packaging floor to ensure efficient, safe, and compliant operations. This role includes planning, scheduling, overseeing equipment setup and operation, and providing guidance and training to packaging team members.

The Packaging Team Lead also steps into a supervisory capacity in the absence of the Packaging Supervisor and plays a critical role in maintaining packaging productivity, quality, and adherence to current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) and safety standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist in managing labor and material resources to meet packaging schedules.

  • Train employees, troubleshoot operational issues, and ensure compliance with standard operating procedures (SOPs) and batch record documentation requirements.

  • Collaborate with Quality, Engineering, and Validation teams to ensure product packaging meets specifications and regulatory requirements.

  • Operate and oversee packaging equipment, which may include blister packers, bottle fillers, labelers, cartoners, and serialization systems.

  • Coordinate workflow across packaging lines to optimize efficiency and minimize downtime.

  • Perform other duties as assigned or requested.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent.

  • 5+ years of experience in a manufacturing or packaging environment.

  • Strong understanding of pharmaceutical packaging operations and cGMP requirements.

  • Ability to lead, train, and mentor team members.

  • Strong attention to detail and documentation practices.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Ability to follow and execute complex instructions accurately.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience in the pharmaceutical or another regulated industry.

Core and Functional Competencies

  • Leadership, communication, teamwork, integrity, continuous learning, decision making, safety focus, strategic thinking, and customer service orientation.

  • cGMP compliance, planning and organizing, problem solving, quality standards, and documentation accuracy.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • Lead team members performing similar packaging duties.

  • Provide day-to-day guidance and support.

  • Train new employees and monitor their progress.

  • Serve as backup to the Packaging Supervisor.

Work Environment and Physical Requirements

  • Ability to lift up to 40 lbs.

  • Good hand-eye coordination and manual dexterity.

title: Aneo Retail - Tech lead/Senior Utvikler
description:
Aneo Retail bygger en ledende nordisk plattform for Energy-as-a-Service til dagligvarehandelen. Vi finansierer, leverer og drifter kundenes tekniske infrastruktur, slik at butikkene kan modernisere og redusere energibruken uten store investeringer på egen hånd. Med Danfoss, HitecVision og TrønderEnergi i ryggen og White Summit Capital som ny strategisk partner, får selskapet tilgang til opptil €100 millioner i langsiktig kapital som skal gjøre det mulig å investere i flere kundeprosjekter og øke veksttakten betydelig. Ambisjonen er stor: å skalere virksomheten i Norden og over tid bygge en ledende europeisk plattform innen Energy-as-a-Service.

Aneo Retail søker en Tech Lead / Seniorutvikler til vårt team på Gjøvik eller i Oslo. Vi hjelper dagligvarebransjen i Norden med energieffektivisering, overvåkning og rådgivning. Nå ser vi etter deg som vil videreutvikle våre digitale løsninger og interne systemer for energiovervåkning og driftsstøtte.

Hos oss får du stor teknologisk påvirkningskraft, frihet til å forme løsninger og mulighet til å sette retning for videre utvikling. Du jobber produktorientert og smidig med systemer som brukes hver dag – og som har direkte betydning for drift og kundeleveranser.

Løsningene er allerede etablert i Norge og Sverige, og nå står Danmark for tur. Du får dermed en sentral rolle i å utvikle teknologien som skal understøtte vår videre vekst i Norden.

Sentrale arbeidsoppgaver og ansvar:

  • Utvikle nye tjenester og videreutvikle eksisterende løsninger.

  • Sikre høy oppetid, stabilitet og ytelse i virksomhetskritiske systemer.

  • Ha ansvar for testing, monitorering og skalering av løsningene.

  • Bidra til å sette teknisk retning og ta beslutninger om arkitektur og teknologivalg.

  • Sikre god kodekvalitet, struktur og løsninger som er enkle å vedlikeholde og videreutvikle.

  • Følge opp tekniske leveranser fra både interne og innleide utviklere.

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Har høyere utdanning innen IT, teknologi eller tilsvarende relevant erfaring.

  • Har minimum fem års relevant arbeidserfaring innen systemutvikling.

  • Kommuniserer godt på norsk, både muntlig og skriftlig.

  • Har god forståelse for verdien av effektive utviklingsprosesser, CI/CD-pipelines og automatisering.

  • Trives med å samarbeide med innleide utviklere og bidra til god onboarding, fremdrift og produktivitet.

Det er en fordel om du har bred teknologisk interesse og trives med å jobbe på tvers av hele teknologistacken. Du trenger ikke være ekspert på alt, men bør ha evnen og interessen til å forstå sammenhengene mellom de ulike delene av løsningene.

Teknologi hos oss:

Hos oss vil du videreutvikle eksisterende løsninger og utvikle nye tjenester. Teknologistacken består blant annet av:

  • Backend: PHP/Laravel i eksisterende applikasjoner og C# for nye tjenester.

  • Frontend: React og TypeScript for nye løsninger, Laravel Livewire for eksisterende løsninger og R/Shiny for dagens EOS-frontend.

  • Infrastruktur: Azure, primært containere, med Terraform for infrastrukturforvaltning.

  • Datainnhenting: Python-jobber for innhenting av værdata til EOS.

  • Databaser og lagring: PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Azure Storage Account og S3.

  • Verktøy: Tailwind, GitHub Actions, Auth0 og Sentry.

Vi har også et eksisterende AWS-miljø så erfaring med AWS er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Vi tilbyr:

  • En rolle der kompetansen din blir verdsatt, og arbeidet ditt får direkte betydning for hverdagen til mange i Aneo Retail

  • Valg mellom nye kontorlokaler sentralt på Gjøvik og kontoret vårt i Oslo

  • Mulighet for hjemmekontor når det passer

  • God opplæring så du ikke trenger å være "ekspert" på alt

  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser

Ta gjerne kontakt med Bjørn Waagø på 900 96 668 eller Anette Larsen på 924 01 478 for en uforpliktende prat om stillingen. Du kan også kontakte Christian Kolderup i Aneo Retail på tlf: 93 24 90 00

Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg!

No prior landscape architecture experience is required.

Language: English, required.

title: Environmental Specialist
description:
Who We Are

CoVolt Power is a leading utility-scale EPC (Engineering, Procurement & Construction) company specializing in the design and delivery of solar, battery energy storage (BESS), and high-voltage infrastructure. Since its founding in 2005, the company has built a reputation for de-risking project delivery and providing creative, integrated solutions that span the power and digital infrastructure sectors.

Consistently ranked as a top-tier EPC, CoVolt Power leverages a mission-driven approach to safety and quality, delivering thousands of megawatts in renewable assets that support a more resilient and sustainable energy future for developers, utilities, independent power producers (IPPs), and data center operators across North America.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Environmental Specialist I will work under the guidance of the Safety Manager to ensure environmental compliance throughout both pre-construction and construction phases of various projects. In this role, you will support the Safety Manager and Senior Safety Manager in developing and implementing policies and programs, while collaborating with Field Engineers to maintain compliance.
The primary focus of this position is to assist with design, permitting, estimating, procurement and planning during the pre-construction phase, while also ensuring adherence to environmental regulations during construction and project closeout. Key responsibilities include implementing the Stormwater Pollution Prevention Plan (SWPPP), Spill Prevention Control and Countermeasure Plan (SPCC), and other permitting requirements related to biological and cultural resources.

This role demands strong communication skills and the ability to build effective relationships with a diverse range of stakeholders, including business development teams, client representatives, Engineers of record, as well as teams in design, estimating, procurement, and construction.

PRIMARY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

The Environmental Specialist will support the environmental aspects of multiple solar, battery energy storage system projects, ensuring compliance with federal, state, and local regulations during the pre-construction and construction phases. The primary focus of this role includes environmental compliance, conducting due diligence, and identifying and addressing buildable area constraints.

Typical responsibilities include:

  • Review environmental due diligence documentation and collaborate with engineers to identify and address environmental constraints.
  • Provide estimating and engineering teams with essential environmental data related to buildable areas, cost estimates, and project schedules.
  • Participate in civil construction plan reviews (30%, 60%, 90%, IFC) by reviewing design plans and providing construction feedback.
  • Review and redline construction plans and environmental compliance plans provided by the Engineer of Record to ensure compliance with federal, state, and local environmental regulations and permitting requirements.
  • Develop training for each project prior to mobilization.
  • Assist the permitting team in meeting federal, state, and local environmental regulations and permitting requirements including fuel, air, waste and recycling.
  • Provide environmental guidance and support to project site teams both prior to mobilization and throughout the construction phase by conducting site audits, assisting in implementing corrective actions, and collaborating with project owner and/or regulator regarding compliance efforts.
  • Strengthen client relationships and enhance the company’s reputation through proactive environmental initiatives.
  • Support continuous improvement and maintain quality control in environmental compliance and excellence within the organization.
  • Participate in meetings and correspondence with clients and the Engineer of Record to provide environmental support.
  • Undertake additional tasks and training as assigned by the Safety Manager or Engineering Manager.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, or related field
  • A minimum of 5 years of progressive experience in environmental roles.
  • Prior experience or certifications in stormwater management, such as CESSWI, QSP or the ability to obtain them.
  • Training in environmental regulations and programs, including National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA), Water of the United States (WOTUS), Clean Water Act (CWA), and National Pollutant Discharge Elimination System (NPDES)
  • Valid driver’s license with a clean motor vehicle driving record (MVR).



REQUIRED SKILLS/ABILITIES:

  • Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to present information effectively to small groups of internal and external stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication skills (oral, written, listening, and presentation) to collaborate effectively with employees, subcontractors and clients.
  • Proficient computer skills, with the ability to quickly learn and efficiently use relevant software, including Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook).
  • Familiarity with Computer Aided Design (CAD) or the ability to quickly acquire the necessary skills.
  • Strong organizational skills, including the ability to schedule, plan, and prioritize tasks effectively.
  • Intermediate knowledge of construction drawings, including layout, references, notes, details and best practices for producing and interpreting drawings.
  • Commitment to following safety protocols and understanding the intent behind safety rules, ensuring adherence without compromising safety standards.

title: Senior Defence Systems Engineering Specialist
description:
Telesat (Nasdaq and TSX: TSAT) is a leading global satellite operator, providing reliable and secure satellite-delivered communications solutions worldwide to broadcast, telecommunications, corporate and government customers for over 55 years. Backed by a legacy of engineering excellence, reliability and industry-leading customer service, Telesat has grown to be one of the largest and most successful global satellite operators.

Telesat Lightspeed, our revolutionary Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite network, scheduled to begin service in 2027, will revolutionize global broadband connectivity for enterprise and Government users by delivering a combination of high capacity, security, resiliency and affordability with ultra-low latency and fiber-like speeds. Telesat is headquartered in Ottawa, Canada, and has offices and facilities around the world.

The company’s state-of-the-art Satellite fleet consists of 12 GEO satellites, the Canadian payload on ViaSat-1 and one LEO 3 demonstration satellite. For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit


Are you passionate about breakthrough technologies and eager to shape the future of satellite-based solutions for defence and national security?

We are seeking a Senior Defence Systems Engineering Specialist to help shape new satellite-enabled capabilities for Canadian and allied defence users. Reporting to the Director, Research & Development, Defence Satellite Mission Solutions, you will lead multidisciplinary investigations from mission-need qualification through initial prototype laboratory validation.

Initial opportunities include system features such as alternative positioning, navigation and timing (PNT), optical relay connectivity with other satellite systems, and space-domain awareness data products. You will combine technical depth with systems thinking, practical experimentation and multidisciplinary leadership.

Main Responsibilities

  • Work with Sales and Product teams with potential customers to translate operational needs into mission scenarios, concepts of operation, measurable effectiveness objectives, requirements and acceptance criteria. Establish the current performance baseline, desired benefit, starting maturity, assumptions and investigation scope.
  • Evaluate candidate approaches, suppliers and opportunities to reuse, buy, partner or develop. Define system boundaries, the functions allocated to each component, interfaces, data flows and quantitative performance budgets. Compare expected benefits, integration constraints and resource needs; identify the critical uncertainties that determine feasibility.
  • Integrate security, resilience and mission-assurance requirements into architecture and verification. Assess effects on Lightspeed capacity, coverage, availability, timing, power, spectrum, interference and operations, working with the relevant specialists and product authorities.
  • Develop and apply computer models and simulations to assess system performance and technical feasibility and lead targeted proof-of-concept experiments. Define hypotheses, compare measured results with predictions and quantify uncertainty and residual risk. Undertake hands-on analysis and testing within your expertise and direct specialist contributions where needed.
  • Lead laboratory integration with hardware, software and test teams. Define supporting elements, control implementation versions, and maintain requirements-to-test traceability. Establish repeatable procedures and obtain agreement on the test envelope and pass/fail criteria before execution.
  • Lead laboratory validation of performance, security and resilience within the agreed envelope. Assess repeatability, correlate models with results, resolve or disposition anomalies, and document limitations. Substantiate technology maturity claims and make recommendations whether to proceed, rework, hold or stop an investigation.
  • Lead technical reviews, mentor engineers and coordinate technical work with Engineering, Product management, Sales and Operations. Support Telesat’s customer and supplier engagements as a technical subject-matter expert.

Education and Experience Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Physics, Computer Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience. An advanced degree is an asset.
  • Substantial systems engineering experience, typically 15+ years, including architecture ownership and multidisciplinary technical leadership. Equivalent experience demonstrating comparable scope and outcomes for this role will be considered.
  • Experience in satellite systems, defence communications, aerospace, wireless, secure networking or comparable integrated systems, with depth in one relevant domain.
  • Demonstrated experience translating operational needs and security/resilience constraints into requirements, architecture trade-offs and measurable validation objectives, working with customers and engineering teams.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and applying computer models and simulations, conducting experimental investigations and performing laboratory validation, including interpretation of measurements and management of technical risk.

Specialized Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Sound engineering judgment, curiosity and the ability to structure ambiguous problems, challenge assumptions and distinguish evidence from estimates.
  • Strong systems thinking and communications or networking fundamentals, with the ability to learn unfamiliar technologies.
  • Proficiency with analysis, modelling and test tools, such as Python, MATLAB or comparable platforms.
  • Experience leveraging AI in support of engineering activities.
  • Clear written and oral communication and technical facilitation skills, including the ability to explain complex findings to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience in one or more of PNT/timing, optical communications, RF systems, satellite networking, space-domain awareness, sensor processing or AI-enabled analysis is an asset. Defence/government programs and model-based systems engineering are additional assets.
  • Fluent in English, written and oral. French is an asset.

Equipment Used

  • Windows and Linux computers and laboratory instrumentation appropriate to each investigation.

Decision Making and Supervision

  • In this role, the incumbent owns technical evidence and recommendations and will have influence on the Lightspeed system design.
  • This role has no direct reports.

The successful candidate must be eligible to work in Canada, meet applicable Canadian Controlled Goods Program screening requirements, and due to the sensitive nature of the work be able to obtain and maintain NATO Secret security clearance.

description:

Job Description

Job Title: Logistics & Shipping Clerk I


Benefits:

Position Summary: The Logistics & Shipping Clerk I is responsible for outbound shipping activities of the company. They assist in quoting, negotiating, and arranging freight shipments including heavy haul loads as well as coordinate regular warehouse shipping functions including small parcel and LTL.


Work Schedule: Monday - Friday 6:00 am - 3:30 pm (every other Friday off)


Essential Duties. Other duties may be assigned

Logistics & Shipping

  • Responsible for shipping all materials out of IE. Prepare all material to be shipped by packing, wrapping, and assuring that material is protected for transport. Prepare all shipping documents for shipping.
  • Verify the correctness of outbound shipments against bills of lading, packing slip(s), invoices, manifests, etc.
  • Ensure that proper documentation is prepared, accurately processed, distributed, and released to carriers, forwarders, customers, and agents in a timely manner.
  • Understand basic Incoterms and their impact on the freight process.
  • Audit/correct carrier freight invoices and BOL's as necessary for payment.
  • Handle claims with freight companies and vendors, and let all appropriate parties know as soon as they become aware of damage to an IE shipment.
  • Convey part transfers as requested to any IE facilities and locations taking into account economics and need. Supplier Management
  • Assist in negotiating shipping costs and contracts with potential carriers
  • Schedule/coordinate shipments
  • Maintain customer profiles/carrier database to ensure all contact information is accurate and up to date.
  • Collect, analyze, and input data from customers for accurate load booking, i.e. pricing, on-time deliveries, customer recommendations, etc.
  • Obtain certificate(s) of insurance from carriers – ensure insurance limits meet or exceed load value

Professional Communication

  • Coordinate outbound shipping activities with production, sales, purchasing, or any other IE relevant parties. Including notification of when to expect cranes, police escorts, or pilot cars, as well as areas or lanes that need to be cleared in order to facilitate the movement of large loads.
  • Verify with customers that their delivery requirements are being met, as well as that they are prepared to receive shipment.
  • Assist in resolving customer issues related to freight transportation and communicate to PM’s any changes or updates as needed.
  • Monitor shipments up to the point of delivery. Notify the appropriate Project Manager, Sales Rep, etc. of any delays or shipment issues throughout the shipping process.
  • Execute needed activities to recover service on potentially late shipments. Effectively communicate any variance from original customer requests for delivery.

Crane/Rigging/Lifting

  • Operate forklifts to move or hoist shipments from the shipping area to trucks.
  • Load trucks using inside cranes and hoists for basic lifts. Assist more experienced riggers with more complex lifts.
  • Assist in moving buildings from the shop floor to outside areas to be staged.
  • Assist with staging cranes and clearing areas for heavy haul equipment to be loaded


Other Essential Duties

  • Assists in other warehouse functions as needed
  • Punctual. Maintains regular and consistent job attendance.
  • Maintains a safe working environment established by Intermountain Electronics, safety guidelines
  • Willing to work overtime when necessary
  • Follows and complies with IE Core Values
  • Follow and comply with IE safety program including following IE’s Cardinal Safety Rules.


Date of Release April 2023; 6/28/2023

Our team is proactive, courteous, and collaborative while providing clear and efficient communication in support of our colleagues, partners, and the audiovisual solutions our team integrates.

description:

Your experience matters!

At The Hospitals of Providence Rehabilitation Hospital East, we are driven by a profound commitment to prioritize your well-being so you can provide exceptional care to others. Here, you’re not just valued as an employee, but as a person.

The Hospitals of Providence Rehabilitation Hospital East in El Paso, Texas, is a dedicated inpatient rehab facility focused on helping patients regain independence after serious illness, injury, or surgery.

Supports the rehabilitation team by carrying out patient care activities as directed by an OTR/RPT, including safe patient transport, treatment preparation, and observation of patient response. The Hospitals of Providence Rehabilitation Hospital East is located in El Paso, TX, and is part of Lifepoint Health, a diversified healthcare delivery network committed to making communities healthier® with acute care, rehabilitation, and behavioral health facilities from coast to coast. From your first day to your next career milestone—your experience matters.

title: Speech Pathologist - PRN
description:
Job Summary

The Speech Pathologist evaluates, diagnoses, and treats speech, language, cognitive-communication, social communication, and swallowing disorders in children and adults. This role develops and implements individualized treatment plans to restore communicative efficiency and improve patient outcomes. The Speech Therapist collaborates with interdisciplinary teams, including physicians, caregivers, and other healthcare professionals, to ensure comprehensive patient care.

Essential Functions
  • Evaluates and assesses speech, language, cognitive-communication, and swallowing disorders, considering educational, medical, social, and psychological factors across diverse patient populations.
  • Develops and implements individualized treatment plans, incorporating appropriate therapeutic interventions to optimize patient outcomes.
  • Provides treatment for patients with communication impairments of both organic and nonorganic etiology.
  • Performs Modified Barium Swallow (MBS) evaluations in collaboration with the Radiology department and effectively communicates results.
  • Documents treatment interventions, patient progress, outcomes, and response to therapy in the medical record daily.
  • Ensures proper coding and accurate maintenance of charge logs for billing and compliance purposes.
  • Uses evidence-based techniques and positive reinforcement to encourage patient participation in therapy sessions.
  • Consults with physicians and interdisciplinary team members to coordinate referrals for additional services when needed.
  • Provides education and training to patients, families, and caregivers through verbal, written, and demonstrative instruction to support continuity of care.
  • Collaborates with other speech therapy professionals and interdisciplinary teams to enhance patient care and maximize therapeutic outcomes.
  • Engages in discharge planning, providing necessary follow-up recommendations and physician feedback.
  • Conducts comprehensive speech, language, cognitive-communication, and swallowing evaluations, including Modified Barium Swallow (MBS) studies when indicated.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Maintains regular and reliable attendance.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.
Qualifications
  • Master's Degree in Speech-Language Pathology from an accredited program required
  • 1-3 years of clinical experience in speech-language pathology preferred
  • Experience with Modified Barium Swallow (MBS) studies and dysphagia management preferred
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
  • Proficient in evaluating and treating a wide range of communication and swallowing disorders.
  • Skilled in completing Modified Barium Swallow (MBS) studies and interpreting results.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and critical-thinking skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with interdisciplinary teams.
  • Knowledge of documentation standards and EMR systems.
  • Understanding of ethical practice standards and regulatory compliance in healthcare.
Licenses and Certifications
  • SLP - Speech Language Pathologist license in state of employment required or
  • Certificate of Clinical Competence (CCC) from ASHA or in Clinical Fellowship Year (CFY) under supervision required
  • BLS - Basic Life Support required

As a Senior Workforce Relations Consultant, you will partner with the Manager, Workforce Relations to drive key initiatives and serve as a trusted advisor to a high-volume line of business. You will lead complex employee relations matters, conduct investigations, advise leaders and HRBPs, and deliver learning initiatives that promote compliance with HR policy, employment law, and best practices.
