Customer Service (Be Kind)

Exceptional service is at the heart of our Resitality® philosophy, creating memorable experiences that go above and beyond resident expectations. By demonstrating Resitality®, you help create a community where residents feel valued, supported, and truly at home.

  • Deliver exceptional service to prospects and residents by responding promptly to inquiries, addressing concerns, and creating positive experiences in every interaction.

Initiative (Own It)

Great associates don't wait for opportunities, they create them. By anticipating needs, taking ownership, and proactively solving challenges, you contribute to community success.

  • Identify opportunities to increase community visibility and traffic through outreach marketing, referrals, competitor analysis, and local market knowledge.

Adaptability (Listen & Talk)

Change is constant and adaptable associates keep communities competitive. By listening, learning, and pivoting quickly, you ensure success in a dynamic environment.

  • Adjust priorities and respond effectively to changing prospect, resident, and community needs in a fast-paced environment.

Teamwork (Have Fun)

High performing communities are built through collaboration and shared accountability. By working as a team, you help create an environment that drives resident satisfaction and operational excellence.

  • Partner closely with office and service team members to deliver a seamless resident experience and ensure compliance with company policies and Fair Housing requirements.

What You’ll Bring – Desired Skills and Experience

At Waterton, we recognize that compensation and benefits are important not only to our associates but to their families as well. We offer a wide variety of benefits including:

  • Generous paid time off, volunteer time off, and paid holidays

Typical Base Pay Range: $23.00-$25.00 per hour, plus bonus program participation

This pay range is base pay only and does not include any additional compensation or bonuses that this position may be eligible for. The pay range is approximate and the actual pay may vary depending on related work experience, certifications, education, and other job related factors.

Waterton welcomes all.

title: IT M&A Integration Program Manager (4+ months contract)
description:
CompassX is a boutique business and technology consulting firm. We help Fortune 500 and high-growth clients deliver their most strategic initiatives, from enterprise transformations to digital and data-driven projects. With over 15 years of proven results, we’ve expanded across industries including financial services, pharmaceuticals, aerospace, consumer products, and quick service restaurants.

We are honored to be recognized as a three-time winner of Consulting Magazine’s Best Boutique Firms to Work For, and previously recognized as a “Best Place to Work” in Southern California and one of INC.’s 5000 fastest-growing private companies in the U.S.

The Role:

  • Program Ownership: Act as the single Program Leader on behalf of CompassX Consulting Group to plan and execute a post-merger IT systems integration for our client, a premier Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) design-build contractor.

  • Cross-Workstream Scope: Own the end-to-end integration roadmap across three core pillars: ERP, HRIS, and IT Infrastructure.

  • Engagement Timeline: 3–4 month consulting engagement (with potential for extension) starting in early December 2026.

  • Work Mode & Travel: Executed primarily remotely, with periodic travel for key milestones and leadership meetings to client headquarters in Southern California and the acquired company’s location (East Coast or Midwest).

What You'll Do

  • Build & Govern the Master Plan: Develop and manage the comprehensive IT integration roadmap, budget, risk register, and executive status reporting from kickoff through cutover.

  • Manage Cross-System Dependencies: Identify, map, and resolve technical and operational interdependencies across ERP, HRIS, and Infrastructure—specifically around single domain architecture, cloud/M365 tenancy, identity and access management, networking, and endpoint devices.

  • Lead ERP & HRIS Integration Workstreams: Partner with internal business owners, IT leads, and third-party vendors to align project accounting, financials, payroll, and employee lifecycle workflows between both organizations.

  • Drive Executive & Vendor Alignment: Serve as the primary bridge between client executive sponsors, internal IT teams, HR/Finance stakeholders, and external implementation partners or MSPs.

  • Protect Business Continuity: Sequence cutover activities and change management to prevent disruptions to active residential and commercial construction projects, field teams, and billing cycles

What You'll Bring

  • IT M&A Integration Track Record: Proven experience leading post-merger IT system integrations at the program level, managing multiple parallel workstreams simultaneously.

  • ERP & HRIS Implementation Leadership: Hands-on project or program management experience leading full-lifecycle ERP and/or HRIS implementations, migrations, or consolidations.

  • Working Infrastructure Fluency: Broad technical familiarity with core IT infrastructure (Active Directory/Entra ID, cloud tenancy, network connectivity, security, and endpoint management) sufficient to spot cross-workstream bottlenecks and challenge technical leads.

  • Program-Level Executive Presence: Strong ability to lead cross-functional teams without direct line authority, escalate risks early, and translate complex technical dependencies into clear business decisions.

  • Industry Familiarity (Preferred): Prior experience in construction, MEP, engineering, or field-service environments (including familiarity with construction ERPs or field/union payroll complexities) is a strong plus.

Our consultants say CompassX is a place where they can truly find their own path. As part of a smaller firm, they see the impact of their work, have an identity, and know their voice matters. They value the freedom to take the reins of their careers, shape their client work, and maintain a direct line to leadership.

With CompassX’s focus on serving local Southern California clients, consultants not only build lasting relationships but also see the results of their work in the communities where they live.

At CompassX, you won’t just follow a path - you’ll create one.

description:

Internal applicants are required to submit the same application materials

X Online Application

Copy of Valid Certification and/or License

  11. Develops a Capital Improvement Plan for security enhancements for consideration into the full district's facilities CIP.

  18. Coordinates with Information Technology Department regarding network/infrastructure requirements for security systems.

  20. Keeps all records related to building evacuations, crisis response actions, and other issues, both actual events and drills.
  21. Coordinates testing and maintenance of life safety and security systems with vendors, school staff, East Hartford Police Department, and East Hartford Fire Department.
  22. Investigates reports of loss or damage to district property and coordinates with Risk Management, insurance carriers, or EHPD when necessary.
  23. Provides investigative support for school personnel on security -related matters, in coordination with Human Resources, EHPD and other school officials as required.
  24. Responds to security-related incidents at schools involving staff, students, or parents and completes comprehensive written reports upon investigation.
  25. Performs other related duties as assigned.

title: Java Developer
description:
Salary: ₱70,000 – ₱90,000 per month

Qualifications:

  • Has 4 years or more of experience in Java Development.

  • Strong proficiency in Java programming and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles.

  • Experienced in developing and maintaining backend applications using Java and Spring Boot.

  • Knowledgeable in building and integrating RESTful APIs and web services.

  • Experienced in working with relational databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Oracle.

  • Familiar with Hibernate/JPA, Maven/Gradle, and Git.

  • Knowledgeable in software development life cycle (SDLC) and Agile/Scrum methodologies.

  • Experience in debugging, troubleshooting, and optimizing application performance.

  • Familiarity with microservices architecture is an advantage.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively with cross-functional teams.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with Hibernate or JPA.

  • Knowledge of microservices architecture.

  • Familiarity with Maven or Gradle.

  • Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

  • Knowledge of Docker and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Experience with unit testing frameworks such as JUnit and Mockito.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain applications using Java and related technologies.

  • Build and maintain RESTful APIs and backend services.

  • Write clean, efficient, reusable, and well-documented code.

  • Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues.

  • Collaborate with frontend developers, QA engineers, and other team members.

  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement.

  • Perform unit testing and support integration testing.

  • Optimize application performance, scalability, and reliability.

  • Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and development activities.

  • Maintain technical documentation and follow development best practices.

title: Sommelier
description:
For the opening of the new exclusive Akira Back restaurant, The St. Regis Rome is casting for a Sommelier.

The ideal candidate is able to provide an outstanding customer service to our international guests whilst delivering service to the highest standards.

POSITION SUMMARY

Reporting to the Specialty Restaurant Manager, the role will be part of the AB Restaurant team, proud to engage our guests and to create exquisite moments.

You are a passionate Sommelier who is always on the lookout for new beverage trends and supervising others to do the same. When you are on the floor, you create energy that is both welcoming and exciting. You take pride in offering our guests a carefully curated wine and sake selection, a warm conversation, and helpful suggestions. Through your expertise, personality and attention to detail, you create memorable experience for our guests while leading by example for the entire team.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

  • Represent the AB brand and deliver exceptional guest experience.
  • Pair and suggest wines and sake that will best complement each particular food menu item.
  • Identify and propose new wines and sake products to complement existing menu selections.
  • Research new wine and sake trends and benchmark competitors
  • Conduct staff wine and sake tastings with company SOP and applicable laws.
  • Conduct period inventories to ensure percentage cost is at or below budgeted levels.
  • Order and conduct inventory of specialty wine equipment and glassware.
  • Create and update wine and sake lists for outlets or restaurants.
  • Design and implement wine and sake promotions and guest engagement initiatives.
  • Meet with wine and sake distributors, wineries, and purveyors to stay abreast of latest products and ensure positive vendor relationships.
  • Curate, update and maintain wine and sake lists.
  • Attend wine tastings and training to continue self-education and development.
  • Answer guest questions or concerns regarding the origin, vintage, and style of various wines.
  • Decant wines appropriately to the wine type.
  • Issue, open, and serve wine/sake/champagne bottles, ensuring guest satisfaction.
  • Monitor inventory of wine cellar, ensuring appropriate quality and amounts of wine, proper storage and disposal of wines, and replenishing cellar as needed.
  • Train and educate server and bartender staff on wine origin, vintage, styles, and pairings.
  • Complete closing duties, including storing all reusable goods, breaking down goods, cleaning all equipment and areas, returning equipment to proper locations, locking refrigerators, restocking items, turning off lights, locking doors, and completing daily cleaning checklist.
  • Ensure that coolers, freezers are set at the correct temperatures and labeled and record equipment and food temperatures on HACCP chart.
  • Complete scheduled inventories for wine and sake at the end of each month.
  • Report any employee, guest, and/or vendor incidents and accidents to management and Loss Prevention at the time of the incident and/or accident.
  • Act as a key operational leader within the restaurant, ensuring service standards are maintained.
  • Count bank at end of shift, complete designated cashier reports, resolve any discrepancies, drop off receipts, and secure bank
  • Update MICROS system menus as required.
  • Contribute to team effort by accomplishing related results as needed.
  • Follow Standard Operating Procedures and brand identity guidelines
  • Comply with all health, safety and hygiene standards and policies.
  • Balance the cash register at the start and close of each shift.
  • Help others when required

CANDIDATE PROFILE

  • A team Player with flexible & positive attitude.
  • Passion for the hospitality industry.
  • Possess a good command of English and Italian.
  • Experience as Sommelier in luxury hospitality, Asian, Japanese or fusion dining concept preferred.
  • Possess a good command of English and Italian.
  • Exceptional storytelling and guest engagement skills.
  • An excellent verbal manner and proven customer service skills.
  • Good organization skills with an attention to detail.
  • Able to work in a fast paced environment & remain calm under pressure.
  • Be able to demonstrate experience in complaint handling.
  • Strong grooming standards and professional presentation.
  • Availability to work late nights, weekends and bank holiday as we operate 365 days a year.

What we offer

  • Discounts on hotel rooms, gift shop items, food and beverage across the company.
  • Learning and development opportunities online, on the job and in class.
  • Charity events, Wellbeing activities through the TakeCare program.
  • Experienced management & motivated and engaging colleagues.
  • Canteen service and uniform.

#LI-FG1

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

title: Plumbing Install Manager
description:
Plumbing Install Manager | $70K–$80K Salary | Full-Time

Las Vegas, NV | Full-Time

You know a clean re-pipe when you see one. Now build the team that delivers them every day.

Winner of 8 Culture Awards by Top Workplaces- check out our page @ Working at Goettl Air Conditioning and Plumbing | Top Workplaces

Goettl has been doing this since 1939, and our standard hasn't changed: We Do Things The Right Way, Not The Easy Way®. We're hiring a Plumbing Install Manager in Austin, TX to lead our plumbing installers, drain technicians, and coordinators and own the quality, safety, and performance of every install and drain job. If you're tired of putting out fires without the support to fix the root problem, this is your seat. And with 30% of our plumbing team promoted from within, you'll be building careers, not just schedules.

Why Goettl:

  • $70,000–$80,000 annual salary, based on branch size, scope, and location
  • Full medical, dental, vision, and 401(k)
  • Steady, high-value work: re-pipes, water heaters, sewer and drain, gas piping, water treatment, and trenchless
  • Ongoing leadership training and a clear career path across Arizona, Nevada, and Texas

What You'll Do:

  • Hire, develop, and retain a high-performing team of plumbing installers and drain technicians at every level
  • Build install schedules that keep crews productive and customers happy
  • Coach to the numbers: Attendance, On-Time Arrival, Callbacks, Customer Satisfaction, and Billable Efficiency
  • Make sure every job is sold and executed right, from re-pipes and water heaters to drain lining, coating, and bursting
  • Run batching, job staging, check-out, and equipment registration and warranty processes
  • Enforce drain and excavation safety, Excavation Competent Person, and mini-excavator certifications.
  • Oversee care of specialized equipment, including mini-excavators, hydro-jetters, and trenchless rigs

What We Need:

  • Strong technical knowledge of residential plumbing, gas, sewer and drain, water treatment, and trenchless systems
  • Proven leadership, organization, scheduling, and coaching skills
  • Plumbing management experience and CRM or job scheduling software experience preferred
  • Clear MVR with a minimum of two years' licensed driving experience
  • Comfortable splitting time between the desk and the field, including standing, bending, kneeling, and lifting up to 15 lbs

If you're ready to lead the best plumbing install team in Las Vegas, we want to talk.

Apply now. We move fast for the right people.

title: Logistics Specialist
description:
Make an Impact With Us

At Vallourec, we are seeking individuals whose passion and dedication match the strength and resilience of the steel we produce. The Logistics Specialist is accountable for all inbound actions necessary to import products including but not limited to supporting the logistics team to process imports, arranging for transportation, preparing the system for invoicing, and assisting in post-entry issues.

Your Role at a Glance

  • Receive and analyze sort documents for entry instruction creation (PL, CI, BL).
  • Create entry instruction sheets from sorted documents for all Vallourec material coming into the USA.
  • Manage documents for import (Commercial Invoice, Import Security Filing, Bills of Lading, Packing Lists, Material Test Reports and Certifications).
  • Organize, digitally catalog, and send entry instruction sheet information and documents (as required) to shipping team members, Customs brokers, salespersons, customers, truckers, storage yards,

    shipping lines, surveyors, Claims Department, ports, and other pipe facilities.

  • Communicate with parties responsible for sending initial ISF forms to promote timely ISF filings.
  • Complete and send ISF forms to the shipbroker before the vessel’s arrival.
  • Obtain invoices from ELISA or appropriate invoices repository and distribute invoices according to the responsible salesperson and prepare them for automatic or manual goods receiving.
  • Post goods issue in SAP.
  • Perform receipt of goods and services in SAP.
  • Transfer (allocate) material in SAP from stock to sales orders for the Billing department (Deliver Goods).
  • Maintain and keep up-to-date records on customer shipping information.
  • Perform maintenance or updates on Microsoft Excel Macro-enabled entry instruction sheet template.
  • Communicate with Vallourec mills and ELISA service for missing documents for upcoming shipments or customers.
  • Follow instructions on the formatting of documents, steamer fields, email subjects, etc, in order to allow for automation databases to work effectively.
  • Communicate with freight forwarders and shipping lines used by Vallourec regarding upcoming shipments and shipment documents (i.e. Bills of Lading).
  • Forward Arrival Notices to the shipping broker and conduct audits against the steamer to ensure all items are accounted for.
  • Inform the Inside Sales Department of arrived vessels and when vessel documents are given to Billing Dept.
  • Identify and assign Harmonized Tariff Codes to import materials based on paperwork description.
  • Maintain vessel tracker.
  • Support Sales/Customers on order status issues related to Logistics.
  • Participate actively in continuous improvement activities for the USA Import and Export process and other areas as required or desired.
  • Assist in requesting Post Summary Corrections (PSC’s).
  • Travel as needed to visit ports, terminals, brokers, truckers, etc. as required.
  • Additional responsibilities as assigned.

                What Powers Your Performance

                • 4-6 years of experience in import/export or US Customs processing
                • Bachelor’s in business, Business management, engineering, supply chain, or a related field is desired. Experience is considered in lieu of education.
                • Experience in ERP Systems required (SAP Preferred)
                • Ability to prepare Excel spreadsheets and PowerPoint presentations.
                • Ability to read, write, and speak English
                • Must be able to handle multiple tasks simultaneously
                • Communicate clearly and constructively
                • Collaborate effectively and contribute to team success
                • Adapt to change with a positive, proactive mindset
                • Take accountability and show initiative in their work
                • Demonstrate reliability and pride in performance
                • Prioritize safety and act with awareness
                • Embrace feedback and use it to grow
                • Maintain high attention to detail
                • Drive continuous improvement and challenge the status quo
                • Support and develop others through shared learning

                                  How We Support Your Success

                                  We are committed to helping you thrive on the job and beyond through career development, collaboration, and a comprehensive benefits program, including:

                                  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
                                  • Company-Paid Life Insurance & Short/Long-Term Disability
                                  • Profit Sharing: Up to 4%
                                  • 401(k): Company match 4.5% with no vesting period
                                  • Paid Parental Leave
                                  • 10 Paid Holidays plus 1 floating holiday
                                  • Paid Vacation Time
                                  • Performance-Based Bonus Program
                                  • Tuition Reimbursement

                                            Safety is not negotiable. Every decision, improvement, and project is guided by our commitment to protecting our people and maintaining a world-class safety culture.

title: Myyjä 30h/vko, XXL Pori
description:
XXL Pori etsii myyjiä osaksi lahjakasta tiimiään!

Nyt sinulla on mahdollisuus päästä kokemaan XXL:n syke urheilukaupan huipulla! Haluamme tarjota asiakkaillemme parhaan mahdollisen ostokokemuksen urheilun ja ulkoilun saralla, ja työskentelemmekin yhdessä tiiminä yhteisten tavoitteidemme saavuttamiseksi.

XXL:n tavarataloissa työskentelemme yli osastorajojen siellä, missä ammattitaitoasi kulloinkin tarvitaan. Myyjänä olet tärkeä osa koko tavaratalon toimintaa, ja pääasiallinen tavoitteesi on varmistaa, että asiakkaamme saavat asiantuntevaa palvelua ja positiivisen ostokokemuksen jokaisella käynnillään.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

  • Kiinnostavan ja monipuolisen tehtävän innostavassa yrityksessä

  • Kansainvälisen työympäristön

  • Henkilökunta-alennuksen

  • Houkuttelevan bonusjärjestelmän

  • Joustavat ja monipuoliset työajat

  • Loistavan mahdollisuuden henkilökohtaiseen kehittymiseen ja uralla etenemiseen

  • Työympäristön, jossa kaikki ovat valmiita auttamaan toisiaan ja työskentelevät yhdessä tiiminä osastosta riippumatta

  • Vaihtelevia ja inspiroivia työtehtäviä, joissa pääset toteuttamaan ja haastamaan itseäsi

Haluamme parasta työntekijöillemme ja panostamme heidän kehittymiseensä sekä hyvään työympäristöön. Koulutamme ja kehitämme työntekijöitämme järjestelmällisesti, ja tarjoamme hyvät mahdollisuudet sisäiseen kehittymiseen ja uralla etenemiseen.

Meillä on osallistava työympäristö, jossa työskentelemme yhdessä tavoitteidemme saavuttamiseksi. Tarjoamme erinomaiset henkilökuntaedut, kilpailukykyiset työsuhteen ehdot sekä mahdollisuuden olla osa Pohjoismaiden suurinta urheiluketjua. Työhyvinvointikyselyissämme saamme jatkuvasti huippuarvioita työyhteisön ilmapiiristä ja työtovereiden tuesta.

Voit lukea lisää työntekijöidemme kokemuksista urasivultamme: linkki työntekijöidemme tapaamiseen.

Keskeisimmät työtehtäväsi

  • Auttaa asiakkaita löytämään oikeat tuotteet ja palvelut

  • Vastata asiakkaiden kysymyksiin sekä esitellä tuotteita ja niiden käyttöä

  • Hoitaa myyntitilanteita ja palautusprosesseja

  • Ylläpitää tavaratalon siisteyttä, järjestystä ja tuotteiden esillepanoa

  • Tukea markkinointikampanjoiden toteutusta ohjeistusten mukaisesti

  • Osallistua tavaratalon päivittäiseen toimintaan ja varmistaa erinomainen asiakaskokemus

Menestyt tehtävässä parhaiten, jos

  • Urheilu ja aktiivinen elämäntapa ovat lähellä sydäntäsi

  • Asiakkaiden auttaminen motivoi sinua

  • Sinulla on vahvat kommunikointi- ja vuorovaikutustaidot

  • Kykenet työskentelemään sekä itsenäisesti että osana tiimiä

  • Olet organisointikykyinen ja järjestelmällinen

  • Sinulla on erinomaiset asiakaspalvelutaidot

Haastattelemme hakijoita heti haun alettua, ja paikat täytetään heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä!

title: Licensed Clinician (59313)
description:
Make an Impact Where It Matters Most

We’re seeking a Licensed Clinician who is ready to lead with purpose, elevate clinical quality, and directly influence client outcomes. This is a high-impact clinical leadership role. You’ll directly influence the quality of care, support the growth of clinical staff, and help clients build a foundation for lasting recovery. This role is ideal for someone who can balance strong clinical expertise with leadership, coaching, and coordination across a multidisciplinary care environment.

You won’t just manage cases—you’ll shape treatment journeys, strengthen clinical teams, and ensure clients receive comprehensive, compassionate care across every stage of recovery.

If you’re a clinician who leads with both skill and purpose, we want to hear from you. Apply today and be part of a team that’s committed to transforming lives—one client at a time.

***Phoenix House of NY is proudly offering 100% employer-paid medical insurance for all eligible employees and their dependents!***

About Us

Phoenix House of New York | Long Island is a nonprofit organization dedicated to helping individuals and families overcome substance use disorders and achieve lasting recovery. We provide treatment, housing, and support services for our clients and their families. Our core values— Integrity, Compassion, Appreciation, Respect, Excellence, and Forward Thinking —guide our approach, ensuring each person receives evidence-based care that promotes dignity and wellness. By upholding these values, we empower people to rebuild their lives with hope, accountability, and support.

What We Offer

At Phoenix House, we recognize that in today’s economic climate, stability and support matter more than ever. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to care for you as a whole person—supporting your health, financial well-being, and work-life balance. Here are some of our perks:

  • (10) Paid Holidays

  • Paid vacation, sick time, personal and wellness time

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance for those who are scheduled to work at least 30 hours per week

  • Pet insurance, legal support, and other supplemental insurance

  • A generous tuition reimbursement program

  • 403(b) retirement plan

  • Competitive wages and more...

Responsibilities:

  • Assists clinical staff in the development of treatment plans, ensuring that such plans address all facets of a patient's treatment -- mental health, substance abuse, education and vocational rehabilitation.
  • Conducts regular interdisciplinary case conferences.
  • Conducts workshops and individual or group therapy sessions, as needed, in conjunction with other clinical staff.
  • Works with counselors in all areas of their job functions and facilitates open, consistent, skill-focused clinical supervision and staff development, documenting as needed.
  • Responsible for overseeing and coordinating overall patient case management with applicable state and local social services agencies, legal referral sources and resources, school-based stakeholders, and community-based providers of services, as needed.
  • Reviews clinical documentation of staff; participates in or leads the clinical case review process; supports, monitors, and implements clinical and recovery support programming for all phases of treatment
  • Works with staff and patients to facilitate effective progression of patients through the treatment process.
  • Works with counselors to ensure that patients receive appropriate information/referrals throughout the re-entry phase of the program and in preparation for discharge.


Job Details

  • Hauppauge Residential - Hauppauge, NY

  • Full Time-Exempt

  • Salary range $64,500 - $75,000

title: Leasing Agent - PIP
description:
About us:

Cambridge Management, Inc. (CMI) began in 1987 as a small team managing a portfolio of communities in Tacoma, Washington. Our focus soon shifted to providing quality management for affordable housing communities. These affordable communities provide homes for those with limited incomes including families, senior citizens, and people with disabilities. Today, our team has grown to nearly 350 employees managing 120 communities and more than 9,000 apartment homes. Our portfolio includes market rate, Low Income Housing Tax Credit, and Project-Based Section-8 communities that range in size from 6 to 344 units. We currently manage communities in California, Florida, Hawaii, Georgia, Oregon, Tennessee, Washington State, and Virginia.

Why work for us:

Cambridge Management, Inc. offers the following Compensation and Benefits package for full time employees:

Hourly pay $18.63

Paid time off:

  • An accrual of 80 hours of Vacation.
  • Up to 6 paid sick days per year. (varies based on state sick leave laws)
  • 8 paid holidays
  • 2 paid floating holidays.

Benefits offered:

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Long Term Disability, AD&D & EAP
  • 401(k) with employer match
  • Voluntary benefits available

Job Summary:

Under the direct supervision of the Community Manager and/or Assistant Manager, the Leasing Agent will assist in the development and implementation of advertising and special promotions. The Leasing Agent is responsible for establishing and maintaining a relationship with prospective and current residents. The Leasing Agent will assist with marketing and is responsible for leasing the property.

Incumbent is expected to have excellent attendance and communication skills, possess the ability to build lasting business relationships, and exhibit professionalism.

Requirements.

Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities:

This job description does not list all duties that will be required of this position. You will be required to perform other duties, as requested by your supervisor.

  • Create a positive, welcoming, supportive environment for residents, visitors, and community associates.
  • Assist with development and implementation of resident services programming.
  • Utilize maintenance software program to enter in and track service requests and track unit turns.
  • Assist in attracting, screening, and selecting prospective residents in accordance with federal, state, governing program laws and regulations utilizing the set Resident Selection Criteria
  • Prepare market surveys and traffic reports.
  • Lease renewal process
  • Determine the needs of prospective residents.
  • Prepare lease packages.
  • Collect late rent and other monies due to the property.
  • Move-in and move-out process.
  • Answer the telephone and greet prospective residents and residents in a pleasant and positive manner. Respond to incoming calls from the corporate office or those related to the operation of the property.
  • Contact all guests by phone and/or email within 24 hours or less of their initial visit.
  • Sends Thank You cards after to guests.
  • May be asked to perform housekeeping duties as needed.

Roles & Responsibilities

This position has responsibility for:

Sales/Marketing

  • Perform telephone market surveys and physical shops of competitors.
  • Recommend strategies and programs for on-site marketing activity.
  • Develop and monitor merchant/neighborhood referral programs for move-in packets, newsletters, and resident retention.
  • Initiate sales outreach plans including but not limited to new development, community management, internal and external communication, and support.
  • Recommend programs and strategies to increase qualified traffic and closing ratios.

Administrative

  • Support the Assistant Community Manager with tracking and processing renewals, lease expirations, and notices to vacate.
  • Collect and accurately process and report receipt of application fees, security deposits, rents, and other fees.
  • Keep files, desk, and leasing area organized.
  • Inspect market ready units and models each morning, ensuring the lights are on, and the unit is shown ready.

Customer Service

  • Assist in planning of resident functions.
  • Provide excellent customer service and display a courteous and professional attitude toward all customers.
  • Attend and assist in facilitating resident functions and community affiliated events, including on weekends and evenings.

Knowledge, Skill, and Competency Requirements

Competency is based on education, training, skills, and experience. In order to perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following knowledge, skills and competencies:

  • Assist the Community Manager and/or Assistant Community Manager in collection of delinquent rents and processing of all administrative forms and reports.
  • Ability to maintain all resident and property files and play an active role in the lease renewal process including completing all lease forms and agreements.
  • Superior sales and customer service skills including helping our customers, answering all incoming calls, greeting incoming visitors, and resolving any issues with professionalism and clear communication.
  • Strong time management and organizational skills with and without direct supervision while being able to maintain professionalism under pressure/deadlines.?
  • Good follow-through is necessary, so our customers feel their needs are recognized and met.
  • Strong adherence to ethical standards including, but not limited to, the ability to maintain confidentiality and fiduciary responsibility.
  • Experience with HUD and LIHTC programs
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule to include weekends, evenings, and holidays.

Computer Skills:

Som person gillar du att arbeta i högt tempo, och du är ansvarsfull och noggrann. Du är kreativ, har många idéer och strävar hela tiden efter att nå uppsatta mål tillsammans med dina kollegor. Ett roligt arbete med härliga kollegor i ett bolag som befinner sig i ett expansivt skede. För rätt person finns det stora möjligheter till utveckling och större ansvar. Hos oss hjälps vi åt, jobbar hårt och firar våra segrar.

Skicka in din ansökan med CV och berätta gärna i ett personligt brev varför du skulle passa i rollen som E-commerce lead hos oss.

description:
Job Summary

The Patient Care Technician (PCT) provides high-quality, patient-centered care by performing delegated tasks in alignment with the PCT's training and the department's needs. Under the direct supervision of a Registered Nurse (RN) or Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) (LVN at Texas facilities), the PCT supports patient care by assisting with activities of daily living, maintaining a safe and organized care environment, and ensuring effective communication within the healthcare team.

Essential Functions

  • Assists nursing staff in delivering care, performing delegated basic patient care services, and ensuring a clean, safe, and well-organized environment.
  • Collects and records patient data, including vital signs, height, weight, oxygen saturation, intake/output, and calorie counts, reporting findings to the RN/LPN/LVN.
  • Supports patients with meals, feeding, bathing, oral care, grooming, linen changes, skin care, elimination assistance, and urinary catheter care.
  • Assists with patient positioning, repositioning, dangling, ambulating, and using mobility aids such as walkers, crutches, canes, and wheelchairs.
  • Collects urine and stool samples and performs blood glucose monitoring via finger sticks, documenting and reporting results to the RN/LPN/LVN.
  • Communicates patient information effectively to the care team, adapts to change, and maintains professionalism in all interactions.
  • Maintains a clean, neat, and safe environment for patients and staff, adhering to infection control and safety protocols, including appropriate use of personal protective equipment (PPE).
  • Participates in performance improvement initiatives, risk management reporting, and compliance with National Patient Safety Goals and Core Measures.
  • May be required to maintain continuous visual observation of the patient and remains with them at all times unless relieved by appropriate personnel.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Maintains regular and reliable attendance.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.

Qualifications

  • 0-2 years of experience in an acute care setting or currently enrolled in a Nursing program preferred

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Basic knowledge of patient care practices and equipment.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions and work collaboratively within a team.
  • Commitment to maintaining patient confidentiality and adhering to safety protocols.

Licenses and Certifications

  • BCLS - Basic Life Support within 90 days of hire required
  • CNA - Certified Nursing Assistant preferred or
  • Certified Patient Care Technician (CPCT) preferred

title: Pharmacy Tech II
description:
Position Summary

The individual in this position will assist in preparing, packaging, delivering, and charging of medications, under the supervision of a licensed pharmacist. Position duties include the following activities:


fill and label medications
stock medications into pharmacy inventory
restock automated dispensing cabinets (ADCs)
maintain adequate medication stock levels and proper storage of medications
deliver medications to patient care areas
attend to medication requests and phone calls
prepare IV sterile admixture solutions and IV products
assist in Pharmacy quality assurance activities
comply with state and federal regulatory requirements, Joint Commission standards and Tenet and hospital policies and procedures
assist pharmacists in performing various duties as assigned

  • The individual’s responsibilities include the following activities: a) accurately fill medication orders with correct strength, dosage form, and quantity in a timely manner, b) assure all medications are checked by a pharmacist prior to dispensing, c) respond appropriately to requests for STAT orders, routine orders, department requests, and ADC stock out bulletins, d) refill emergency crash carts, boxes, and kits accurately and timely, e) accurately stock ADCs in a timely manner, f) prepackage and label oral medications and extemporaneous preparations, g) prepare IV sterile admixture solutions and IV products accurately consistent with IV policies and procedures (USP797 and USP800), h) restock medications in IV room and conform to IV cleaning schedule, i) complete monthly medication inspections as assigned, j) maintain quality assurance logs with proper documentation and notify Supervisor of any deviations from standards, k) adhere to pharmacy technician operational workflow and delivery schedule, l) follow proper process for handling of controlled substances and report any variances to Supervisor or pharmacist-in-charge, m) ensure patient accounts are properly charged, n) acts under the supervision of facility DEA registrant or other Licensed Independent Practitioners while performing medication management related activities at a remote site commonly owned and operated by the Hospital o) other duties as assigned.
  • Organization/Work Role: Prioritizes workload. Completes work in a timely manner. Maintains a clean and orderly work environment. Shares responsibility for ordering and stocking medication and keeping the department clean. Maintains a calm demeanor during busy or crisis situations. Utilizes personal protective equipment to protect from exposure to chemical, radiation and infectious hazards.
  • Professional: Actively participates in department management by providing input at meetings and reading communication. Mentors new and less experienced staff and students. Uses policy and procedure manuals and other reference material to ensure proper course of action.
  • Quality Improvement: Identifies, proposes solutions and assists in implementation of ideas for improvement in patient care and departmental / hospital operations. Participates in the successful implementation of change. Identifies opportunities and implements strategies to decrease waste in medication. Participates in department QI as requested.
  • Other related job tasks or responsibilities as assigned
  • Special Skills:
    • Must be able to work in a fast-paced environment with occasional periods of above average pressure.
    • Must have basic computer skills.
    • Excellent customer service skills.
    • Must be willing to work in all areas of the pharmacy services as assigned.
    • Effective interpersonal skills and ability to work with team members required.
  • Minimum Requirements:
    • Education: High School Diploma or equivalent GED
    • Experience: Two (2) years of hospital pharmacy experience.
    • Licensure/Certification: Licensed in the State of Arizona as a Pharmacy Technician, Pharmacy Technician certification
  • Preferred Requirements:
    • Experience: Previous hospital pharmacy experience preferred. IV experience preferred. Good organizational skills, verbal and written communication skills, and basic computer skills preferred.

title: Instructional Aide - SPED
description:
Primary Purpose:

To assist students with disabilities in accessing the general education curriculum and achieving IEP goals by providing instructional, behavioral, and social support within inclusive classroom settings. The Inclusion Paraprofessional works under the supervision of certified special education staff to promote student independence, engagement, and success.

Qualifications:

Education/Certification:

  • High school diploma or GED (required)
  • 48 college hours, associate degree, or passing score on the Paraprofessional Assessment of Academic Skills (required)
  • CPI (Crisis Prevention Intervention) certification (preferred or required upon hire)

Special Knowledge/Skills:

  • Knowledge of student disabilities and accommodations
  • Ability to follow teacher guidance and implement support strategies
  • Effective communication and collaboration with general and special education staff
  • Patience, flexibility, and professionalism in supporting students with diverse learning needs
  • Ability to model appropriate behavior and support student regulation

Major Responsibilities and Duties:

Instructional Support:

  1. Assist students during instruction by clarifying content, supporting assignments, and reinforcing accommodations
  2. Support implementation of instructional modifications as specified in the IEP
  3. Monitor and document student progress, participation, and areas of need

Behavioral Support:

  1. Reinforce classroom expectations and assist with behavior management strategies
  2. Provide positive behavioral support and redirection as needed
  3. Assist in implementing behavior intervention plans (BIPs) when applicable

Collaboration:

  1. Work closely with general education teachers, special education teachers, and related service providers
  2. Participate in training and staff development to support inclusion practices
  3. Attend ARD meetings when requested and maintain the confidentiality of student information

Supervision and Safety:

  1. Supervise students in general education classes, hallways, lunch, arrival/dismissal, and transitions as needed
  2. Ensure student safety and well-being in all settings
  3. Report any concerns regarding student behavior, academic needs, or safety to the appropriate staff
  4. Perform other duties as assigned.

Working Conditions:

  • Classroom and school campus environment
  • May require assisting students with physical, emotional, or behavioral needs
  • Some lifting or physical support may be necessary
  • Possible exposure to challenging behaviors or self-regulation issues

*Minimum Salary $15.23 hourly
*Salary is commensurate with experience
*Works 187 Day Calendar
* This position requires on-site, in-person work and does not offer remote work options.

Sheldon ISD will accept applications for this position through October 5, 2026. After this date, applicants can continue to submit applications in case the district was unable to find a suitable candidate. If the district was unable to find a suitable candidate from the initial applications, applications submitted after October 5th will be reviewed in five-day increments until a viable candidate is recommended for hire.

title: Associate, Donor Experience
description:
Position Title:

Associate, Donor Experience

Status:

Full Time, Permanent

Hiring Salary Range:

$54,219 - $63,255

To ensure fair and equitable pay at THPF, salary will be based on your years of experience, skills and qualifications relevant to the role

Work Location:

Hybrid - 1 day per week in the office at 2085 Hurontario Street with occasional work at hospital sites – Mississauga, Credit Valley Hospital and Queensway Health Centre sites.

ABOUT US

At Trillium Health Partners Foundation, we’re helping build a new kind of health care for one of Canada’s fastest-growing and most diverse communities.

We raise funds to support the highest-priority needs of Trillium Health Partners, one of the largest community-based hospital systems in Canada, and help advance better care for the communities it serves. Made up of The Credit Valley Hospital, the Mississauga Hospital and the Queensway Health Centre, Trillium Health Partners cares for the people of Mississauga, West Toronto and surrounding communities. It is a teaching hospital affiliated with the University of Toronto, an associate member of the Toronto Academic Health Science Network, and a proud member of Mississauga Health (Ontario Health Team).

This is an exciting time to join our team. Through Built for Us, our $1 billion fundraising campaign, we’re helping deliver faster care, bring more specialized care closer to home and build a health system around the people who rely on it. The campaign will support the future home of The Peter Gilgan Mississauga Hospital, set to become Canada’s largest hospital; the Shah Family Hospital for Women and Children, Ontario’s first hospital dedicated to women’s and children’s health; and the redevelopment of The Gilgan Family Queensway Health Centre.

Our work is ambitious and so is our team. Together, we have an opportunity to help transform health care for generations to come.

Join us and help build the future of health care, built for all of us.

THE ROLE

The Associate, Donor Experience reports to the Senior Manager, Donor Experience and supports the planning and execution of meaningful stewardship, recognition and engagement opportunities. This includes donor-centric communications, core stewardship and construction-related events, and gift announcements and celebrations. The role will also contribute to the ongoing enhancement of our donor experience program, creating exceptional experiences and touchpoints that will strengthen donor relationships throughout the campaign and beyond.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Work with the Senior Manager, Donor Experience to implement and execute new touchpoints that will elevate the annual major gift donor journey, including the rollout of a new donor onboarding series.
  • Assist with the development and delivery of donor-centred communications that may include video messaging, email messaging, postcards, and e-newsletters.
  • Execute event logistics for the annual President’s Circle Gala, Partners in Progress virtual series, and other stewardship events and tours that arise during the year.
  • Support the team with the execution of tactics aligned with gift announcements and celebration events.
  • Manage the Foundation’s Campaign Recognition Inventory Tool. Ensure the integrity of information and visuals being added and/or updated, and monitor the troubleshooting and support log so that updates can be made in a timely manner. Assist the philanthropy team in identifying meaningful campaign naming opportunities at the $25K-$500K level.

  • Support donor stewardship and recognition efforts through the accurate tracking of campaign recognition commitments, maintenance of donor segment coding, creation of stewardship event records, and recording of stewardship-related activities and interactions within the donor database.

  • Help operationalize a legacy recognition strategy for donors who have recognition in our existing Mississauga Hospital site.

  • Support with the stewardship journey of donors who are part of a long-term stewardship strategy.

  • Support the Senior Manager, Donor Experience as required in the development and implementation of new initiatives and tactics that will enhance the overall donor journey at the Foundation.

  • Provide ah-hoc support as needed to Donor Experience team members.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • University degree or college diploma in a related discipline.
  • 1-3 years of experience in fundraising, donor relations, customer experience, event coordination, communications, or a related field. Event experience is considered an asset.
  • Knowledge of best practices and tactics related to donor stewardship and recognition.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, effective at building relationships and able to work well with donors, colleagues and key Foundation and Hospital stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently and efficiently in a busy environment managing multiple projects, shifting priorities, and tight deadlines.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills with meticulous attention to detail.
  • Excellent writing and communication skills and knowledge of digital outreach.
  • Highly professional and articulate with sensitivity, discretion, and an appropriate demeanour.
  • Experience working in hospital environment, and/or health-related charity is considered an asset.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications (Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Teams and SharePoint)
  • Donor/Client database experience (Raiser’s Edge and Luminate Online experience strongly preferred)

WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Willingness to work flexible hours and to tight deadlines as needed —some after-hours work may be required.
  • Hybrid work schedule with 1 day in the office.
  • Valid driver’s license and access to a reliable vehicle an asset.

title: SubContract Manager
description:
As a 100% employee-owned contractor, when you work at Sundt, you’re not just hiring on at a company, you’re joining a culture. Because everyone at Sundt is part owner, you’ll join a team of people who are deeply invested in their work. From apprentices to managers, we’re passionate about the details and deliberate in everything we do.

At Sundt we focus on building long-term prosperity for our clients, communities, and employee-owners. We offer competitive pay, industry-leading benefits including a 401k and employee stock ownership plan, incentive programs for craft and administrative employees as well as training that focuses on your personal and professional growth. We’re driven by skill, grit and purpose. Join us as we strive to be the most skilled builder in America.

Job Summary

The Subcontract Manager is responsible for managing the full lifecycle of subcontractor relationships and the direct reports that support this position. The lifecycle of the subcontractor may include prequalification, assistance with subcontractor evaluations, contract award support and management, subcontractor performance monitoring and metrics – including potential inspections, validation of quality and conformance with specifications, invoicing, reviewing any potential subcontract change orders, facilitation of communications and / or project changes, and closeout. This role ensures subcontractors meet the requirements of: The contractual specifications, Schedule – including fabrication, delivery, installation, and checkout, Quality – both off site and on project site, Safety – with a focus on project site, and financial requirements. The Subcontractor
Manager also needs to be able to adapt to different project strategies as determined with the client. Certain clients might have existing relationships, commitments, or suppliers that will be engaged as subcontractors.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Assist with subcontract negotiations and procurement strategies for new projects.
2. Conduct regular subcontractor performance reviews and address performance issues promptly.
3. Coordinate subcontractor onboarding, prequalification, insurance, bonding, licensing, and compliance requirements.
4. Ensure compliance with company policies, contract terms, applicable laws, and project requirements.
5. Identify contractual and commercial risks and develop appropriate mitigation strategies.
6. Lead subcontract closeout activities, including final payments, releases, warranties, and outstanding documentation.
7. Maintain accurate contract records, correspondence, amendments, and supporting documentation.
8. Manage subcontractor relationships and serve as the primary point of contact for assigned subcontractors.
9. Monitor subcontractor performance against contract requirements, project schedules, budgets, quality standards, and safety expectations.
10. Review and process subcontractor change requests, claims, time extensions, and potential disputes.
11. Review, negotiate, and administer subcontract agreements, purchase orders, change orders, and related documentation.
12. Support project forecasting, cost reporting, accruals, and financial reconciliation.
13. Track subcontractor deliverables, milestones, submittals, invoices, and payment applications.
14. Work closely with project managers, procurement, legal, accounting, estimating, and field teams.

Minimum Job Requirements:

1. 5+ years of experience in subcontract management, contract administration, construction management, procurement, or a related field. Preferred experience with managing a direct report as support of the process.
2. Ability to mentor and guide others in the process of subcontractor management.
3. Ability to work effectively with project teams, vendors, subcontractors, and senior management.
4. Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related field with 0-5 years of experience or at least two years of experience on active projects with subcontractors.
5. Experience reviewing financial and contractual documentation.
6. Familiarity of applicable construction regulations, insurance requirements, bonding, and compliance practices.
7. Familiarity with the subcontracting process, required deliverables, flow of relevant information to and from the subcontractor, and ability to understand and report progress of the subcontractor relative to the subcontractor's deliverables.
8. Strong understanding of construction contracts, subcontract agreements, change management, and claims.
9. Strong understanding with the subcontracting process, required deliverables, flow of relevant information to and from the subcontractor, and ability to understand and report progress of the subcontractor relative to the subcontractor deliverables.
10. The ability to be organized and handle multiple items at once either directly or through direct reports, and problem-solving skills.
11. The ability to communicate priorities and resolve conflicts in a professional manner.

Note: Job Description is subject to change at any time and may include other duties as assigned.

Physical Requirements:

1. May stoop, kneel, or bend, on an occasional basis.
2. Must be able to comply with all safety standards and procedures.
3. Required to use hands to grasp, lift, handle, carry or feel objects on a frequent basis.
4. Will interact with people and technology frequently during a shift/workday.
5. Will lift, push or pull objects up to 50lbs on an occasional basis.
6. Will sit, stand or walk short distances for up to the entire duration of a shift/workday.
7. Will use telephone, computer system, email, and other electronic devices on a frequent basis to communicate with internal and external customers or vendors.

title: Certified Enrollment Director
company: YOUNG MENS CHRISTIAN ASSOCIATION OF METROPOLITAN LOS ANGELES
description:
YMCA OF METROPOLITAN LOS ANGELES

The LA Y is the Center for Community Well-Being in Los Angeles, committed to building stronger communities by providing equitable programs and services to empower all. We are focused on fighting food insecurity, providing equity in education, making sure every child has the opportunity to experience the joy of sports, ensuring kids and teens have a safe place to grow, learn and live a healthy lifestyle. The LA Y’s health and wellness initiatives offer medical and mental health resources to ensure everyone has access to basic health needs. Our mission is to provide services and resources that contribute to the well-being of our community. The LA Y operates 29 Centers and over 200 program sites across LA County.

*This position is grant funded, and continued employment is contingent upon the availability and renewal of funding and compliance with grant requirements. Positions may be modified or eliminated if funding is reduced, discontinued, or not renewed.*

POSITION SUMMARY

  • Provide in-person, hands-on support to community members completing applications, enrollment, renewals, and redeterminations for Medi-Cal, CalFresh, and other eligible benefits.
  • Assist individuals with gathering, reviewing, and submitting required information and documentation to support timely and complete applications and renewals.
  • Help community members understand HR1 policy changes, eligibility requirements, important deadlines, and actions they may need to take to maintain or access benefits.
  • Provide same-day application and renewal assistance when possible and help individuals identify next steps when additional documentation or follow-up is required.
  • Assess individual and household needs during appointments and connect community members to appropriate YMCA and community resources.
  • Identify individuals who may need to complete HR1 community engagement requirements and provide information on available pathways, including employment, education, workforce development, and volunteer service.
  • Connect individuals who need volunteer hours to Regional Program Coordinators for volunteer registration, onboarding, placement, and ongoing support.
  • Share available YMCA programs and resources, including food access, workforce development, mental health services, volunteer opportunities, and other supports that promote household stability.
  • Provide warm referrals to YMCA programs, community partners, and other service providers based on identified needs.
  • Stay informed of HR1 policy, eligibility, enrollment, and implementation updates to provide community members with accurate and current information.
  • Participate in community workshops, educational sessions, and enrollment events designed to help individuals and families understand policy changes and access support.
  • Maintain accurate and confidential records of applications, renewals, referrals, services provided, and outcomes in accordance with program and privacy requirements.
  • Track enrollment and renewal activities, referrals, and other program data to support reporting, follow-up, and evaluation.
  • Work closely with Regional Program Coordinators, YMCA center staff, community partners, and program leadership to ensure individuals receive coordinated support and successful referrals.
  • Funding Contingent Position: Continued employment is contingent upon the availability of program funding, ongoing program needs, and satisfactory job performance. Funding beyond the current funding period is not guaranteed.

YMCA LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES

The Y’s Leadership Competency Model is comprised of multiple leadership competencies (leadership knowledge, skills, and behaviors required for success in the Y), organized by the four disciplines of cause driven leadership:

  • Advancing Our Mission & Cause: Provide visionary leadership to the organization and ensure that all resources are mobilized to adapt to new challenges and needs in the community.
    • Competencies Include: Change Leadership, Engaging Community, Philanthropy, & Volunteerism
  • Building Relationships: Connect people to the Y’s cause by developing inclusive relationships, partnerships and collaborations so that Ys can co-create solutions to pressing social needs.
    • Competencies Include: Collaboration, Communication & Influence, Inclusion
  • Leading Operations: ensure relevance, effectiveness, and sustainability of the organization so that we can continue to fulfill our promise to the community.
    • Competencies Include: Critical Thinking & Decision Making, Fiscal Management, Functional Expertise, Innovation, Program/Project Management
  • Developing & Inspiring Others: support the holistic development of self and others so that everyone can embrace the Y’s cause, sustain the Y’s culture, and inspire others to take individual and collective action to further our impact.
    • Competencies Include: Developing Self & Others, Emotional Maturity

While all competencies are significant the following are critical to success in this position:

  • Engaging Community: Builds relationships with YMCA centers, County agencies, funders, and community partners to support effective HR1 implementation, accountability, and responsive community services.
  • Compliance & Accountability: Ensures program operations, data, documentation, privacy practices, and reporting align with funding agreements, regulatory requirements, and YMCA standards.
  • Collaboration: Works closely with the Senior Director of Civic Engagement, program staff, Legal, Risk Management, Finance, funders, and County partners to coordinate compliance, reporting, contracts, and successful program implementation.

*This position is grant funded, and continued employment is contingent upon the availability and renewal of funding and compliance with grant requirements. Positions may be modified or eliminated if funding is reduced, discontinued, or not renewed.*

title: Manual QA Engineer
description:
We are a global IT product company shaping the future of real-time social connection. We have millions of users across North America, Europe, Latin America, and MENA, and we build next-gen mobile and web apps for the live-streaming and social networking niches. The market will exceed $206 billion by 2030, and we are already among the leaders in the industry. Founded in Ukraine, scaling worldwide. Are you in?

About your role: We are looking for a Manual QA Engineer. You'll own the quality of our high-load web products and directly affect product stability, monetization and release speed. The role covers APIs, databases, analytics events, payment flows and A/B experiments across multiple brands and platforms. You'll also be part of an AI-first QA process, using AI tools and agents for test design, test runs and bug investigation, and helping the team improve these workflows.

In this role, you will

  • Perform functional testing of new web features and verify bug fixes (UI, user flows, cross-browser, responsive)

  • Run smoke, sanity and regression testing before releases; perform post-release checks on production

  • Test analytics and CAPI events: parameters, deduplication, data validation (DevTools, BigQuery)

  • Run API checks and prepare test data (Postman, MongoDB)

  • Test business logic, A/B experiments and monetization flows (admin panel, feature flags)

  • Review requirements, plan testing and assess risks

  • Maintain test documentation (Qase, Jira)

  • Investigate bugs via console, network and service logs (Lens): client vs backend, root cause

  • Work within SCRUM and SDLC, improving testing speed and quality (incl. AI tools)

It's all about you

  • 2-3 years of manual QA experience with web applications: UI, API, Web Push, Email

  • DevTools: Network (payload, status codes), Console, Application (cookies, Storage, service workers)

  • HTTP / REST: methods, status codes, headers, cookies; requests in Postman / curl

  • MongoDB (find, aggregate) and BigQuery (SQL): you write queries and prepare test data independently

  • CAPI conversions: verification of server-side events (parameters, event_id, deduplication with pixel) via Events Manager / test events

  • Test design, SDLC / STLC, TMS (Qase), Jira / Confluence

  • Use of AI tools in your work (Claude Code)

  • Experience with logs

  • Git and IDE (VS Code): clone, switching branches, pull; reviewing changes in MR / diff; running the project locally

  • Claude (Claude Code) or other AI tools for test design, test documentation, log and bug analysis

  • Ability to verify AI output instead of taking it on faith

  • English Intermediate (B1)

Would be a plus

  • A/B testing: group distribution, feature flags

  • Web Payments: payment providers, test cards, 3DS, recurring, refund

  • Basic UI / API automation: JS/TS, Playwright, Postman tests

  • Client-side ad tracking

What we offer

Care and support

  • 20 paid days off, 15 days off due to sickness, and 6 extra days for family moments that matter

  • Up to 10 additional days off for public holidays

  • 100% medical insurance coverage

  • Sports and equipment reimbursement

  • Financial and legal support when you need it

  • Maternity Recovery Support Allowance

  • Position retention and support for teammates who joined the Armed Forces of Ukraine

  • Active participation in social initiatives supporting Ukraine

  • Team spirit beyond the screen: company marathons, themed masterclasses, and teambuildings people actually look forward to

Comfortable environment

  • Fully remote cooperation: our processes are built around it. Kyiv hub is there if you want it

  • Modern equipment, or reimbursement for your own setup

Investment in your future

  • Collaborate with a highly-skilled team of Middle & Senior professionals, sharing practical cases and expertise in the social networking and streaming niche

  • Clear KPI system, so you always know what “good” looks like, no guessing games

  • Access to premium AI tools and technologies

  • Performance-based reviews and Individual Development Plans (IDPs)

  • Reimbursement for professional courses and English classes

  • Corporate library, book club, and regular knowledge-sharing events

Hiring process

  • Intro call

  • Technical interview

  • Final interview

  • Reference check

  • Offer

title: Pulidor(a)
description:

title: Packaging Improvement Engineer
description:
Position Summary

The Packaging Improvement Engineer partners with cross-functional teams, equipment manufacturers, and packaging suppliers to improve packaging-system performance across the company. The role focuses on protecting product quality, food safety, and regulatory compliance while making packaging operations safer, more reliable, more consistent, and less wasteful. To support these improvements, the engineer establishes and improves packaging standards, converts operating data and field observations into practical solutions, and supports plants in resolving critical packaging and equipment issues. The position will be based at one of our four manufacturing facilities but will support all sites.

At Daisy Brand, we are committed to delivering high performing packaging solutions for our customers, and safe, experience enhancing solutions for our consumers. As a Packaging Improvement Engineer, you will play a critical role in shaping the future of packaging at Daisy Brand while working in a collaborative and growth-oriented environment. Join us to contribute to exciting projects and help us achieve our company's goals.

Location and Travel Requirements

Travel Requirements: Up to 25%

This position operates under a hybrid work model, requiring onsite presence Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday, with Wednesday and Friday designated as remote workdays. While this schedule is typical, team or business needs may require additional onsite days.

Work Location: This position will be based at our new manufacturing facility in Boone, IA, expected to open in 2028. Until then, the role will work from our interim office in Ames, IA.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Packaging Continuous Improvement Activities, Projects, and Processes by:

  • Scheduling, coordinating, communicating, and verifying packaging improvement activities from problem definition through sustained results.
  • Identifying and driving improvements in packaging equipment, materials, operating methods, changeovers, inspection systems, and sanitation.
  • Leading initiatives to improve line efficiency, equipment reliability, throughput, and labor effectiveness while reducing packaging waste, giveaway, rework, downtime, and defects.
  • Using structured problem-solving methods such as 6M, root-cause analysis, Pareto analysis, capability studies, statistical process control, and designed experiments.
  • Developing business cases, expected benefits, trial plans, acceptance criteria, and post-implementation verification for improvement projects.
  • Analyzing manufacturing and packaging data using Excel, Power BI, statistical software, historian/MES data, or visualization platforms to identify trends, quantify losses, determine root causes, and verify that improvements are sustained.

Lead Packaging Quality and Process Standardization by:

  • Auditing packaging lines to verify that approved equipment settings, centerlines, materials, inspection methods, sanitation requirements, and operating procedures are being followed.
  • Establishing and maintaining packaging standards for critical parameters such as fill accuracy, seal temperature, dwell time, pressure, cooling, package integrity, code quality, and package appearance.
  • Partnering with plants, cross-functional teams, and vendors to design and execute controlled trials that resolve packaging unknowns, confirm repeatable solutions, and support data-based recommendations for equipment, material, parameter, or procedural changes.
  • Driving adoption and sustainment of packaging improvements by engaging plant leadership, operators, maintenance, quality, sanitation, and engineering resources in the development, implementation, training, and ongoing verification of new standards.

Provide Technical Support and Capability Development by:

  • Responding to critical packaging, product-quality, food-safety, and equipment-performance issues, including defects, complaints, excessive waste, downtime, and performance gaps, by supporting plants in investigating causes and implementing corrective actions that meet current targets and specifications.
  • Collaborating with OEMs and material suppliers on equipment capability, packaging-material performance, specifications, testing, troubleshooting, and improvement opportunities.
  • Identifying recurring equipment failure modes, evaluating mechanical condition and process capability, and partnering with Maintenance and OEM resources to eliminate chronic losses rather than repeatedly adjusting around equipment deficiencies.
  • Creating practical technical documentation, including troubleshooting guides, centerline sheets, health checks, inspection standards, and training materials, that explains both the required standard and the engineering rationale behind it for operators, mechanics, engineers, and technical resources.
  • Sharing proven methods and lessons learned across sites to accelerate standardization and prevent repeat issues.

Support Equipment Projects and Commissioning by:

  • Participating in equipment FATs, SATs, commissioning, capability studies, startups, and performance acceptance activities to ensure new or modified packaging systems meet agreed-upon safety, quality, throughput, waste, reliability, and maintainability requirements.
  • Documenting proven operating settings once the line is running consistently and meeting these requirements.

Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications and Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Packaging Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field is preferred; equivalent packaging or manufacturing experience will be considered.
  • Experience: Five or more years of experience in packaging engineering, manufacturing engineering, or continuous improvement is preferred, with an emphasis on hands-on packaging equipment troubleshooting, process optimization, and sustained improvements in line efficiency, reliability, package quality, and waste reduction. Experience in food manufacturing is preferred.
  • Technical Skills:
    • Knowledge of food-packaging materials and how material properties such as thickness, coefficient of friction, sealant behavior, barrier properties, stiffness, dimensional variation, and supplier tolerances interact with packaging equipment, package integrity, and process capability.
    • Familiarity with applicable packaging test methods and standards, including ASTM and ISTA methods where relevant, and experience with package-integrity, seal-performance, material, and distribution testing.
    • Experience with packaging equipment and machinery in a manufacturing setting.
    • Proficiency in CAD software for packaging design is a plus.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with a focus on developing practical and cost-effective solutions.
  • Regulatory Knowledge: In-depth understanding of food packaging standards, including FDA, USDA, and global food safety regulations.
  • Project Management: Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, from concept to implementation, while meeting deadlines.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills to collaborate with internal teams and external suppliers, including the ability to lead and facilitate cross-functional continuous improvement meetings, guide structured problem-solving discussions, and establish clear action items, owners, and follow-up timelines.
  • Attention to Detail: High level of accuracy and detail orientation in material selection, testing, and reporting.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Packaging Materials and Shelf Life: Experience with food-grade packaging materials and process- and material-based shelf-life extension techniques.
  • Dairy Experience: Experience in dairy manufacturing.
  • Automation and Controls: Working knowledge of PLC-controlled packaging equipment, HMI recipes, servo systems, VFDs, sensors, vision/inspection systems, temperature controls, pneumatics, and automated reject systems, with the ability to troubleshoot packaging-process interactions in partnership with controls and maintenance resources.

Company Overview

Daisy Brand is the market leader in two billion-dollar categories – sour cream and cottage cheese. Headquartered in Dallas, Texas, we’ve earned the trust of Americans through consistency and quality across five generations as a family-owned company. Our success has been guided by a simple belief: good food, much like good work, starts with integrity. That mindset continues to shape how we make our products, run our business, and support the people behind the brand.

At Daisy Brand, tradition and innovation go hand in hand. We invest thoughtfully in advancements that strengthen our products and operations, supporting responsible, long-term growth. In 2025, we broke ground on a new manufacturing facility in Boone, Iowa, further strengthening our supply chain alongside our established plants in Garland, Texas; Casa Grande, Arizona; and Wooster, Ohio. Looking ahead, our state-of-the-art Innovation Center, opening in 2026, will bring together research, food science, culinary, and technology teams to shape the future of our products. Recent work from these teams includes the development of the squeeze pouch and new line of dips, reflecting an intentional approach to modernization while staying true to the quality our consumers expect.

At the heart of Daisy Brand is its people. The company is intentionally structured to be collaborative and accessible, with an entrepreneurial mindset encouraged at every level. We hire with the goal of building long-term careers and provide an environment where employees are trusted to think critically, take initiative, and continue learning. Growth here isn’t accidental; it’s actively supported and shared.

To support our employees and their families, Daisy Brand offers a people-first benefits package that includes:

  • A no deductible, $0 premium option for employee only medical coverage
  • Access to virtual healthcare and wellness programs
  • A 401(k) program with company match, plus weekly safe harbor and annual profit-sharing contributions
  • Company paid short and long-term disability coverage and 2x annual salary in life and AD&D insurance
  • Four weeks of paid time off, plus 20 hours of floating holidays in your first full year of employment
  • Annual rollover and payout options for any unused paid time off
  • Paid time for volunteering and community involvement
  • Tuition reimbursement and ongoing professional development opportunities
  • Fitness and wellness incentives
  • And more.

Daisy Brand is a nicotine-free company. Daisy Brand is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Veterans and disabled encouraged to apply.

location: New York, New York, United States
description:
