title: Senior Program Manager
description:
The Senior Program Manager – Ground System Modem leads end-to-end delivery of the modem within a complex SATCOM ground-system solution. This role is accountable for integrated planning, supplier execution, cross-functional and technical alignment, acceptance, deployment, and operational readiness.

Combining strong program leadership with telecommunications/SATCOM knowledge, the Senior Program Manager works across engineering, System Architecture, Product Owners, Integration and Test, program controls, Procurement, Operations, and external suppliers to manage dependencies, risks, commitments, and critical decisions. The role may establish a new program or take ownership of an in-flight delivery, quickly building a fact-based view of status, priorities, critical path, supplier commitments, and recovery needs.

Success requires strong supplier and stakeholder leadership, commercial and contractual awareness, and a delivery-focused approach that drives issues and decisions to closure.

Key Responsibilities

Program Definition and Execution

  • Define and maintain the Ground System Modem program execution framework, including the delivery roadmap, scope, integrated schedule, milestone baseline, release strategy, governance cadence, supplier commitments, integration approach, and acceptance strategy aligned with system architecture and contractual commitments.
  • Turn system, customer, contractual and operational commitments into executable work packages, supplier deliverables and measurable acceptance outcomes.
  • Lead execution end to end, from supplier development through integration, verification, acceptance, deployment, and operational readiness, while actively managing dependencies, risks, and recovery actions.
  • Drive trade-offs across scope, performance, schedule, cost, quality, risk, and give decision-makers clear options and consequences.
  • Keep the critical path, milestone confidence, integration readiness, major defects, and supplier commitments visible.
  • Quickly assess in-flight programs and set recovery priorities. For new programs, set up the delivery model, requirements baseline, and acceptance framework.
  • Own the full program outcome across hardware, software, integration, and operational readiness, not just the schedule.

Technical, Cross-Functional and Agile Delivery Leadership

  • Use working knowledge of Telecom/SATCOM and modem technologies to challenge technical status, understand system impacts, and work credibly with engineers, architects, Product Owners, Integration/Test teams, and vendors.
  • Work with System Architects and Product Owners so that architectural intent, requirements, interfaces, feature priorities, and release sequencing show up in vendor execution and stay aligned with program milestones and acceptance needs.
  • Lead in Agile or hybrid hardware/software environments, linking backlogs, features, releases, dependencies, and definition of done to system-level milestones and program commitments. This role partners with the Scrum Master or Product Owner.
  • Partner with Integration and Test so that delivered capabilities can be tested, defects are prioritized, and product maturity is ready for system verification and acceptance.
  • Represent the program in cross-functional planning and decision forums. Report status, milestone confidence, dependencies, risks, trade-offs, and the decisions that are needed.
  • Resolve issues that cross technical, organizational, contractual, customer, or supplier boundaries before gaps between teams turn into delivery or integration risks.

Vendor Leadership & Accountability

  • Serve as the accountable program-delivery interface with the modem supplier and establish an effective, professional, and accountable vendor relationship.
  • Drive vendors against agreed scope, technical requirements, schedule, quality, deliverables, dependencies, and acceptance commitments.
  • Establish a supplier operating cadence with clear owners, actions, decision points, escalation paths, and evidence-based measures of delivery performance.
  • Hold vendors accountable while maintaining the working relationships required to solve complex technical and delivery problems.

Procurement & Contractual Support

  • Work closely with the internal Procurement team to connect program execution and technical delivery with contractual obligations, sourcing strategy, business objectives, and customer commitments.
  • Lead development of program Statements of Work (SoWs), coordinating technical and commercial inputs to ensure scope, deliverables, milestones, dependencies, responsibilities, and delivery expectations are clearly defined.
  • Ensure technical requirements and delivery decisions are understood in terms of their potential scope, schedule, cost, and contractual impact.

Program Governance & Executive Reporting

  • Develop and maintain an evidence-based view of program health covering schedule and critical path, milestone forecast, supplier and feature delivery, integration/test maturity, commercial concerns, key risks and dependencies, required decisions, and recovery actions.
  • Support the Senior Director in monthly program reviews, including preparation of executive-level status, key messages, decision requests, risks, and recommended actions.
  • Own or contribute to program dashboards, integrated forecasts, milestone reviews, management review inputs, and PMO reporting, using tools such as Microsoft Project, Oracle Primavera, Jira, and Confluence as appropriate to the program environment.
  • Ensure significant technical and delivery decisions are appropriately captured and communicated.

Required Experience & Qualifications

  • A Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Telecom, Computer or Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • 10+ years running programs or leading technical delivery in telecom, SATCOM, networking, or similar.
  • A track record delivering complex hardware/software systems with major suppliers. You've negotiated, escalated, and gotten a delayed program back on track.
  • Experience starting programs from scratch and taking over ones already underway.
  • A solid grasp of how systems get built, integrated, tested, accepted, and handed to operations.
  • Comfort with integrated schedules, critical paths, risk, change control, and forecasting.
  • Commercial awareness: you've written SOWs and worked through contract changes and supplier negotiations.
  • Hands-on experience with Agile and hybrid delivery on large system programs.
  • Clear communication, whether you're in a technical deep-dive or briefing executives.
  • You're self-directed, handle ambiguity well, and can lead and influence people who don't report to you. This role has no direct reports.

Preferred Experience

  • A Master's in Engineering or Engineering Management, or an MBA.
  • PMP, PgMP, or SAFe certification.
  • Hands-on experience with SATCOM ground systems, modems, gateways, or RF/networking equipment, ideally at an operator or service provider.
  • Experience with qualification, certification, or launching a new service.
  • Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, MS Project, SmartSheets or Primavera.
  • Exposure to Government or Defense programs.
The successful candidate must be able to work in Canada and obtain clearance under the Canadian Controlled Goods Program (CGP).

title: Data Conversion Lead (1657)
description:
Oracle Cloud Applications | Senior Delivery Role

Position Summary Lead the end-to-end data conversion workstream for Oracle Cloud implementations, from strategy and mapping through testing, reconciliation, cutover, and production validation.

About Highstreet

Highstreet helps public sector organizations modernize through Oracle Cloud technology and services. With more than 30 years of public sector experience, we combine deep Oracle expertise with a client-focused approach to delivering successful transformations. We offer a progressive work environment along with a comprehensive and competitive benefits package. highstreetit.com

Position Overview

The Data Conversion Lead is responsible for leading the strategy, planning, design, execution, testing, and validation of data migration activities required to transition customer data from legacy systems into Oracle Cloud Applications. This senior delivery role works closely with functional, technical, integration, reporting, and project leadership teams to ensure data is accurately mapped, transformed, loaded, reconciled, and approved throughout the implementation lifecycle.

The Data Conversion Lead is accountable for the quality, completeness, and readiness of converted data across testing cycles and production cutover, while providing clear leadership to onshore and offshore conversion resources and customer data owners.

Key Responsibilities

Data Conversion Strategy & Planning

  • Develop and manage the overall data conversion strategy, approach, plan, schedule, and governance model.
  • Define conversion scope, methodologies, standards, templates, controls, and repeatable delivery processes.
  • Identify source systems, conversion objects, data dependencies, sequencing, ownership, and acceptance criteria.
  • Align conversion cycles with configuration, integration, testing, reconciliation, and deployment milestones.
  • Identify conversion risks, dependencies, and issues and drive timely resolution with project leadership.

Data Mapping, Transformation & Migration

  • Lead data discovery, profiling, mapping, cleansing, transformation, and migration activities.
  • Coordinate mapping of legacy data structures and business rules to Oracle Cloud data requirements.
  • Oversee the development and execution of data extraction, transformation, and load processes using approved Oracle Cloud tools and templates.
  • Ensure conversion specifications, mapping documents, data dictionaries, and decision logs remain complete and current.
  • Partner with functional leads and customer data owners to resolve data gaps, mapping questions, and business-rule discrepancies.

Testing, Validation & Reconciliation

  • Lead mock conversions and data migration activities across system integration testing, user acceptance testing, and production-readiness cycles.
  • Define reconciliation and validation procedures to confirm the completeness, accuracy, and integrity of converted data.
  • Coordinate functional and customer validation of conversion results and required sign-offs.
  • Track conversion defects, load errors, reconciliation differences, and data-quality issues through resolution.
  • Establish measurable controls and reporting for conversion status, completeness, error rates, and data quality.

Cutover & Production Deployment

  • Develop and manage the data conversion portion of the production cutover plan.
  • Define conversion sequencing, dependencies, timing, validation checkpoints, rollback considerations, and go/no-go criteria.
  • Coordinate final extraction, transformation, loading, reconciliation, and business validation activities.
  • Monitor conversion execution during cutover, communicate status, and escalate critical issues promptly.
  • Ensure required controls, documentation, approvals, and sign-offs are completed before production go-live.

Team & Delivery Leadership

  • Lead onshore and offshore data conversion resources supporting Oracle Cloud implementation projects.
  • Assign conversion activities, monitor progress, and manage delivery against scope, quality, and timeline commitments.
  • Provide technical and functional guidance to conversion team members and customer resources.
  • Establish consistent conversion standards, reusable assets, tools, templates, and quality checkpoints.
  • Mentor team members and strengthen organizational data conversion capabilities.

Client & Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for the data conversion workstream.
  • Lead data conversion workshops and working sessions with customer business and technical stakeholders.
  • Communicate status, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and readiness to project leadership and governance teams.
  • Partner with customer data owners to drive data cleansing, validation, remediation, and sign-off activities.
  • Collaborate with project managers, solution architects, functional leads, integration teams, and reporting teams to maintain alignment.

Sales & Solution Support

  • Represent data conversion capabilities during sales presentations, discovery sessions, and solutioning activities.
  • Estimate conversion scope, effort, staffing, assumptions, dependencies, and delivery timelines.
  • Contribute data conversion content, estimates, and assumptions to proposals and Statements of Work (SOWs).

Required Qualifications

  • Significant experience leading data conversion or data migration workstreams for enterprise application implementations.
  • Hands-on knowledge of data profiling, cleansing, mapping, transformation, loading, reconciliation, and validation.
  • Experience with Oracle Cloud Applications conversion methods, file-based data loads, and related migration tools and templates.
  • Demonstrated experience planning and executing multiple mock conversion cycles and production cutover.
  • Ability to translate functional requirements and business rules into clear conversion specifications.
  • Experience leading distributed teams and coordinating customer, functional, and technical stakeholders.
  • Strong communication, facilitation, issue-resolution, documentation, and executive-status reporting skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Oracle Cloud ERP, HCM, Payroll, Financials, Procurement, or related modules.
  • Experience supporting public-sector, education, or other complex, highly regulated implementations.
  • Knowledge of SQL, ETL concepts, data-quality tools, and structured reconciliation methods.
  • Experience contributing to implementation proposals, estimates, staffing plans, and SOW development.

Expected Outcomes

  • Accurate, complete, reconciled, and approved data converted into Oracle Cloud Applications.
  • Successful execution of mock conversions, testing cycles, cutover, and production validation.
  • Timely identification and resolution of data-quality, mapping, conversion, and reconciliation issues.
  • Clear accountability and collaboration across customer, functional, technical, and project teams.
  • Repeatable conversion methods, templates, controls, and tools that improve delivery speed and quality.
  • A capable, mentored data conversion team positioned to support future Oracle Cloud implementations.

Employment Type / Location / Travel

  • Full-time, permanent position.
  • Travel to the client site Monday through Thursday may be required.

title: Material Services Director
description:
Summary
Lead enterprise strategy and execution for the procurement, repair, and availability of aircraft parts, materials, and maintenance-related services across Allegiant and Sun Country Airlines. Lead an organization of approximately 65-75 team members through six to seven direct-report managers covering Technical Purchasing, AOG and Materials Services, Aircraft Parts Repair Management, and Warranty Management. Accountable for the department budget, parts availability, vendor performance and cost, supporting dispatch reliability and FAA-compliant maintenance materials operations. Oversee the development of analytical models and decision-making tools, source and negotiate supplier contracts, resolve parts-related engineering issues, and manage parts procurement, component repair, warranty recovery, and excess parts sales. Reports to the VP, Procurement. This role is based in Las Vegas, NV, and is not eligible for remote work.

Visa Sponsorship Available: No

Minimum Requirements
Combination of Education and Experience will be considered. Must be authorized to work in the US as defined by the Immigration Act of 1986. Must pass a Criminal Background Check.
Education: Bachelor’s Degree
Education Details: Bachelor's in Supply Chain, Business, Aviation Management, Engineering, Finance or a related field.
Years of Experience: Minimum five (5) years of progressive experience in aviation materials management, supply chain, or technical procurement at a commercial airline or MRO, including at least 3 years in a leadership role.

• Demonstrated strength in sourcing, negotiation, contracting, and vendor/supplier management; financial acumen; data analytics; and a strong track record of developing talent, driving continuous improvement, and stakeholder collaboration.
• Demonstrated leadership competencies: measuring and managing team and individual performance; establishing department goals and objectives aligned with company objectives; managing talent development and succession planning for the department; and modeling behaviors aligned with Allegiant values and leadership norms.

Preferred Requirements
• Experience leading multi-function materials organizations (such as AOG, repairs, and purchasing) at a multi-fleet or multi-airline carrier; experience integrating or harmonizing supply chain processes, systems, and vendors across two airlines is desirable.
• Strong sourcing, negotiation, and contracting experience with OEMs and MRO vendors, including repair and exchange agreements, rotable pooling, consignment, and warranty agreements, along with budget management.
• Strong data analytics skills, including analytical modeling and spend and supplier performance analysis, and experience with data tools (such as SQL, advanced Excel, or BI platforms) and aviation maintenance/ERP systems.
• Working knowledge of FAA regulations and carrier maintenance program requirements as they apply to parts traceability, approved parts, and receiving inspection.
• Continuous improvement mindset; effective stakeholder collaboration and executive-level communication; and sound prioritization and problem-solving in a 24/7 AOG environment.
• Professional certification such as APICS CSCP/CPIM, ISM CPSM, PMP, or Lean Six Sigma.
• Master’s degree or MBA.

Job Duties
• Provide strategic and operational leadership to Materials Services, including AOG support, Technical Purchasing, Aircraft Parts Repair Management, and Warranty across Allegiant and Sun Country Airlines. Lead approximately 65-75 team members through six to seven direct-report managers.
• Technical Purchasing: Negotiate larger item purchases and services contracts. For predictable, higher use items, seek to purchase in bulk and/or establish contracts for fulfillment with vendors. Arrange the sale of excess inventory.
• Materials Services and AOG: Coordinate parts needs with maintenance control and shift managers. Assure that AOG and critical parts requests are fulfilled quickly, including after hours; purchase and move parts and materials to meet the immediate demands of aircraft maintenance.
• Aircraft Parts Repair Management: Manage repair vendors, cycle times, and core returns to assure a supply of high-quality rotable components sufficient to meet the requirements of aircraft maintenance.
• Warranty: Lead warranty administration and recovery from OEMs and vendors, including claims management, contract warranty terms, and tracking of recoveries, to reduce net parts and repair cost.
• Establish a strategy to achieve the function’s mission and vision and communicate it down through the organization. Align and harmonize processes, systems, and vendor relationships across Allegiant and Sun Country where appropriate.
• Develop supplier strategy and manage key OEM and MRO relationships, including performance scorecards and periodic business reviews.
• Establish department goals and objectives aligned with company objectives, and measure and manage team and individual performance against them.
• Manage talent development and succession planning for the department: select, develop, and mentor managers. Assure the appropriate training, assistance, coordination, and time are available to carry out objectives; re-prioritize as necessary.
• Model behaviors aligned with Allegiant values and leadership norms.
• Own the department budget and monitor monthly activity, forecast, and report on results.
• Define, track, and report key performance indicators such as parts service level, AOG response and aircraft-on-ground time attributable to parts, repair turn time, and spend versus budget.
• Assure compliance with FAA regulations and carrier maintenance program requirements for parts traceability, approved parts, and receiving inspection, and support internal and regulatory audits.
• Direct the development of analytical models and decision-making tools, and lead special projects that provide continuous improvement.
• Facilitate the resolution of issues within the department and across functions, including parts-related engineering issues, by lending expertise and actively directing the process of problem-solving.
• Interface with the Directors of Maintenance, Heavy Maintenance, Quality and Reliability, and with Sun Country counterparts, to assure the efficacy of parts supply decisions.
• Advise upper management on key issues and keep the VP, Procurement, informed on progress in each area, particularly as it affects the department’s commitments.
• Ensure any direct reports understand and apply our Customer Commitment and customer service standards to their daily responsibilities as appropriate.
• Model Allegiant’s customer service standards in personal actions and when providing leadership direction.
• Perform other duties as assigned.

Physical Requirements
The Physical Demands and Work Environment described here are a representative of those that must be met by a Team Member to successfully perform the essential functions of the role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role.
Office - While performing the duties of this job, the Team Member is regularly required to stand, sit, talk, hear, see, reach, stoop, kneel, and use hands and fingers to operate a computer, key board, printer, and phone. May be required to lift, push, pull, or carry up to 20 lbs. May be required to work various shifts/days in a 24-hour situation. Regular attendance is a requirement of the role. Exposure to moderate noise (i.e. business office with computers, phones, printers, and foot traffic), temperature and light fluctuations. Ability to work in a confined area as well as the ability to sit at a computer terminal for an extended period of time. Some travel may be a requirement of the role.

Essential Services Provider
Allegiant as a national air carrier is deemed an essential service provider during declared national and state emergencies. Team Members will be required to report to their assigned trip or work location during national and state emergencies unless prohibited by local, state or federal order.

title: Animal Care Technician
description:
The Grooming Room is seeking dog lovers with a passion for providing top notch care, and a desire to grow with a company of like-minded individuals! title: Analyst, PMO
description:
Who We Are

ATCO Frontec is a leading provider of facilities management, infrastructure, construction, defence and operational support services. We work in complex and remote environments, delivering practical solutions that help our clients and communities thrive.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a detail-oriented PMO Analyst to support our Project Management Office through portfolio reporting, governance coordination, performance analysis and project support.

In this role, you will work closely with project teams, functional leaders and senior leadership to maintain accurate project information, monitor portfolio performance and transform data into meaningful insights. You will help ensure projects follow established PMO standards and provide timely reporting that supports informed decision-making.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop and maintain portfolio dashboards, key performance indicators and executive-level reports.

  • Consolidate and analyze project information, including schedule, cost, risk, resource and performance data.

  • Coordinate regular PMO reporting cycles, governance meetings and action tracking.

  • Support project governance processes, stage-gate reviews, project health checks and compliance activities.

  • Monitor project and portfolio performance to identify trends, emerging risks and areas requiring leadership attention.

  • Maintain accurate and consistent project information within PMO systems and reporting tools.

  • Support resource capacity, allocation and utilization reporting across the project portfolio.

  • Assist with forecasting, variance analysis and portfolio prioritization activities.

  • Develop automated reporting solutions where practical.

  • Recommend improvements to PMO processes, reporting tools, governance practices and performance measures.

What You Bring

  • A bachelor’s degree in Business, Project Management, Engineering, Finance, Information Technology or a related field.

  • Five or more years of experience in a PMO, project controls, business analysis, portfolio management or project management environment.

  • Experience supporting multiple projects and working with project schedules, budgets, risks, resources and performance measures.

  • Experience preparing portfolio, governance or executive-level reporting.

  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Power BI.

  • Experience using Microsoft SharePoint and project or portfolio management systems.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify trends, investigate variances and translate data into practical recommendations.

  • Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing presentations and reports for leadership.

Assets

  • Experience with Microsoft Project or Procore.

  • Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM), PMI-PMOCP or a related certification.

  • Experience developing dashboards, automated reports or standardized performance measures.

Who You Are

You are a practical and collaborative analyst who enjoys bringing structure to complex information. You take ownership of data quality, ask thoughtful questions and can communicate project information clearly to different audiences. You are comfortable working across multiple projects and proactively identify risks, trends and opportunities for improvement.

What Success Looks Like

  • Portfolio reporting is accurate, consistent and delivered on time.

  • Leadership receives clear and reliable insights to support decision-making.

  • Project teams understand and follow established governance and reporting requirements.

  • Project and portfolio data is treated as a trusted source of information.

  • Reporting processes and PMO practices continue to become more efficient and effective.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the country where this position is located before starting work and must maintain any legally required work authorization during employment.

We would like to thank everyone for their application; however, only those being considered for an interview will be contacted.

Final candidates will be required to undergo a Security Clearance Check.

Collection, use, and retention of personal information will be in accordance with ATCO Group privacy policies and practices.

By submitting your resume and personal information to the ATCO Group of Companies, and/or participating in a personal interview, you acknowledge and consent to the collection, use and disclosure of your personal information by the ATCO Group of Companies to determine your suitability for employment opportunities within the ATCO Group of Companies.

  • Ability to lift and move heavy materials, as required for the role.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills for collaborating with clinical and administrative staff.
  • Ability to work independently and manage time effectively to meet supply demands.
  • Knowledge of safety protocols related to handling medical supplies and equipment.

title: Senior Solution Architect
description:
NGI is an internationally recognised research institute delivering expertise in geosciences. Through research, technology and innovation we help solve key societal challenges in climate adaptation, the energy transition, critical infrastructure and public safety. Our mission is a sustainable future on safe ground.

In NGI we have a series of corporate systems: ERP, HR and project administration tools, Microsoft 365 and the Power Platform for collaboration and automation, and Power BI for insight. We now want to connect them into a coherent whole, with reliable integrations, shared data models and a modern cloud data platform with clear data ownership.

This is a hands-on senior role (approx. 60% hands-on / 40% architecture and strategy). We expect working solutions, not only documents. Our product development teams build and maintain NGI’s portfolio of digital geoscience products. You will collaborate with them on shared platforms, data standards and integration patterns.

You will:

  • Define the current and target architecture for our corporate systems, showing how processes, applications and data fit together, and turn it into a roadmap with clear priorities.

  • Design and build integrations and data pipelines between ERP, HR, project administration, document management and Microsoft 365

  • Create data models and establish data ownership

  • Evolve our cloud data and R&D platform on Azure, with a focus on quality, cost and security

  • Work with the CISO and security engineers on data classification, access and compliance with GDPR, ISO 27001 and NIS2

Technology

  • Cloud and data platforms: Azure (primary), Microsoft 365

  • Data and integration: Python, PostgreSQL, REST/OData APIs

  • Identity, security and governance: Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Purview

  • Infrastructure as code: Terraform

  • Hosted infrastructure and storage: managed servers, virtual infrastructure and NetApp

How you work

  • You work closely with data owners, developers and management to shape the target architecture take well-informed decisions together

  • You start with the business need and make decisions together with the users and technical colleagues

  • You are pragmatic and hands-on, and choose solutions that are good enough, secure and maintainable

  • You take ownership and responsibility from design through to production

Who we are looking for

  • Master's or bachelor's degree in IT or similar, and at least 5 years of experience in data, solution or enterprise architecture, including hands-on development

  • Strong data modelling skills and knowledge of Domain Driven Design

  • Proven experience building integrations and data pipelines (REST/OData APIs or similar)

  • Experience with Azure and Databricks or similar technologies

  • Experience defining non-functional requirements for business systems

  • Understanding of identity, security and data protection in Microsoft environments

Why NGI Digital?

  • Real influence on architecture, platform choices and priorities

  • A mix of strategy, solution architecture and hands-on development in a modern cloud environment

  • Work that makes a difference, in an internationally recognised research institute

  • Competitive conditions, including strong pension and insurance schemes

  • A skilled, collaborative environment with opportunities for professional growth

We assess candidates continuously and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

title: RESOURCE PLANNER
description:
Job Title: Resource Planner

Department Name: Conservation District

Starting Rate: 20.83

Job Description (Essential Functions and Responsibilities)

Dauphin County Conservation District is currently accepting applications for the full time position of Resource Planner. The employee in this role is responsible for performing the following essential functions listed below:

  • Provides and/or coordinates educational programs, presentations and activities that promote and demonstrate management of water as a valuable natural resource. The primary targets of the educational outreach are municipal decision makers, design professionals and watershed organizations.

  • Works to obtain funding and coordinates projects that would protect and improve the water resources or water resource management in Dauphin County independently or in cooperation with other District Staff, agencies, watershed organizations, etc.

  • Maintains and applies knowledge of municipal government structure and applicable planning codes and ordinances and the municipal planning code in order to achieve the goals of district programs, projects and initiatives.

  • Completes assigned tasks under the Act 167 Storm water Management Program in accordance with guidelines and recommendations established by the PA Department of Environmental Protection (DEP), the Watershed Plan Advisory Council (WPAC) and the Conservation District.

  • Completes assigned tasks under the Municipal Separate Storm Sewer System (MS4) program in accordance with guidelines established by DEP and the Conservation District.

  • Complete assigned tasks under the district Floodplain Monitoring Program in accordance with guidelines established by the Department of Community and Economic Development (DCED) and the conservation district.

  • Acts as technical assistance resource to municipal officials, district staff, planning commissions, consultants, developers and the public for water quality and watershed management issues in support of district related programs or activities.

  • Develops and implements specific annual goals and objectives to support and achieve major district-established goals and objectives.

  • Interacts and works with watershed associations, other agencies, organizations and individuals to develop a coordinated approach to the protection and improvement of all water resources within Dauphin County.

  • Completes assigned tasks under the Dauphin County Agricultural Land Preservation Program in accordance with guidelines established by PA Department of Agriculture (PDA) and the Conservation District.

  • Prepares and updates local program guidelines and ensures compliance with local, state and federal guidelines.

  • Coordinates and facilitates all facets of the Agricultural Land Preservation Program application process.

  • Processes and ranks easement applications; coordinates professional services and submits easement purchase applications to state.

  • Provides technical assistance to the public regarding all assigned programs.

  • Generates reports, maintains files, log, etc.

Minimum Education, Experience, and Training Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Environmental Planning, Community Planning, Environmental Science or related natural resource field. Computer training and valid PA driver's license required. Extensive job experience may be substituted for educational requirements.

  • Working experience preferred but not required.

  • This position requires an individual with a strong interest and concern for water resource issues and the ability to relate this interest to others.

  • Must have strong presentation skills to effectively communicate ideas and information to individuals and groups of all sizes.

  • Knowledge and understanding of the organization and function of local governments including the municipal planning code and planning regulations such as zoning, subdivision and land development ordinances, etc.

  • Ability and willingness to stay current with advancing technology relating to water quality issues.

  • Skill in use of correct grammar and English.

  • Ability to work to close detail with minimal supervision.

  • Ability to manage, organize and coordinate multiple projects under moderately stressful guidelines and deadlines.

  • Ability to effectively communicate both orally and in writing to individuals and groups.

  • Ability to establish and maintain effective work relationships with the public and co-workers.

  • Ability to learn and apply technical information in a practical manner.

Preferred: 2 years of nursing experience in Perinatal Services

Required: Current state licenses and certifications. AHA BLS, AHA ACLS, & NRP.

title: Oracle Cloud HCM Solutions Architect (1658)
description:
Oracle Cloud HCM Solutions Architect

Full-Time, Permanent

ABOUT HIGHSTREET

Highstreet helps public sector organizations modernize through Oracle Cloud technology and services. With more than 30 years of public sector experience, we combine deep Oracle expertise with a client-focused approach to delivering successful transformations. We offer a progressive work environment along with a comprehensive and competitive benefits package. highstreetit.com

OVERVIEW

The Oracle Cloud HCM Solutions Architect will provide solution architecture leadership for a full life cycle Oracle Cloud implementation for a public sector K-12 client located in Maryland. This role will own the overall HCM solution architecture and guide the design, configuration, validation, testing, deployment, and stabilization of the Oracle Cloud HCM solution and its integrations with Payroll, Financials, and related applications.

The Solutions Architect will define and safeguard the end-to-end HCM solution and serve as a senior subject matter expert across multiple Oracle Cloud HCM modules, including Global Human Resources, Benefits, Compensation, Talent Management, Recruiting, Learning, and related capabilities. The role combines hands-on Oracle Cloud expertise, architectural vision, public sector HCM process knowledge, and strong client-facing leadership to deliver an integrated, scalable solution aligned with the client’s objectives and Oracle leading practices.

State, Local, and Education (SLED) experience, particularly with public sector K-12 organizations, is highly preferred but not required. Travel to the client site in Maryland Monday through Thursday may be required.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES

• Serve as the lead architect for the Oracle Cloud HCM solution, guiding the workstream through discovery, requirements, solution design, configuration, conference room pilots, testing, deployment, stabilization, and transition to support.

• Define and own the end-to-end HCM solution architecture across Global Human Resources, Benefits, Compensation, Talent Management, Recruiting, Learning, and other assigned HCM capabilities.

• Facilitate client workshops, gather and document business requirements, lead fit-gap analysis, and recommend solution approaches and process improvements using Oracle leading practices.

• Own the HCM solution design and key configuration decisions, including enterprise structures, security and role design, workflows, approvals, and cross-functional dependencies; document design decisions, setups, and their rationale.

• Partner with Payroll, Financials, technical, integration, data, reporting, security, organizational change management, and testing leads to deliver an integrated Oracle Cloud solution architecture.

• Define the architecture and functional requirements for integrations, conversions, extensions, reports, and third-party systems; convey designs to technical teams and review deliverables for alignment with the approved solution.

• Define the testing strategy and scenarios; guide system integration testing, user acceptance testing, defect resolution, and client validation activities to confirm the solution meets the approved design.

• Support organizational change, knowledge transfer, client training, and end-user readiness activities associated with the HCM implementation.

• Provide architectural and functional leadership during cutover, go-live, stabilization, and post-production support, including issue triage, root-cause analysis, and resolution of complex client escalations.

• Provide design guidance and mentoring to onshore and offshore functional and technical resources, review deliverables for design integrity, and hold resources accountable for quality and schedule commitments.

• Communicate status, risks, issues, dependencies, scope impacts, decisions, and recommendations to the Project Manager, Project Director, client workstream leaders, and executive stakeholders.

• Identify design requirements or decisions that affect scope and support the development and evaluation of change requests.

• Stay current on Oracle Cloud HCM quarterly releases and recommend opportunities for optimization, continuous improvement, and adoption of new functionality to evolve the solution roadmap.

• Support proposals, estimates, solution demonstrations, and business development activities by providing Oracle Cloud HCM solution architecture expertise as needed.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS

• 10+ years of Oracle HCM implementation experience, including substantial experience designing solutions with Oracle Cloud HCM.

• Experience leading solution design for at least three full life cycle Oracle Cloud HCM implementations, with hands-on configuration experience.

• Experience serving as a solutions architect or functional lead on at least two Oracle Cloud HCM implementations.

• Broad functional expertise across multiple Oracle Cloud HCM modules, with strong knowledge of Global Human Resources and Benefits.

• Ability to architect the end-to-end HCM solution and manage dependencies across HCM modules, Payroll, Financials, integrations, data, reporting, and security.

• Working knowledge of Oracle Cloud HCM integration, data, and reporting tools and approaches, such as HCM Data Loader, HCM Extracts, BI Publisher/OTBI, and Oracle Integration Cloud, along with security and role design.

• Hands-on experience leading requirements gathering, fit-gap analysis, solution design, configuration, conference room pilots, testing, training, deployment, and post-go-live support.

• Ability to translate client requirements into scalable Oracle Cloud solution designs and clearly explain solution options, trade-offs, risks, and impacts.

• Experience developing solution design documents, configuration workbooks, process flows, integration designs, testing scenarios, and user-facing materials.

• Strong client-facing consulting, facilitation, presentation, stakeholder management, and decision-driving skills.

• Experience guiding functional and technical teams in an onshore/offshore delivery model and collaborating across workstreams.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, analytical, organizational, mentoring, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work independently, manage multiple assignments, take initiative, and deliver under pressure in a fast-moving consulting environment.

• Bachelor’s degree in human resources, information technology, business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

• SLED experience, particularly with public sector K-12 school systems, higher education institutions, or other government organizations.

• Knowledge of Oracle HR Help Desk, Case Management, Compensation, Recruiting, Talent Management, Learning, and related HCM capabilities.

• Experience with public sector HCM requirements, including complex organizational structures, collective bargaining considerations, position management, benefits administration, and regulatory reporting.

• Experience with Oracle Cloud release 20 or later and current quarterly release functionality.

• Experience working for a systems integrator or consulting organization and leading client-facing delivery teams.

• One or more Oracle Cloud HCM certifications, such as Global Human Resources, Recruiting, Compensation, Talent Management, Learning, or Benefits Implementation Specialist, and/or Oracle Cloud architecture or integration certifications.

title: Assistant Property Manager
description:
About Us:

The Property Management Company, Inc (The PMC, Inc) is a nationwide full-service real estate platform focused on acquisition, asset management, property management and development. Our current property portfolio consists of around 8,000 apartments and townhomes, with a focus on providing affordable housing for seniors and persons with disabilities. We also own and manage a diverse and growing portfolio of other real estate assets covering traditional multifamily rentals, office and light industrial uses. The PMC, Inc employs around 400 Teammates in 30 states across the country – and we’re growing!

As we enter the next phase of our company’s growth, we’re looking for Teammates who can help us optimize our existing management platform (systems, tools and processes), better leverage technology, and maintain our reputation for excellence. We are looking for ambitious self-starters who aren’t afraid to dig in. We value excellent communication and collaboration, and we reward those who challenge the status quo to find better ways of doing things. We believe that people learn best by doing – so although we offer a full range of classroom learning and structured training paths, we prioritize hands on experience and self-directed development.

We’re proud of the people-first company culture we’ve built over the past two and a half decades – we’ll stretch and challenge you, and we’ll let you be you. We Say Yes to Uniqueness: We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer. Our commitment to equal opportunity extends to all applicants and The PMC, Inc Teammates, regardless of national origin, race, sex, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other class protected by the laws in the states where we operate.

About you:

The Assistant Property Manager is responsible for supporting the Property Manager in the overall management of the property. Key responsibilities include accounts receivable, rent collection, recertifications, and the processing of accounts payable invoices. The Assistant Property Manager also serves as the acting Property Manager in the absence of the Property Manager, ensuring that the property continues to operate efficiently and effectively.

Key Responsibilities:

Financial and Accounts Management:

• Oversee rent collection, ensuring all rents are received on time, accurately recorded, and accounted for in the property’s financial systems.

• Monitor delinquent accounts and follow up with residents on past-due balances, implementing collection procedures when necessary, including initiating payment plans and pursuing legal actions when required.

• Assist the Property Manager in preparing monthly financial reports, including tracking rent roll, late fees, and other revenue streams, ensuring accurate and timely reporting to corporate accounting.

• Process accounts payable invoices by reviewing, coding, and entering them into the system for approval and payment, maintaining up-to-date records for vendors and contractors.

• Reconcile financial discrepancies related to rent payments or invoicing, ensuring accuracy in financial reporting and timely resolution of issues.

Resident Recertifications and Compliance:

• Manage the resident recertification process, ensuring timely completion of all required paperwork for income verification, employment records, and other necessary documentation for HUD and LIHTC compliance.

• Conduct annual and interim recertifications, working closely with residents to gather necessary documentation, explain program requirements, and ensure timely submission to meet regulatory deadlines.

• Ensure all resident files are up to date with accurate and complete documentation, maintaining compliance with all affordable housing programs, including Section 8 and LIHTC requirements.

• Prepare for and assist with regulatory inspections and audits, ensuring the property is compliant with all local, state, and federal housing regulations.

• Assist the Property Manager with maintaining compliance-related records and documents, including REAC inspections, file audits, and HUD reporting requirements.

Property Operations and Resident Relations:

• Assist in the overall management of the property’s daily operations, ensuring smooth collaboration between leasing, maintenance, and resident service teams.

• Act as the Property Manager’s deputy, stepping in to lead the property team in their absence and ensuring continuity of operations, including handling resident issues, overseeing staff, and managing property needs.

• Support leasing efforts by assisting with showing units, processing applications, and preparing lease agreements, ensuring compliance with fair housing laws and company policies.

• Work with residents to address their concerns, respond to inquiries, and ensure all service requests are handled promptly and professionally.

• Assist with the organization and coordination of community events, promoting positive resident engagement and fostering a strong sense of community.

Vendor and Contract Administration:

• Assist with the coordination and management of vendor services, ensuring all service contracts are properly tracked, invoices are processed, and services are delivered in accordance with the agreed-upon terms.

• Collaborate with the Maintenance Team to ensure that vendors complete necessary repairs and services on time and to the required quality standards.

• Assist the Property Manager in tracking contract renewals, vendor performance, and compliance with insurance and licensing requirements.

• Oversee the procurement of property supplies and materials, ensuring cost-effectiveness and maintaining adequate stock levels.

Accounts Payable and Budget Support:

• Process vendor invoices, ensuring proper coding and timely payment, and maintain accurate records of payments made to vendors and contractors.

• Assist the Property Manager in preparing the property’s annual operating budget, including input on anticipated expenses, capital improvements, and vendor service agreements.

• Monitor actual expenses against budgeted amounts, identifying discrepancies and working with the Property Manager to address variances.

• Track utility usage and expenses, ensuring accuracy in billing and making recommendations to reduce costs where possible.

Compliance and Risk Management:

• Ensure the property remains in compliance with all local, state, and federal housing regulations, including fair housing laws, affordable housing program requirements, and safety standards.

• Conduct regular reviews of resident files, lease agreements, and recertification documents to ensure compliance with HUD, LIHTC, and other affordable housing programs.

• Assist with preparing for inspections by regulatory agencies, lenders, or investors, ensuring that all necessary documentation is complete and accurate.

• Help maintain risk management protocols by ensuring all resident and property-related incidents are documented, reported, and addressed in accordance with company policies.

Resident and Leasing Support:

• Assist with all leasing activities, including showing available units to prospective residents, preparing lease agreements, and processing applications.

• Ensure all leasing activities comply with fair housing laws and company policies, providing equal opportunities for all prospective residents.

• Help maintain occupancy levels by following up with prospects, conducting outreach efforts, and assisting in marketing efforts to attract new residents.

• Support resident retention initiatives by responding to resident needs, resolving issues, and fostering a positive living environment.

Property Inspections and Maintenance Coordination:

• Conduct regular property inspections to ensure that the property meets cleanliness, safety, and maintenance standards.

• Assist in coordinating maintenance and repair requests, ensuring that work orders are completed efficiently and to the satisfaction of the residents.

• Monitor the quality of unit turns, ensuring that vacant units are rent-ready in a timely manner and meet company standards for condition and appearance.

• Work with the Maintenance Team to develop and implement preventative maintenance schedules and ensure the timely completion of required maintenance tasks.

title: Rehabilitation Technician
description:
Title: Rehabilitation Technician

Job Type: Full time

Your experience matters!

At The Hospitals of Providence Rehabilitation Hospital East, we are driven by a profound commitment to prioritize your well-being so you can provide exceptional care to others. Here, you’re not just valued as an employee, but as a person.

The Hospitals of Providence Rehabilitation Hospital East in El Paso, Texas, is a dedicated inpatient rehab facility focused on helping patients regain independence after serious illness, injury, or surgery.

  • 24/7 Availability: Open around the clock to support patients through every stage of recovery.

  • Comprehensive Rehab Services: Offers intensive physical, occupational, and speech therapy for individuals recovering from stroke, brain injury, orthopedic trauma, and other complex conditions.

As a Rehabilitation Technician joining our team, you’re embracing a vital mission dedicated to making communities healthier. Join us on this meaningful journey where your skills, compassion, and dedication will make a remarkable difference in the lives of those we serve.

How you’ll contribute

Supports the rehabilitation team by carrying out patient care activities as directed by an OTR/RPT, including safe patient transport, treatment preparation, and observation of patient response. Communicates effectively with therapists and team members, follows written and verbal instructions, and maintains a safe, organized environment to promote optimal patient outcomes.

Essential Functions

  • Follow patient care tasks as determined by the OTR/RPT to help patients achieve therapy goals.
  • Safely transport patients to and from therapy and other activities.
  • Communicate clearly (verbally and in writing) with members of the rehabilitation team.
  • Observe and recognize patient reactions to treatment; follow instructions accurately.
  • Lift and carry equipment, supplies, and materials up to 50 lbs on a regular basis; use proper body mechanics.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Additional Information

Works under the direction and supervision of licensed therapists within established policies and procedures. Maintains cleanliness and readiness of therapy areas, equipment, and supplies. Adheres to safety, infection prevention, and patient privacy standards.

Qualifications and requirements:

Education: High school diploma or equivalent.

Experience: 6–12 months of relevant experience in a rehabilitation setting strongly recommended; willing to participate in on-the-job training after orientation.

Certifications: CPR certification (as required).

Skills/Abilities: Effective verbal and written communication; ability to follow directions; patient transport and safe lifting techniques (up to 50 lbs); observation and basic documentation; reliability, teamwork, and time management.

About us
The Hospitals of Providence Rehabilitation Hospital East is located in El Paso, TX, and is part of Lifepoint Health, a diversified healthcare delivery network committed to making communities healthier® with acute care, rehabilitation, and behavioral health facilities from coast to coast. From your first day to your next career milestone—your experience matters.

title: Service Desk Specialist I
description:
Job Summary

The Service Desk Specialist will be responsible for providing Level 1 and/or Level 2 technical support and customer service for internal employees and will serve as the primary point of contact for all IT related requests and technical problems. In addition, the Service Desk Specialist will receive and categorize all incoming Help Desk emails and phone calls; ensuring requests and problems are clearly identified and documented within the help desk ticket tracking database. The successful Service Desk Specialist must be a flexible problem solver for both technical and procedural inquiries and take responsibility for escalating unresolved requests/problems to the appropriate technical support teams. The Service Desk Specialist position includes 2 levels based on experience (Level I designated for representatives with 1-2 yrs. of help desk experience and the Level II is for those with 2-4+ yrs. of experience).

Key Responsibilities

1. Ability to effectively communicate technical and non-technical information to various audiences.
2. Effectively utilizes the IT Department Change Management process when adding new equipment or making changes that could impact the production network environment.
3. Maintains effective lines of communication with all IT Department staff to research problems, repeated incidents, and documentation of solutions.
4. Maintains ongoing education in the technology industry, participating in both company sponsored training and/or external vendor lead courses.
5. Manages all incoming emails, tickets, and phone calls to the help desk by correctly identifying, documenting, and categorizing issues within the ticket database.
6. May test software and/or hardware to provide feedback on ease of use, bugs and conflicts, suitability to task, or provide specific configuration suggestions. Assist with the development of end user training materials.
7. Provide basic-to-intermediate PC software and/or hardware systems support via telephone, e-mail, and remote-control sessions.
8. Provides a positive customer experience with exceptional listening skills. Represents the IT department as a trusted and reliable resource by supplying accurate information in a confident and professional manner.
9. Provides application and computer troubleshooting to local and remote users. Contributes to the formal documentation of technical problems and corresponding resolutions.
10. Provides end user technical assistance for company supported software applications, hardware, and hand held devices. Ensures maximum issue resolution in minimal amount of time and escalates unresolved requests and problems to higher level support groups.

Minimum Job Requirements

1. Ability to answer, troubleshoot and document support calls and tickets.
2. Ability to work independently with minimum direction and to succeed in a rapidly changing environment.
3. Capable of diagnosing and resolving basic technical issues.
4. Competent in use of Windows 10 operating system and desktop software applications including Office 365, Microsoft Teams and web browsers.
5. High School Diploma and a minimum of 1-2 years IT support experience (Level I) or 2-4 years (Level 11) or a combination of training and experience.
6. Knowledge of how to effectively use Active Directory.
7. Knowledgeable in PC laptops, components, peripherals, and iOS mobile devices.
8. Superior communications, planning and organizational skills.

Note: Job Description is subject to change at any time and may include other duties as assigned.

Physical Requirements

1. May stoop, kneel, or bend, on an occasional basis
2. Must be able to comply with all safety standards and procedures
3. Required to use hands to grasp, lift, handle, carry or feel objects on a frequent basis
4. Will interact with people and technology frequently during a shift/work day
5. Will lift, push or pull objects up to 50lbs on an occasional basis.
6. Will sit, stand or walk short distances for up to the entire duration of a shift/work day.
7. Will use telephone, computer system, email, and other electronic devices on a frequent basis to communicate with internal and external customers or vendors

Safety Level

Non-Safety Sensitive

Note: Jobs with the Safety-Sensitive designation are those that include tasks or duties that the employer reasonably believes could affect the safety and health of the employee performing the task or others such as operating a vehicle, operating equipment, operating machinery or power tools, repairing/maintaining the operation of any vehicle/equipment, the handling/disposal/transport of hazardous materials, or the handling/treatment/disposal of potentially flammable/combustible materials.

title: NLCC Systems Engineer, Lead

With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future.

The DISA/CIO Department is looking for an experienced systems engineer to contribute to MITRE’s support to DISA’s NLCC Project. title: Staff Real-Time Embedded Software Developer
description:
If you are a Staff Real-Time Embedded Software Developer professional looking for an opportunity to grow your career, Emerson has an exciting opportunity for you. In this role, you will provide technical leadership within the DeltaV Controller team, helping to shape the future of a leading industrial automation platform. You will leverage your expertise in real-time embedded systems to solve complex technical challenges, drive software innovation, and enhance the reliability, performance, and scalability of DeltaV controllers. This is an opportunity to collaborate with cross-functional teams, mentor engineers, and make a lasting impact on technologies that support critical industrial operations worldwide.

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:

  • Design, develop, test, debug, and optimize embedded real-time software using C/C++ for DeltaV controller platforms.
  • Define and evolve software architectures, components, and interfaces that support maintainability, scalability, and long-term product success.
  • Analyze and resolve complex technical challenges involving real-time performance, determinism, concurrency, memory management, scheduling, and system reliability.
  • Advance engineering excellence through effective software design practices, code reviews, automated testing, diagnostics, and continuous integration and deployment methodologies.
  • Explore and utilize AI-assisted engineering tools and technologies to improve productivity, quality, and innovation across the software development lifecycle.
  • Collaborate closely with hardware, systems, testing, cybersecurity, product management, and customer-facing teams to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions.
  • Provide technical leadership by mentoring team members, sharing expertise, facilitating technical discussions, and helping guide engineering decisions.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen development processes, product quality, and customer outcomes.
  • Support the evolution of DeltaV controller technologies through innovative problem-solving and technical insight.

Who You Are:

You anticipate future possibilities and translate them into innovative solutions that create long-term value. You effectively analyze complex and sometimes conflicting information to solve problems and make sound decisions. You build partnerships and work collaboratively with others to achieve shared objectives, fostering an environment of trust, respect, and inclusion. You develop and support others by sharing knowledge, providing guidance, and creating opportunities for growth while championing high standards of technical excellence.

For This Role, You Will Need:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related STEM discipline plus 15+ years of experience or 12 years of experience with a Master’s degree.
  • Significant experience developing embedded real-time software for industrial automation, process control, or other high-reliability environments.
  • Strong proficiency in C/C++ software development.
  • Deep understanding of real-time operating systems and concepts including multitasking, scheduling, synchronization, interrupts, and memory management.
  • Experience diagnosing and resolving complex hardware and software integration challenges.
  • Strong software design and architecture capabilities, including experience with automated testing, version control systems, and code review practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives, mentor colleagues, and communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders.
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States without sponsorship now or in the future.

Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:

  • Experience with DeltaV, distributed control systems (DCS), or process automation technologies.
  • Experience working with RT Linux or other real-time operating systems.
  • Experience utilizing AI-assisted software development tools within engineering workflows.
  • Knowledge of fault-tolerant or redundant system architectures.
  • Familiarity with industrial networking, functional safety, and cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience influencing technical direction and contributing to strategic product development initiatives.
  • Advanced degree in a related technical field.

Our Culture and Commitment To You:

At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. title: Systems Engineer, Land C5ISR - Tactical Communications
description:
We are currently looking for an Intermediate Systems Engineering Analyst to help shape the evolution of the Land Command Support System (LCSS) network supporting the Canadian Armed Forces’ Land C5ISR-T (Command, Control, Communications, Computers, Cyber, Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance – Targeting) program. In this role, you will work with the Tactical Communications (TacComms) Network Systems Engineering team to design and improve the LCSS network to support the exchange of voice and data between Canadian Army members over a range of wireless and wired links.

What You’ll Do

  • Engage with the customer, the Department of National Defence (DND) to elicit and define system expectations for desired capabilities.
  • Obtain agreement with the customer on the scope and boundaries of the problem space for the desired capabilities
  • Interface with User Experience and Mission Specialist (former Canadian Army personnel) to understand user needs
  • Design networking solutions to switch/route traffic between the various elements of the Canadian Army (Headquarters elements, Fighting/Support vehicles, dismounted soldiers) to support the exchange of voice and data over a range of bearer devices (i.e., wired or wireless links that carry voice and data between elements)
  • Develop activity, sequence, use case, and block definition diagrams using Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) techniques to describe the configuration of the LCSS network and the flow of information through the LCSS network.
  • Develop system requirements, interface specifications and design documents for the software providing LCSS network functions.
  • Manage the traceability of higher-level requirements to lower-level requirements and to test artifacts.
  • Provide guidance and support to the development teams for the implementation and revision of capabilities within LCSS.
  • Manage System Problem Reports (SPRs) and Observations by providing proper upfront analysis and input to support bug fixes as well as seeing the proper close out of each SPR.
  • Support integration and test activities, including reviewing test cases, analyzing results, and helping resolve discrepancies.
  • Participate in meetings and reviews with both internal teams and external stakeholders, presenting insights and recommendations.
  • Take ownership of deliverables and contribute to meeting key program milestones and commitments.

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Engineering (Electrical, Computer, Engineering Physics, etc.), Computer Science, or applicable scientific discipline is required.
  • 2+ years of applicable system engineering or related experience.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, including the ability to perform technical analysis, root cause investigation and communicating the result.
  • Demonstrated initiative and strong verbal and written communications skills.
  • The ability to work effectively both independently and in a team environment, with minimum supervision.
  • Enthusiastic contributor, willing to learn new skills, and takes ownership of assigned work.
  • Demonstrated capability of meeting commitments and delivering high quality work product.

Assets

  • Exposure to enterprise or tactical networking concepts, including Ethernet, IP networking, VLANs, and wireless communication principles.
  • Knowledge of unicast and multicast routing protocols and/or the configuration of Cisco based network solutions.
  • Experience in requirements development and system design.
  • Experience and working knowledge of systems engineering tools including UML/SysML diagrams (sequence, activity, etc.), Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) Tools (e.g., Enterprise Architect, Rhapsody, Cameo), DOORS/IBM Engineering Requirements Management (ERM), IBM Engineering Workflow Manager (EWM) and Team collaboration tools (e.g., MS Teams, Sharepoint, OneNote, etc.).
  • Experience supporting integration, verification, and validation activities at the system or subsystem level.
  • Familiarity with Agile or iterative development methodologies.
  • Service (Reserve or Regular) in any branch of the Canadian Armed Forces.

The hiring range for this position is $85,000-$92,000.Our goal is to provide a fair and competitive offer based on an assessment of internal equity and your qualifications, including:

  • Relevant experience
  • Technical and non-technical skills
  • Education and certifications

Benefits
As a full-time employee at General Dynamics Mission Systems–Canada, you’ll enjoy a competitive total rewards package that supports your professional and personal well-being:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and eligible dependents from day one (no cost), including flexible benefits options (HCSA) emergency travel insurance, and 24/7 virtual care services.
  • Employee & Family Assistance Program (EFAP), onsite fitness facilities, and employee resource groups.
  • Defined Contribution Pension Plan with employer contributions after 3 months, RRSP access from day one, and financial planning support.
  • Flexible time off including vacation, holidays, parental leaves with top-up options, sick leave, and disability programs.
  • Career development through learning platforms, educational assistance, mentoring, and reimbursement of professional memberships.
  • Additional perks such as employee discounts, free onsite parking, social clubs, and an annual scholarship program for employees’ children.

Why join us?

  • Purposeful Innovation: You’ll work on innovations that genuinely make a difference. You’ll apply advanced thinking, design expertise, and practical problem-solving to help equip military and allied forces with leading-edge systems. You’ll be surrounded by some of the brightest minds in the defence sector, contributing to next-generation technologies in an environment that celebrates creativity, new ideas, and modern solutions.
  • Connection: We believe people do their best work when they feel they belong, and their ideas can flourish. Different perspectives, experiences, and ways of thinking help us innovate and grow. Strong relationships with our teammates help us unite, overcome challenges, and deliver the world-class quality we’re known for. Here, we are committed to inclusivity and ensures every individual feels valued, respected, and empowered.
  • Challenging and Rewarding Career Pathways: Your career path matters to us. From mentorship and regular check-ins with your leader to educational support, professional certifications, and continuous training, you’ll have the resources you need to thrive. We encourage internal mobility so you can explore different business areas, broaden your skillset, and expand your network. You’ll be working on high-profile, impactful projects that challenge your skills, expand your expertise, and allow you to both learn from mentors and guide others along the way.

Accommodation
If you require accommodation during any stage of the application process, please contact Human Resources via recruitment@gd-ms.ca.

Closing Date
We reserve the right to close this vacancy early if we receive sufficient applications for the role. Therefore, if you are interested, please submit your application as early as possible.

title: Corporate PPA Originator
description:
⚡️ What We Do

Flower is Flexible Power. We are a next-gen energy company leveraging AI and machine learning to make renewable energy stable and always available – even when the sun isn’t shining and the wind isn’t blowing.

Through smart optimization and trading of energy assets like wind and solar farms, battery systems, and EV chargers, we make renewable energy reliable and predictable, leading the charge towards the energy system of tomorrow.

🌟 Who We Are

Tech company at heart. Purpose-driven at core. Flower consists of a diverse group of innovative individuals with a strong desire to improve the state of the world.

At Flower, we believe trust, collaboration and diversity are essential to not only create an inclusive work environment, but also drive career growth. By embracing varying perspectives, we allow creativity and progress to flourish.

To accelerate towards our goal of becoming the pioneering force powering the energy system of tomorrow, we are now looking for an experienced Corporate PPA Originator to join us.

👩‍💻 About The Role

As Corporate PPA Originator, you’ll build the relationships and find the opportunities that bring long-term electricity contracts to Flower. You’ll be our PPA specialist for large energy buyers, understanding their price, risk and sustainability needs and turning them into solutions that work for both the customer and Flower.

You’ll own the journey from first contact to signed contract: identifying and qualifying opportunities, developing offers and leading commercial negotiations. Your focus will be Sweden, with opportunities across other European markets where Flower operates.

This is a role for someone who enjoys being out in the market—meeting customers, attending industry events and discovering opportunities in new places. You’ll bring an established network and the drive to build on it, connecting with energy-intensive businesses such as industrial companies, data centres, retailers and real estate groups.

You won’t work alone. You’ll partner closely with colleagues across Flower, including quantitative and structuring specialists who support pricing and more complex deal design. Together, you’ll create PPA solutions that complement our renewable energy and battery storage portfolio.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and own a pipeline of corporate PPA opportunities, from identifying new leads through to negotiation and signing

  • Develop relationships with customers’ procurement, energy, sustainability and finance teams, as well as advisors, brokers and other market participants

  • Shape commercial offers around customers’ needs, working with internal specialists on pricing, risk and deal structure

  • Lead negotiations on price, volume, duration, delivery profile, credit support and key contract terms, coordinating internal approvals and working cross-functionally on agreements

  • Represent Flower in the PPA and energy-buyer community, share market insights, maintain accurate pipeline forecasts and identify opportunities to offer Flower’s flexibility and BESS solutions

Who You Are

You’re a relationship builder and opportunity hunter who knows how to turn conversations into long-term commercial partnerships. You enjoy finding new ways into a market, take ownership of your targets and pipeline, and bring colleagues together to get a deal over the line.

We believe you have:

  • Several years of experience in energy origination, energy sales or a related commercial role, for example at a utility, IPP, trader, aggregator or PPA advisory firm

  • A proven track record of closing electricity PPAs with corporate buyers, ideally in Sweden

  • A strong, active network among corporate energy buyers, advisors and market participants in Sweden and the Nordics

  • Solid knowledge of Nordic and wider European power markets, strong negotiation and deal-structuring skills, and sound judgement when balancing customer needs with margin and risk

  • A degree in business, economics, engineering, energy or a related field, and fluency in Swedish and English

Relevant training or certifications in energy trading, risk or contract negotiation are a plus.

In this role, you will work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, project managers, developers, QA teams, and other IT professionals to translate business requirements into clear, actionable technical specifications.

You will play a key role in analyzing business processes, identifying system enhancements, documenting requirements, and supporting the delivery of secure, efficient, and customer-focused banking solutions.
