title: Master Scheduler
description:
Position Summary: The Master Planner / Scheduler is responsible for developing, maintaining, and executing the master production schedule for a precision CNC machining job shop supporting defense programs. This role translates customer orders and contract requirements into an optimized, achievable shop schedule while balancing machine and labor capacity, material availability, outside processes, and compliance demands (ITAR, DFARS, AS9100). The position is the central coordination point between sales, engineering, production, procurement, and quality and requires strong analytical skills and deep technical experience with ERP/MRP systems and capacity planning. JobBOSS experience preferred. In addition, this role requires exceptional communication skills to effectively align cross-functional stakeholders and clearly convey schedule status, risks, and trade-offs. A high level of data analytics and computer proficiency is essential to interpret complex production data, drive decision-making, and continuously improve scheduling performance.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Develop and maintain the master production schedule for CNC milling, turning, and related operations in a job shop environment (finite and rough-cut capacity planning).
  • Translate purchase orders, contract line items, and delivery schedules into work orders, routings, and production priorities within the ERP/MRP system.
  • Optimize ERP data (routings, lead times, work center capacities) to improve schedule accuracy and throughput; lead ERP-related scheduling improvements and best practices.
  • Monitor WIP and schedule adherence; proactively identify and resolve delays, bottlenecks, and capacity constraints.
  • Coordinate with procurement to align raw materials, tooling, and outside processing (heat treat, plating, NDT) with production timing.
  • Sequence work with engineering and quality to accommodate first-article inspections, PPAP/FAI, and process qualifications.
  • Communicate schedule status, risks, and changes to production supervisors, program managers, procurement, and customers. Elevate communication by delivering clear, concise, and actionable updates tailored to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Analyze machine and labor capacity data to inform decisions on overtime, outside processing, or capital investment; identify and manage bottleneck work centers. Leverage advanced data analysis to identify trends, forecast constraints, and support proactive decision-making.
  • Support contract review and order-entry processes to ensure promised delivery dates are realistic.
  • Track and report key scheduling metrics (on-time delivery, schedule adherence, capacity utilization) and provide capacity vs. demand analysis for Sales &Operational Planning/Sales, inventory, &Operational Planning. Develop and enhance reporting tools, dashboards, and data visualizations to improve visibility and decision-making.
  • Ensure scheduling practices and documentation meet defense industry and export control requirements (ITAR, DFARS, AS9100).
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance scheduling accuracy and production flow. Utilize data-driven methodologies to drive continuous improvement and operational excellence.
  • Maintain proper traceability and documentation standards required for defense programs.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, industrial engineering, operations management, business, or related field — or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum 5 years’ production planning/scheduling experience in machining, manufacturing, aerospace, or defense environments (job shop experience strongly preferred).
  • Demonstrated experience with ERP/MRP systems (JobBOSS preferred; Epicor, SAP, IQMS or similar acceptable). Proven ability to optimize ERP scheduling data and workflows.
  • Strong understanding of CNC machining processes, capacity planning, routing, and manufacturing lead times.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and scheduling tools; familiarity with finite capacity planning. Strong analytical and data interpretation skills, with advanced Excel capabilities and experience using data analysis or visualization tools.
  • Familiarity with AS9100, ITAR, DFARS, and other defense industry quality/compliance requirements preferred.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills; high attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and clearly articulate complex scheduling and capacity concepts. Ability to prioritize and manage competing demands in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Experience building or improving dashboards, reporting tools, or data models to support planning and scheduling.
  • U.S. Person status may be required for ITAR/export-controlled work.

Physical Requirements & Work Environment

  • Primarily office-based with regular shop-floor interaction and inspections.
  • Ability to sit or stand for extended periods and occasionally lift up to 25 lbs.
  • Minimal travel; occasional supplier or customer visits may be required.

Supervisory Responsibilities: May oversee planning/scheduling support staff depending on organizational structure.

Travel Required: N/A

title: Director of Front Office
description:

Responsible for all front office functions and staff as well as security staff functions. Areas of responsibility include Bell Staff, Switchboard Operations, Guest Services/Front Desk, Retail/Gift Shop, Concierge, Valets, and Security, as applicable. As a department head, directs and works with managers and employees to successfully execute all front office operations, including guest arrival and departure procedures. Works to establish a safe and secure environment for all guests and associates. Strives to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction and maximize the financial performance of the department.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

• High school diploma or GED; 6 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area.

OR

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration or related major; 4 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area.

Leading Front Desk, Guest Services, and Security Teams

• Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.

• Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.

• Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.

• Supervises and manages employees. Manages all day-to-day operations. Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees' absence.

• Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.

• Ensures recognition of employees is taking place across areas of responsibility.

• Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position and monitors progress.

• Celebrates successes and publicly recognizes the contributions of team members.

Managing Guest Services and Front Desk Teams

• Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish work.

• Keeps Front Office team focused on the critical components of operations to drive guest satisfaction and the desired financial results.

• Conducts department meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding department goals to produce desired results.

• Supervises and coordinates all activities for luggage attendants, garage valets, door attendants, and concierge.

• Reviews staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and financial objectives are met.

• Understands the impact of Front Office operations on the Rooms area and overall property financial goals.

• Manages department controllable expenses to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.

• Provide recommendations and reports for capital expenditures, repairs and maintenance programs for all front office areas.

Managing Security Team

• Protects property and provides a safe environment for guests and staff.

• Verifies property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.

• Coordinates activities with other hotel departments in order to facilitate incrased levels of communication and guest satisfaction.

• Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.

• Supervises and managing employees. Managing all day-to-day operations. Understanding employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees' absence.

• Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.

• Establishes challenging, realistic and obtainable goals to guide operation and performance.

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
TransCore (TRN), a subsidiary of ST Engineering, is seeking a Principal Software Engineer to join our growing Smart Mobility Ecosystems team and help shape the architecture and technical direction of our next generation of mobility solutions.

Location: Atlanta

About the Role:
Passionate about the Smart Cities space? Interested in solving problems with how people move? Perhaps this is the role for you!

TransCore is seeking an experienced, hands-on Principal Software Engineer to help build the Smart Mobility Platform, the shared foundation for our Smart Mobility products with the intent to rethink how users move, providing innovative, user-friendly solutions to their day-to-day lives, reaching millions of users across the globe. This "zero to one" role is pivotal in building an entirely new product & ecosystem from scratch. You’ll serve as the platform subject matter expert for Smart Mobility engineering leadership and work closely with the full engineering group to shape technical direction, developing a high-quality, data-informed system to meet customer needs, support user growth & critical journeys, while unlocking new mobility use cases and verticals.

TransCore is uniquely positioned to have a huge impact in advancing smart cities & mobility and this role is uniquely positioned to achieve this vision. Join TransCore as we shape the future of smart cities and transportation tech.

This is an individual contributor role. You will not have direct reports. We are looking for a deep technical practitioner who leads through expertise, influence, and good engineering practice, with room to grow into a more senior technical or people-leadership role over time.

Key Responsibilities:

Be the hands-on technical authority for the Smart Mobility Platform and its expansion into a multi-modal mobility ecosystem. Requires deep expertise in cloud-native architecture, microservices, payment systems, and modern engineering practice.

  • Platform Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as the platform SME for Smart Mobility engineering leadership. Assess current engineering capabilities and architecture, and advise on the technology direction and standards we adopt going forward.
  • Hands-on Design & Implementation: Design, prototype, and implement cloud-native, microservices-based architectures, focusing on payment integration (PCI DSS), auto integrations, and API-first design to enable multi-vertical use cases as well as great end user experiences. Apply user-first thinking to determine other features or capabilities to build into the UI and ensure the architecture can support.
  • Scalability & Performance: Ensure high-performance, scalable systems for high-volume, real-time data processing.
  • Security & Compliance: Maintain system security and compliance with relevant regulations (PCI DSS, GDPR, etc.).
  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Work closely with product, platform, and application engineering teams to align designs, resolve cross-cutting technical issues, and keep teams on a consistent path.
  • Engineering Practices & Mentorship: Set and promote good practices (design reviews, code reviews, testing, observability, secure delivery), and mentor engineers across teams.

    Key Skills & Experience:

    • Expertise in cloud-native architecture (AWS, Azure, GCP), microservices, and event-driven systems; experience with high-volume, real-time data processing.
    • Proficiency in API design (RESTful/GraphQL) with experience showcasing applications across broad sets of use cases.
    • Strong working knowledge of modern engineering and DevOps practices, including CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and observability.
    • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including sustained experience as a technical lead across multiple teams or systems.

    Qualifications:

    • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field.
    • Typically requires 14+ years of combined relevant software engineering experience and advanced education, including sustained experience as a technical lead across multiple teams or systems.
    • Proven track record of technically leading “zero to one” initiatives, especially in tech-heavy, regulated industries like transportation or infrastructure.
    • Strong communication skills and a proven ability to influence and coordinate across teams without formal authority.
    • Currently working as a hands-on individual contributor. Candidates whose recent roles have been primarily people management should note this role writes and reviews code and designs.

    Preferred qualifications and experience:

    • Master’s degree or higher in Computer Science
    • Application of AI capabilities to improve workflow or deliver organizational efficiencies.
    • Knowledge of tolling, parking, or transportation technologies is a plus.
    • Experience working in cross-functional environments with a focus on platform SDK development.

    Physical Demands/Work Environment

    While performing the duties of this job, the employee may be seated for extended periods of time. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, and reach with hands and arms. The employee may occasionally lift and/or move up to 15 pounds. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

    * TransCore complies with federal and state disability laws and provides reasonable accommodation for employees with disabilities.

title: Counseling Administrator - Elementary
description:
Counseling Administrator - Elementary

Position Summary:

The District Counseling Administrator (Elementary) provides strategic leadership, coordination, and clinical oversight for elementary school counseling services across the district. This role ensures the effective implementation of comprehensive, data-driven school counseling programs that support elementary students' social-emotional development, academic success, and early career awareness, while ensuring compliance with state standards and district goals. and the delivery of Tiered behavioral health interventions for elementary students.

Essential Duties:

  1. Great Teaching & Learning (Instructional Infrastructure):
    • Provide specialized professional development and guidance to elementary counselors on social-emotional learning (SEL) curricula, trauma-informed practices, and early intervention strategies.
    • Mentor site-level counselors in classroom management support, behavior intervention plans, and positive behavioral interventions and supports (PBIS) integration.
    • Analyze district-wide outcome data to identify and address achievement, attendance, and opportunity gaps, ensuring equitable access to college and career readiness programming.
    • Assist in developing systems to track and monitor student success metrics.
    • Assist in developing and leading professional development to support counseling strategies and initiatives.
    • Support school counselors in utilizing data to drive student support strategies.
  2. Great People (Talent Management):
    • Coordinate counselor/teacher; counselor/parent; and any other scheduled conference or team meetings.
    • Ensures the support of District Counselors for District Counseling initiatives and compliance with tracking data.
    • Provide support for development of District and Site level comprehensive counseling frameworks and plans.
    • Assist in mentoring and supporting school counselors through monthly meetings designed to ensure the successful implementation of a school counseling program that aligns with American School Counselor Association (ASCA) standards. Facilitate monthly collaboration meetings with site counselors to promote consistency and continuous improvement.
    • Assist in monitoring state and national issues and trends related to mental health, academic, career, and social domains, and assist in providing professional development to educate staff.
    • Assist in providing individual training and onboarding support for newly assigned or hired counselors to ensure consistent processes across the district.
    • Coordinate with the Director of Mental Health to foster professional growth through training in trauma-informed practices, suicide prevention, and support for at-risk students.
    • Assist in providing updates to school sites regarding legislative updates related to school counseling.
  3. Great Culture (Systems Leaders):
    • Facilitate monthly collaborative meetings for elementary counselors to promote consistency in SEL implementation, crisis response protocols, and child safety education.
    • Coordinate elementary transition programs, ensuring smooth educational transitions for students entering kindergarten and moving from elementary to middle school.
    • Ensure and monitor all School Counselors have the required structures in place to meet students Tier 1-3 MTSS needs, including completing master schedules and student schedules in time for appropriate service delivery.
    • Helps to plan, monitor and support Counselors to ensure parent/family outreach is targeted and successful.
    • Ensure follow-up with families who have not been contacted or reached, and implement strategies to strengthen family communication and engagement based on the data.
    • Strengthen collaboration with families, community organizations, and mental health providers.
    • Ensure consistent implementation of crisis intervention, suicide prevention, and postvention protocols.
    • Promote inclusive and transparent systems to support the holistic development of all students.
    • Represent OKCPS in local, state, and national forums to remain current in the fields of mental health, counseling, and career readiness.
    • Maintain high levels of communication with site leaders to ensure alignment with district goals and emerging needs.
  4. Great Systems (Support & Accountability):
    • Respond to inquiries and provide assistance to staff, students and the public; schedule counseling appointments; answer telephone calls and provide information and assistance to callers, visitors, staff and students.
    • Prepare all routine correspondence as requested by the guidance department and/or administration.
    • Assist counselors with the process of monitoring student grades and submitting grade change requests; notify teachers, counselors and parents of academic issues.
    • Assist in developing systems for processing student grade report data and maintaining accurate student/staff schedules.
    • Assist in maintaining and updating all office files and a master calendar for guidance counselors and other coordinators.
    • Assist building administrators and guidance staff in processing forms, surveys, and other data as appropriate.
    • Perform other duties as assigned.

Job Specifications:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities required.

Minimum Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills and/or Abilities):

  • Master’s Degree in School Counseling, Educational Leadership, or a related field required.
  • Current Oklahoma School Counselor certification.
  • 3+ years of experience in elementary school counseling, educational administration, or related leadership roles.
  • Strong knowledge of elementary legislation and policies, elementary child development, SEL frameworks, MTSS/PBIS structures, and child protection policies.
  • Knowledge and experience working with computer hardware and software applications (Microsoft Office Suite) required.
  • Flexibility, initiative, and excellent organizational skills.

Physical/Mental Requirements:

  • Able to sit and/or stand for extended periods of time.
  • Exhibit manual dexterity to enter data into a computer.
  • Ability to see and read a computer screen and printed material with or without vision aids.
  • Hear and understand speech at normal classroom levels, outdoors and on the telephone.
  • Speak in audible tones so that others may understand clearly in normal classrooms, outdoors and on the telephone.
  • Physical agility, able to bend, stoop, sit on the floor, climb stairs, walk and reach.
  • Ability to lift, push, pull up to 25 pounds.

Work Environment:

  • Frequent use of personal vehicle for travel within and outside the district to meetings with community partners, advisory board meetings, trainings, outreach and engagement events, and other community-based meetings that are needed to ensure the success of the grant.
  • Office duties will be performed in a well-lighted, climate-controlled environment.
  • Will require time in office, as well as external meeting locations with community partners or schools throughout the OKC metro area.
  • Must maintain a consistent daily in-office presence during designated work hours and remain available to respond to school-site needs requiring in-person support.
  • Able to bend and stoop, lift 25lbs, stand and/or sit for extended periods of time.

Reports To: Director of Counseling

Compensation: 904 (Salary determined by experience.)

Work Days: 242

FTE: 1.0 (8 hours per day)

location: Palm Beach - West Palm Beach - West Palm Beach, FL 33401
description:
“Sanitas is a global healthcare organization expanding across the United States. Our services include primary care, urgent care, nutrition, lab, diagnostic, health care education and resources for our patients. We strive to attract professionals who believe in our mission, vision and are dedicated to the service of our patients and their families creating a memorable experience through compassion, respect, and kindness.”

Job Summary

The Patient Representative Coordinator (PRC) is the first point of contact for patients and visitors, ensuring a welcoming and professional experience. This role supports the patient journey through pre-visit planning, check-in, check-out, and post-visit follow-up while maintaining accurate records, protecting confidentiality, and complying with organizational and regulatory standards. The PRC demonstrates strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills to engage effectively with patients, staff, and leadership, contributing to efficient operations and service excellence.

Essential Job Functions

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Welcome and greet patients and visitors to the Medical Center in a friendly and professional manner; determines the purpose of their visit and directs them to the appropriate person or department as needed.
  • Review scheduled appointments to complete pre-visit planning; validate insurance eligibility in eCW; verify pharmacy information and designated PCP in Leap to support continuity of care; confirm and update copayment amounts and pending balances; contact patients to address eligibility issues or confirm attendance; validate patient contact information in Availity; and documents pre-visit planning completion.
  • For scheduled and walk - in patients, perform the check -in process; verify the patient’s scheduled appointment and visit type in eCW; scan and uploads identification and insurance cards; print and scan the Patient Registration Form; validate insurance eligibility; collect required copayments; update demographic information by asking the patient the required information (email, phone, address) in eCW; collect consents when applicable and update the visit status to confirm check-in completion.
  • Ensures patients are seen in a timely manner by monitoring schedules and workflows, minimizing wait times, and reducing the risk of patient dissatisfaction.
  • Perform check -out process; Review and update the patient’s general notes; If additional services were rendered for the patient review and collect copayment or pending balances as needed. confirm registered prescriptions, referrals, labs, and diagnostic imaging (including providing instructions and requirements as needed); schedule indicated follow-up appointments in eCW; update the visit status to confirm visit completion; and print lab and diagnostic imaging orders for the patient if requested.
  • Remains attentive to patients identified as very high and high risk, ensuring they receive appropriate follow-up, coordination, care programs enrollment and support to promote proper care and continuity of services.
  • Compile records, and maintain medical charts, reports, and correspondence in an accurate, organized, and confidential manner to ensure proper documentation and compliance with medical and organizational standards.
  • Protect patient confidentiality by ensuring protected health information (PHI) is secured at all times; avoid leaving PHI in plain sight; and log off computer systems before leaving workstations unattended, in compliance with privacy and security regulations.
  • Maintains a safe, secure, and healthy work environment by adhering to organizational standards and procedures, complying with all applicable legal and regulatory requirements, and keeping the workstation clean and organized at all times.
  • Ensures adequate processes adherence to workflows to prevent claim denials, supporting accurate billing, reimbursement, and compliance with payer requirements.
  • Performs post-visit calls to patients to ensure service recovery, address any concerns, and conduct NPS (Net Promoter Score) surveys, documenting outcomes to support continuous improvement and patient experience initiatives when required.
  • Provides support in ordering office supplies as needed, assisting with maintaining adequate stock levels to meet departmental requirements.
  • Monitors and reviews telephone encounters in the PRC bucket, ensuring timely follow-up and resolution of patient inquiries or requests.
  • Prepares and maintains the coffee and snacks station to provide a welcoming environment for patients, visitors, and staff.
  • Responds to patient questions in a courteous, accurate, and professional manner, ensuring clear communication and a positive service experience.
  • Actively participates in staff and departmental meetings, contributing to discussions, sharing feedback, and supporting team and organizational goals.
  • Consistently reports for duty on time and maintains reliable attendance to support smooth clinic operations and patient care continuity.
  • Ensures productivity by assisting the center in monitoring that the assigned patient population is seen throughout the year, verifying task completion, and maintaining accurate documentation to support operational efficiency and continuity of care.
  • Identifies patients expressing dissatisfaction and takes appropriate steps to address their concerns, ensuring needs are met and promoting a positive care experience.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the supervisor.

title: Senior Civil Project Manager
description:
Stantec's Water business is seeking a Senior Civil Project Manager, Water/Wastewater to join our growing team. This position is designed for an experienced civil engineering professional with a strong background in municipal water and wastewater infrastructure, multidisciplinary project leadership, client management, and successful project delivery.

The role emphasizes the management and delivery of complex engineering projects, including responsibility for project scope, schedule, budget, financial performance, risk management, client satisfaction, and multidisciplinary team coordination.

The successful candidate will provide overall project leadership and exercise sound engineering judgment while collaborating with technical discipline leads and specialized engineering professionals responsible for detailed design, technical development, and production.

In addition to project management responsibilities, this position provides opportunities to mentor engineers and developing project managers, share established project management practices, and contribute to the professional development of Stantec's Water team.

The Senior Civil Project Manager will work independently on assigned projects, lead multidisciplinary teams on larger and more complex assignments, and collaborate with Stantec professionals across the region and throughout North America to bring the appropriate expertise and resources to clients.

Your Key Responsibilities

Project Management and Delivery

  • Work in a manner that protects the health and safety of Stantec employees, clients, and the public by following company health, safety, and security guidelines and policies.
  • Serve as Senior Project Manager for municipal water and wastewater infrastructure projects, with an emphasis on water distribution, wastewater collection, pipelines, force mains, pump stations, lift stations, and related conveyance infrastructure.
  • Lead and manage projects through planning, alternatives evaluation, preliminary design, detailed design, permitting, bidding, construction, and project closeout.
  • Develop and manage project scopes, schedules, budgets, staffing plans, and quality requirements, maintaining accountability for successful delivery and project financial performance.
  • Proactively identify and manage project risks, scope changes, schedule constraints, resource limitations, and budget considerations.
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams, including civil, process mechanical, structural, electrical, instrumentation and controls, geotechnical, environmental, survey, and construction professionals.
  • Establish clear project responsibilities, communication protocols, milestones, and deliverable expectations among project team members.
  • Monitor project financial performance, including labor expenditures, project profitability, earned revenue, forecasting, and change management.
  • Coordinate preparation and delivery of engineering reports, technical memoranda, calculations, plans, specifications, cost estimates, and construction documents through appropriate technical discipline leads.
  • Provide overall project-level technical guidance and engineering judgment to facilitate practical, constructable, and cost-effective project solutions.
  • Coordinate technical reviews and quality management procedures, utilizing qualified discipline leads and technical reviewers to ensure compliance with applicable engineering standards and project requirements.
  • Oversee engineering services during construction, including coordination of submittal reviews, responses to requests for information, field observations, and contractor communications, with technical support from the appropriate discipline leads.
  • Coordinate permitting and regulatory activities with municipalities, utility owners, and applicable local, state, and federal agencies.
  • Lead project meetings, coordination workshops, project progress reviews, and client presentations.
  • Maintain appropriate communication with project stakeholders to identify potential challenges early and develop effective mitigation strategies.

Client Relationships and Business Development

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for clients, developing an understanding of their infrastructure needs, project objectives, operational constraints, and long-term capital improvement programs.
  • Establish and maintain trusted client relationships through responsive communication, sound judgment, and consistent project delivery.
  • Identify opportunities for additional services and future projects through ongoing client relationships and knowledge of municipal infrastructure needs.
  • Collaborate with local and regional leadership on business development opportunities, pursuit strategies, go/no-go decisions, and teaming arrangements.
  • Lead or support the preparation of Statements of Qualifications, proposals, project scopes, labor estimates, schedules, and fee proposals.
  • Participate in client interviews, presentations, and contract negotiations as appropriate.
  • Collaborate across Stantec offices and technical practices to provide clients with specialized expertise and support the continued growth of the Water business.

Mentoring and Professional Development

  • Mentor engineers and developing project managers in effective project planning, scope development, budgeting, scheduling, client communication, and successful project execution.
  • Provide guidance to project managers and team members in navigating complex project challenges, managing client expectations, and improving project financial and operational performance.
  • Promote effective project management practices, including resource planning, risk management, quality management, and consistent project delivery processes.
  • Encourage professional growth, accountability, collaboration, and knowledge sharing across multidisciplinary project teams.
  • Support development of future project leaders through coaching, practical experience, and sharing lessons learned from successful project delivery.

Other Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with Water leadership regarding project resource needs, staffing availability, and project delivery priorities.
  • Participate in initiatives intended to improve project management effectiveness, client service, and operational performance.
  • Other related duties or responsibilities as assigned, consistent with the position's primary project management and leadership functions.

Your Capabilities and Credentials

  • Strong knowledge of municipal water and wastewater infrastructure planning, design, and construction, including water distribution, wastewater collection and conveyance, pipelines, force mains, pump stations, and lift stations.
  • Demonstrated success managing multidisciplinary engineering projects with responsibility for project scope, schedules, budgets, financial performance, quality, risk, and client communication.
  • Strong understanding of project management principles, including project planning, resource allocation, financial forecasting, contract administration, and change management.
  • Ability to develop and manage engineering scopes of work, level-of-effort estimates, project budgets, staffing plans, and schedules.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary engineering professionals and coordinate technical resources to achieve project objectives.
  • Strong understanding of civil engineering design principles, utility coordination, grading, site development, construction practices, and applicable engineering standards.
  • Ability to exercise sound professional judgment in evaluating technical recommendations, project risks, constructability considerations, and alternative solutions.
  • Understanding of the relationship among engineering reports, drawings, specifications, calculations, estimates, and construction documents.
  • Experience managing client relationships and communicating effectively with municipal agencies, utility owners, regulatory authorities, consultants, and contractors.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent projects while maintaining attention to financial performance, project quality, and client satisfaction.
  • Ability to mentor and develop engineers and project managers through coaching, collaboration, and practical project experience.
  • Strong leadership, interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience preparing and presenting proposals, project updates, and client presentations.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and project management tools. Familiarity with relevant civil engineering design and modeling applications is preferred.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor of Science degree in Civil Engineering or a related engineering discipline required.
  • Licensed Professional Engineer (PE) required, or the ability to obtain licensure in the applicable state within an agreed timeframe.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification preferred.
  • Minimum 15 years of progressively responsible experience in civil engineering, preferably focused on municipal water and wastewater infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated experience managing engineering projects and multidisciplinary teams, including responsibility for scopes, schedules, budgets, financial performance, and client communications.
  • Experience managing municipal client relationships and delivering projects through multiple phases of planning, design, permitting, and construction.
  • Experience mentoring engineers or developing project managers preferred.
  • Valid driver's license and ability to travel as required.

Stantec offers a comprehensive benefits program, which may include retirement savings opportunities, health and wellness benefits, paid time off, and professional development opportunities, subject to applicable company policies and eligibility requirements.

title: Insurance Specialist
description:

Memorial Medical Center is part of Lifepoint Health, a diversified healthcare delivery network with facilities coast to coast. As an Insurance Specialist, joining our team, you’re embracing a vital mission dedicated to making communities healthier ®. Join us on this meaningful journey where your skills, compassion and dedication will make a remarkable difference in the lives of those we serve.

How you'll contribute
An Insurance Specialist who excels in this role:

  • Verifies and documents insurance benefits, secures pre-certification/referral numbers and estimates/collects patient liabilities on all outpatient scheduled procedures.
  • Ensures that pre-certifications required by managed care companies for scheduled surgeries and procedures are obtained on a timely basis and documented in advance of appointment
  • Notifies physician offices and centralized scheduling in the event pre-cert is not obtained in time for patient appointments

  • Verifies the patient has active insurance coverage and obtains insurance benefits utilizing insurance eligibility tools, payer websites and payer phone systems
  • Communicates with Benefits and Notification Specialist whenever a patient has no verifiable insurance benefits to cover a scheduled procedure.
  • Works closely with physician offices and departments of the hospital when obtaining clinical information, providing them with necessary information or forwarding relevant documents to them.
  • Creates and explains patient liability estimates for all scheduled and add-on procedures.
  • Contacts patient or physician offices when insurance information invalid or termed for all scheduled procedures.

Education:

  • Must be able to work in a stressful environment and take appropriate action.
  • Must be able to function appropriately in a multi-task setting.
  • Working knowledge of managed care and third-party payors

Schedule: Full-time

Why join us
We believe that investing in our employees is the first step to providing excellent patient care. In addition to your base compensation, this position also offers:

  • Employee Well-being: Mental, physical, and financial wellness programs (free gym memberships, virtual care appointments, mental health services and discount programs).
  • Professional Development: Ongoing learning and career advancement opportunities.

Memorial Medical Center is a 199-bed acute medical/surgical teaching hospital located in Las Cruces, NM, and is part of Lifepoint Health, a diversified healthcare delivery network committed to making communities healthier® with acute care, rehabilitation, and behavioral health facilities from coast to coast. From your first day to your next career milestone—your experience matters.
